text:
那个 @predictdotfun 亏本是早有预料的事情。

几年前，ai还不是很成熟，每个团队都还是野蛮生长，不少founder还存有理想主义，那个时候大家都还挺相信去中心化这个叙事，所以做了很多不错的产品出来。
就算是为了发币割人，但最终目标就是为了上币安，才有足够的流动性退出。

但当时币安现货/合约其实很不好上，这也就衍生出了一堆掮客/中介，声称自己有资源能上现货。这种除了付费之外，还需要大量的链上数据，这也就让空投佬和工作室派上了用场

在2026的今天，gpt都更新到6.1了，claude强大又封号，导致一大堆mac mini出海的今天。工作室过往的技术壁垒已经被最大限度的抹平了。普通散户，也能靠免费的ai手搓一个“自用”小工具。你要有想法，愿意付上个几十一百刀，还能做的更好。
这对项目方而言，是一个最美的时代。
alpha降低了所谓的“上币安”的门槛，ai减少了团队的技术人力的支出。既然是要往外给钱的，我给bn就好了，为什么还要给散户？
所以这个时代里，我们如果还想靠着“撸”项目致富，大概率是不太可能的。
你得精准押注到一个“有理想主义的老外团队，且有正向盈利空间”的项目，才有机会靠这一个项目的空投翻身。

但撸毛本身还是一直存在的，只是空投这种形式已经落后于时代了。
以后的好项目，更多会通过公募的形式给用户散发筹码
要不然就是，类似于 @TapeOutWorld @UsePaid @gangdotfun @Ptahtrade 这种，半meme半撸毛的属性。
如果非要交互项目，也一定要选有盈利的赛道/项目。但羊毛出在羊身上，这种项目未来大都会沦为花钱买分的存在，比如各类型的perps和预测平台。

我的判断路径

1、卖工具也好，卖咨询也好，生产力场景的核心是让别人赚到钱，然后别人分你钱

当然，这个钱可能是预付，比如我知道 MacBook 能帮我赚钱，所以我不管最终赚不赚到，我先买 MacBook

2、dbskill 跑了几个月，我意识到，我的 skill 可以帮很多人赚钱，但是真正用上的人只有 1%

3、所以赚钱的机会就是：如何让 99% 的人用上 dbskill

4、用上 dbskill 两大门槛：1️⃣ 不会使用通用 Agent 2️⃣ 不会写提示词，不知道用哪个 skill 干啥事

5、问题 1️⃣ 通过微信解决，直接在微信里面扫码开箱即用，直接不用学了，bot 智能决策应该调用什么 skill

6、问题 2️⃣，即便在微信里面，我不会写提示词，AI 不说话、人也不说话，skill 依然不会被调用，那就 proactive，让 AI 主动说话，让 AI 主动告诉你，你还有什么事情没干完，而它接下来准备用什么技能帮你干好这个事情，你只需要说：“1” 就可以了

7、可是 AI 怎么才能完成这个事情呢？上下文从哪来呢？解决方案有三：

A、开场的时候主动对话，主动收集信息
B、对于不能搭建知识库的用户，售卖一个搭建知识库的服务，这个知识库既可以服务 codex，也可以服务 dondon bot
C、对于已有知识库的用户，用户直接在微信把一个压缩包发给 dondon bot 就行了，一键拥有上下文

~14 hours ago, 𝕏 updated the algorithm (again).

There are a few new things worth noting: 

• New "user debias" model: adjusts engagement based on how "generous" each viewer is 

• Likes from people who like everything will start counting less 

• Engagement from "picky" users who rarely interact will count more 

• Engagement pods and "like for like" groups got weaker

• Some general search improvements 

• Media (video and image) are now tracked as their own signals

What still matters most:  

• Posting high-quality, original content

• Replies (5x) and quotes (5x) are weighted far above likes (0.5x) 

• Shares via DM (5x) and copy link (20x) are the strongest positive signals 

• A predicted follow is worth 4x 

• Reports, mutes, blocks, and "not interested" are heavily negative 

• Posts older than 48 hours drop out of For You 

• Posting too much in a row decays your reach

TL;DR: regardless of algo changes, just focus on producing content that is unique to you.

author: matthew_d_green
quoted_text:
Announcing 3 Critical vulns for hundreds of millions of IoT, Firewalls, OT, and Military devices including: Palo Alto Networks, Comcast, D-Link, HP, Canon, Honeywell, GE, Oracle, Siemens, Rockwell, Digi, Lockheed Martin, Boeing... 

The vulns are with GoAhead Web Server which is a backend library used by these devices. There's a patch available from GoAhead but that doesn't mean there's a patch available for the devices yet -- that's up to the manufacturer.

- TLS traffic over DHE ciphers have a 1-byte secret, "04", meaning anyone can decrypt connections to these devices and steal login credentials and session tokens if the client negotiated with DHE ciphers like the latest TLS_DHE_RSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256, which is extremely likely.

- LibreSSL mTLS has been completely bypassed, meaning anyone can connect over mTLS. If you have one of these devices listening on the internet and are expecting mTLS to protect it from attackers, take it offline or patch asap.

- OpenSSL Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs) are not enforced, meaning if a user device is stolen or compromised, and you revoke that mTLS cert, nothing actually happens. There are a lot of other attacks this can be used for.

These are critical because these types of devices run our world. Water systems, electricity, military, firewalls, critical infrastructure.

https://t.co/AYUgNsrA0f

quoted_text:
4 data leaks reported today:

1. Coinbase's vendor Amplitude exposed some users’ contact data (funds unaffected).
2. Bithumb (Korea) had user data leaks.

In TradFi, two securities firms in Korea leaked data: 
3. Mirae Asset
4. Daishin Securities

You can't prevent a leak, but you can protect yourself.

Leaked exchange data (names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, ID documents, transaction history) is mostly used for phishing, SIM swapping, and social engineering.

Reduce info you share
- Use a unique email alias for each exchange (SimpleLogin, Apple Hide My Email, etc). A leak then can't be linked to your other accounts, and you can spot which service leaked.
- Share only what's required. Don't add optional profile details.
- Use a dedicated phone number (a VoIP or secondary SIM) for exchange accounts if you can, since leaked numbers are the main route to SIM swaps.

Lock down the account
- Use a unique, long password from a password manager.
- Turn on hardware security keys (YubiKey) or passkeys, or at least an authenticator app.
- Avoid SMS 2FA.
- Enable withdrawal address whitelisting and a withdrawal time lock if the exchange offers them.
- Set up an anti-phishing code, which puts a code you choose in every legitimate email from the exchange.
- Review active sessions and API keys regularly. Delete any API keys you don't use.
- Restrict API keys to withdraw-disabled and IP-whitelisted.

Defend against
- SIM swapping: Ask your carrier to add a port-out PIN or number lock.
- Phishing and impersonation: Assume anyone who contacts you about your account, "security issues," or "refund recovery" is a scammer, even if they know your name, balance, or recent trades.
- Exchange support staff don't ask for your password, 2FA codes, or seed phrase.
- Never click links in emails or texts. Go to the site yourself.

- "Wrench attacks": Leaked addresses plus holdings data have led to real-world extortion and robberies. Don't publicize your holdings, and keep large balances out of anything tied to your home address if you can.

If a breach is announced
1. Change the exchange password and any other account that reused it.
2. Check https://t.co/qtIGFkbaPO for your email address.
3. Revoke API keys and active sessions.
4. Review recent withdrawals and security settings.
5. Watch for phishing emails and texts that reference the breach, because scammers move fast after one.

Stay SAFU! 🙏

I’m genuinely devastated by what happened in Spain today.

64 people have lost their lives and more than 179 have been injured after two high-speed trains collided near Urda, Toledo.

And what makes this even more heartbreaking is that this is the second major railway tragedy in Spain in just nine months.

Here’s what we know so far:

At 8:54 AM, a Renfe AVE traveling from Madrid to Seville reportedly crashed into the back of an Iryo train that was stopped on the same track.

- 397 people were aboard the AVE
- 147 people were aboard the Iryo
- several carriages derailed and fell down an embankment

Investigators are now examining whether a mistake in the instructions given by rail traffic control allowed the AVE to continue when it should have been moving under stricter safety restrictions.

The exact cause has not yet been established.

we’re talking about people’s lives, not something we should rush to turn into a political argument.

In January, another railway disaster in Adamuz killed 46 people.

Two major tragedies on Spain’s high-speed rail network in the same year.

And now families are once again waiting for news of their loved ones.

I also remember Transport Minister Óscar Puente saying after the January accident that the probability of another similar tragedy was extremely low.

Sigh.

Today, those words are incredibly painful to read.

I’m not going to pretend I know who is responsible before the investigation is completed.

But I do believe the Spanish public deserves a full explanation of what failed, why it failed and what will be done to make sure this never happens again.

My thoughts are with every victim, every injured passenger and every family going through this nightmare.

What a heartbreaking day for Spain.

What’s happening to the country I used to love.

text:
比特币的白皮书一共 9 页，定义了未来的钱，超主权货币

Yuki 视频里讲的这篇《Attention Is All You Need》，15 页，定义了整个 AI 产业的发展

1/ 以前的电脑读句子像玩传话游戏，现在像开圆桌会议

传话是一个接一个往下传，传到最后一个，开头早忘了；现在是把整句话摊在桌上，每个字同时听完所有人说话

2/ 意思可以像坐标一样做加减法

“小猫”减“猫”加“狗”，差不多就是“小狗”。从猫走到小猫的方向，和从狗走到小狗的方向几乎一样，说明电脑真的把意思变成了位置

3/ 语法不是人教的，是它自己看出来的

翻译“动物没过马路，因为它太累了”，把它的注意力画出来，it 指向的是“动物”，不是“马路”。没人告诉它这个规则

4/ 一个字的意思，看它旁边站着谁

“苹果”在水果摊是水果，在发布会现场是一家公司。字没变，旁边变了，意思就变了

5/ 每个字会自己挑，该多听谁的

“小猫没吃鱼，因为它不饿”，看到“它”，句子会回头找，发现“小猫”最对得上，就把小猫的信息拿过来

6/ 第一个字和第一百个字，可以直接对上话

中间不用经过九十八个人传话，一步就够。所以句子再长，它也不会读到后面忘了前面

7/ 能同时算，才是它真正厉害的地方

不是排一队一个一个来，是所有字一起算，显卡几千个核心全开工。所以它才能不断加人、不断变大

8/ 加人真的有用，这条规律被验证了九年

模型大十倍、数据多十倍，能力就上一个台阶。所以公司敢一直买卡、一直建机房

9/ 八个角度一起看，是它自己分的工

一个盯语法，一个盯谁指代谁，一个盯动作是谁做的。分工没人规定，是训练的时候自己长出来的

10/ 一次看全文，所以它分不清先后

“狗咬人”和“人咬狗”在它眼里曾经一模一样，所以要给每个字编号，它才知道谁先谁后

11/ 记性是有价格的

句子长一倍，计算量涨四倍。你给它的资料越长，烧的钱越多，所以 AI 的记性一直很贵

12/ 它不查资料，它是在接话

就像你说半句，它猜你下一句。所以它会一本正经地编，因为它从不查，只负责接

13/ 训练时故意不让它太自信

逼它对答案留一点余地，结果反而更准。太笃定的模型，错得也更离谱

14/ 每一层只改一点，不推倒重来

新的等于旧的加上这一层的修改，所以它能堆几十层、几百层而不乱
author: UnicornBitcoin
quoted_text:
今天的主流大模型，ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek，底层都是将近十年前的算法：2017 年谷歌论文《Attention Is All You Need》里的 Transformer。我做了个视频，用大白话讲清楚AI在想什么？

看这篇论文的时候，我诞生了两个想法

1、Transformer 把理解语言变成了矩阵乘法，这正是显卡的强项。模型越大，显卡卖得越多，英伟达踩中这张算法彩票，赢了将近十年。可 Mamba、RWKV、扩散语言模型都在挑战它，算法一变，护城河就可能动摇...

2、论文里的核心公式：Attention(Q,K,V) = softmax(QKᵀ/√dₖ)·V

一个字的意思由身边的字决定："因为它不饿"，它是小猫；"因为它不新鲜"，它是鱼。

我用"生命三问"理解 Q、K、V：你要去哪里、你是谁、你从哪里来。

这很像佛教的缘起：意义依条件而生

A lot of ink has been spilled on GPU financing lately. I spent over a decade trading ABS on Wall St, and structured over $2B+ of debt financings as an operator (including at @tryramp). Figured I'd try to make sense of this market, so I went back to a framework I knew well: aircraft ABS and aircraft engine ABS.

My take: a GPU neocloud runs on airline economics, and the debt behind it looks a lot like aircraft engine ABS.

The parallels:

• Perishable inventory. An empty seat after the door closes is gone forever. So is an idle hour on an energized H100 rack.
• 85%+ of cost is fixed (servers, 10-year rack leases, 10-14% debt service). One more hour of compute costs pennies of power.
• Utilization is everything. Airlines break even around 80% load factor, a levered GPU cluster around 65-75%. The returns live in those last 25 percentage points.
• NVIDIA is Boeing and Airbus rolled into one. Powered shells and grid interconnects are the new airport slots.
• Wall St copied the aircraft financing playbook: take-or-pay contract plus servers in a bankruptcy-remote SPV, 70-80% LTV.

Part 1 of my blog post goes into a lot more detail:

https://t.co/0fghWVnGOU

text:
最近花了半天，对比方案，把自己的 Apple Watch 健康数据接给了 Grok @bot 。过程挺折腾，但结果让我对「个人数据 + AI Agent」这件事有了点判断。

🤖 我的路径是这样的：
- 通过一个第三方 App 把「苹果健康」 里的数据导成 CSV
- iPhone 快捷指令把 CSV 推到我的接收端
- 再设一个自动化：每次我打开运动 App，就推送一次，保证数据连贯
- 最后让 AI 去读库，并总结

整个过程，个人健康数据不缺，各种采集设备非常齐全了，手机手表戒指体重秤等。缺的是让它自动流进来。

也有类似的项目，再做这样的事情，例如 Gotchi Labs @sleepagotchi 从睡眠和健康场景切入，目标是把个人健康数据和 AI Agent 带进真实日常，是首个已上线并实现规模化的垂直业务。这正好是我自己折腾一圈后觉得真正缺的那一块：用户不用自己搭管道，数据就应该能帮他做件事。

公开数据显示，Sleepagotchi 的新 App 拥有 60 万用户，并且是 Solana Seeker 手机上的第一大应用，让我掏出了我尘封已久的 Seeker 手机开始感受 😁

其实相比 AI App 本地分析，我更期待这些健康 App 能自由开放数据接口，让用户可以自由控制，并且选择自己想分析的地方。当然，它最终能不能把这个循环跑顺，还要看后面的产品迭代。

text: Chutes is very excited to be working with METANOVA LABS as they develop their Hit-to-Lead optimization agent! We fully intend to assist and support to this project in any way we can as it develops.
author: chutes_ai
quoted_text:
NOVA Hit-to-Lead Optimization Agent
In collaboration with @chutes_ai and @onepot_ai 

We're developing a Hit-to-Lead optimization agent that integrates an algorithm developed by a NOVA Blueprint winner, extending NOVA's capabilities beyond hit discovery and into the iterative optimization of small molecules.

The system combines a domain-specialized AI agent with proprietary combinatorial chemical databases supplied by our partner Onepot AI, spanning billions of possible compounds, that are delivered within 5-7 business days. 

Researchers will be able to guide the agent in developing, comparing and refining optimization strategies, exploring chemical modifications and prioritizing candidates based on predicted affinity, selectivity, physicochemical properties and specific binding interactions.

Confidentiality is a central design requirement. Pharmaceutical R&D involves valuable intellectual property, including compound structures, targets, emerging chemical series and optimization strategies that cannot be exposed publicly.

The Chutes team integrated domain specific models so that we can run inference in their verified Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs), with encrypted communication and controlled access to proprietary databases and project records. This architecture is intended to support confidential inference on external infrastructure while preserving organizational control over sensitive research data.

Finding a molecule with promising predicted affinity is only the beginning. Hit-to-Lead optimization involves balancing multiple, often competing objectives, including potency, selectivity, physicochemical properties and synthesizability, before progressing toward experimental activity and ADME validation.

The next step is to integrate the agent into our own Hit-to-Lead development program.

For NOVA, this represents an important step toward translating algorithms developed through open competition into tools for proprietary drug discovery programs, including our own asset-development pipeline and those of external research partners.

quoted_text:
I’ll try to steelman the opposition position:

RH tokenized stocks are probably disliked for the same reason non-sponsored ADRs are disliked: the company’s name is on something it didn’t authorize and doesn’t do things like revert unvoted shares to management control.

The new (not old EU swap-based) RH tokenized stocks do not pass beneficial ownership, and are a debt instrument with exposure to RH itself potentially. Ondo put their backing into an SPV that’s designed for bankruptcy remoteness but the Jersey-issued RH tokens do not appear to be claiming remoteness from RH’s creditors that I’ve seen. Please correct me if you have seen otherwise.

So from AMC or another company’s view, you have people who view themselves as shareholders, but are not actually shareholders holders. The RH tokens feel closer to a Contract-For-Difference.

Legally, I suspect RH is right that everything is meeting the letter of the law, but from the public company’s perspective, the tokens create a big blast radius for you via vanilla creditors of Robinhood thinking they are owners in your company.

⬆️ That’s the steelman I’d construct for AMC et al. I think it breaks down if I’ve misunderstood how this generation of RH tokenized stocks are structured

text:
read through the launch post and i feel hybrid architechtures are the next big thing.
the main thing about LFM3 from Liquid AI is that
instead of relying entirely on attention, their 1.7B model uses 13 gated convolution layers, 5 sliding-window attention layers, and only 6 global attention layers. the intuition makes sense. you don't need expensive global attention for every token interaction. convolutions handle local patterns cheaply, SWA captures nearby dependencies, and global attention handles the longer range stuff.

what's interesting is that this gets them a 256K context window, ~1GB weights at 4 bit, and reportedly 25% faster inference at 8K context compared to LFM2-1.2B on edge devices.

@lintaho and I started @FormationBio because we believed the biggest bottleneck in bringing new medicines to patients wasn’t drug discovery, but drug development.

Our new Fund brings together dedicated capital, drug development expertise, and AI-powered development capabilities to acquire promising drugs and advance them through the clinic.

text:
AI时代，后发先至正在失效

过去三十年，中国靠人口红利、工程师密度、组织动员能力，在互联网、智能手机、电动车等领域平均"用十年左右" 追上并超越美国。这套模式在“方向已定、需要执行”的阶段极其有效。

但AI改变了规则：

- “智力总量 = 人 + 算力 × 模型。” 
美国算力占全球约75%，四大云厂商年资本开支已达7000亿美元量级，明年或超1万亿；中国约1300亿，差距约5倍。前沿模型仍落后数月。

- 创新周期从“十年一变”压缩到“一年一变”。举国体制的研究、协调、资源聚集需要时间，而对方已在持续加速。

- 虚拟世界的领先正渗透物理世界：AI直接设计直升机、控制机器人、突破材料与药物。专利一旦被先占，后发几乎无法追赶。

Anthropic这类公司正在形成人才与资本的正反馈黑洞。SpaceX星舰的发射与回收节奏，也在用同样逻辑拉大差距。

资本层面同样关键。
A股本质是服务国家战略方向的资源池，而非自由市场。
方向符合红头文件的公司容易融资上市；方向之外的创新很难获得资源。这在需要“集中力量办大事”时有效，但在需要百花齐放的探索期会限制可能性。

可见的手（政府）擅长执行与动员，无形的手 (市场和法律、法规）擅长试错与涌现。AI时代，创新权重正在上升。

对创业者：方向不在政策清单内，就把事做成生意，别执着市值叙事。

对下一代：“尽量给他全球舞台，而不是只停留在单一市场。” 

“智能总量的分配，正在决定未来谁能持续创新。
对于中美的AI竞争的思考，也许能得到结论。
还有投资方向、住居地、孩子的教育等..." - ccl 

#Superintelligence #AI

text:
NOVA Hit-to-Lead Optimization Agent
In collaboration with @chutes_ai and @onepot_ai 

We're developing a Hit-to-Lead optimization agent that integrates an algorithm developed by a NOVA Blueprint winner, extending NOVA's capabilities beyond hit discovery and into the iterative optimization of small molecules.

The system combines a domain-specialized AI agent with proprietary combinatorial chemical databases supplied by our partner Onepot AI, spanning billions of possible compounds, that are delivered within 5-7 business days. 

Researchers will be able to guide the agent in developing, comparing and refining optimization strategies, exploring chemical modifications and prioritizing candidates based on predicted affinity, selectivity, physicochemical properties and specific binding interactions.

Confidentiality is a central design requirement. Pharmaceutical R&D involves valuable intellectual property, including compound structures, targets, emerging chemical series and optimization strategies that cannot be exposed publicly.

The Chutes team integrated domain specific models so that we can run inference in their verified Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs), with encrypted communication and controlled access to proprietary databases and project records. This architecture is intended to support confidential inference on external infrastructure while preserving organizational control over sensitive research data.

Finding a molecule with promising predicted affinity is only the beginning. Hit-to-Lead optimization involves balancing multiple, often competing objectives, including potency, selectivity, physicochemical properties and synthesizability, before progressing toward experimental activity and ADME validation.

The next step is to integrate the agent into our own Hit-to-Lead development program.

For NOVA, this represents an important step toward translating algorithms developed through open competition into tools for proprietary drug discovery programs, including our own asset-development pipeline and those of external research partners.

author: dapangdun
quoted_text:
我最近一直在研究“抗量子公链”这个赛道，这个概念并不新鲜，从我前几篇的推文介绍中可以看到2018年就已经有相关的公链了，所以为什么？

这个 “为什么” 实际上是两个问题：
1. 为什么选择研究这个赛道？
2. 为什么是现在？

先回答第1️⃣个问题：

（1）随着量子技术的发展，它会被越来越多的提及，它会有持续不断的叙事热度；

（2）虽然现在“量子计算机”并没有问世，但是这是一个很难被证伪的赛道，特别是在中美都在大力发展这项技术的前提下，即使不幸最后被证伪，也是一个长期的过程，这个叙事具有长期持续性；

（3）我判断：未来抗量子会成为标配。所以这里面就会蕴含着很多的机会，老公链升级的机会，新公链诞生的机会；

（4）我有一种感觉：会有一条定位“抗量子”的公链重现上一轮 $KAS 的神话，这是我想把握的！

接着回答第2️⃣个问题：

（1）技术的发展可以很明显看到在加速，破解所需物理比特数量在不断降低，技术在迭代，新技术在不断推出；

（2）当下的AI会加速这个过程，我一直认为AI就是“世界加速主义”的催化剂，它也确实有效，我和量子相关的从业人员讨论的时候，他们也明确给出这样的结论；

（3）所以，我认为，我们现在真的站在了“迎接一个真实的新挑战”的起点上（以往我还是有一定质疑的，因为量子技术不仅是技术问题，还是工程实践问题），我想要站在这个新浪潮上。

#postquantum #Quantum

quoted_text:
我给百合网创始人转了2000后拉黑了他。

今天天气不错，
二连板，吃着天妇罗刷着抖音，
突然看到一条新闻：百合网的联合创始人慕岩，因为财产被冻结，生活遇到了困难，甚至在朋友圈发了收款二维码，向朋友们寻求帮助。
我跟慕岩认识，以前连过麦，微信里偶尔也会聊几句。上一次聊天，我们还在讨论孙宇晨。印象里，他以前在我直播间刷过几百块钱的礼物。
所以看到新闻，我就想着给他转点钱。
本来准备转一万块钱的。
但看到他当时一共才筹集了五千多块钱，我又觉得不合适。一个曾经那么成功的企业家，如今愿意发二维码求助，想必已经经过了一番心理挣扎。大家几百块地转，我突然转过去一万块钱，比他筹集的总金额还多，反而可能让他不好意思收。
于是改成了2000块钱。即便如此，按照我当时看到的记录，这依然是最大的一笔。
转完之后，我又想了想，干脆把他微信删了。
我给他留了一句话：
“为避免收款心里有压力，我就先删除了，回头有事找我随时加回来。你的放下，注定你可以再次找到人生的方向，下一个人生路口再聚。”
为什么要删呢？
因为我们算不上特别亲密的朋友。我怕他不好意思收，也怕他想着怎么感谢我、怎么还这份人情。
反正我都把他删了，他收了也就收了。我希望他能少一点心理负担。
这件事让我想了很多。
慕岩曾经是中国互联网创业浪潮里非常成功的一批人。百合网最辉煌的时候，他拥有过的财富和社会地位，恐怕是绝大多数人一辈子都无法企及的。
但人生有时候就是这么奇怪。一个人可以花二十年建立自己的事业，却未必能够决定未来二十年会发生什么。
我在人选天选论里写过两句话：
选择必有代价，不选择也是选择。
未失而能止者，人选也；既失而后止者，天选也。
这两句话放在财富上，尤其值得思考。
我们总是把赚钱看成一种能力。一个人从零赚到一千万，我们佩服他；从一千万赚到一个亿，我们更佩服他。
可一个人赚到一个亿之后，决定不再追逐下一个十亿，安安稳稳守住财富，难道就不值得佩服吗？
我甚至觉得，后者可能更难。
因为赚钱需要不断寻找机会，而守钱往往需要不断放弃机会。
一个人已经赚到足够生活一辈子的钱，却依然要面对无数诱惑。有人告诉他项目可以让资产翻倍，有人告诉他某个行业正在风口上，错过就再也没有机会。
他过去又确实成功过很多次，于是继续下注，继续扩张，继续承担风险。
可财富积累到一定程度以后，风险和收益对人生的意义，已经不再对称。
一个拥有一个亿的人，再赚一个亿，生活未必会发生多大改变。但失去这一个亿，生活却可能翻天覆地。
所以关于财富，我觉得有一个特别简单的道理：
永远不要用我们需要的钱，去挣我们不需要的钱。
什么叫需要的钱？
是能够让家人安稳生活的钱，是孩子的教育、父母的养老，是生病时不必借钱，是不想工作时还能有底气休息几年。
什么叫不需要的钱？
是已经拥有足够的财富，却还想再多赚一点；是一个亿变成两个亿，两个亿变成五个亿；是那些即使没有赚到，也不会影响生活的数字。
如果为了后者，把前者也押上去，无论最后赢了多少钱，这个选择都值得警惕。
我不反对冒险，也不反对追求财富。但至少应该知道，哪些钱可以冒险，哪些钱无论如何都应该留下来。
选择继续追逐财富，要承担失去财富的可能；选择停下来，也要承担错过机会的遗憾。
但人最容易犯的错误，就是把错过赚钱机会的遗憾，看得比失去已有财富的痛苦还重。
赚到一个亿以后，看到别人赚了十个亿，觉得自己错过了九个亿。可那九个亿原本就不属于你。
你真正拥有的，是手里的一个亿。
为了追逐那九个亿，把已经拥有的一个亿也输掉了，这才是真正的损失。
这就是“未失而能止者，人选也；既失而后止者，天选也”。
在还有选择权的时候，主动决定不再追逐什么，这叫人选。等到财富失去，现实逼着你停下来，那就由不得自己选择了。
当然，我不知道慕岩今天的处境究竟是怎样造成的，更不知道他过去做过哪些财务选择。我虽然想用一个人的困难去证明自己的观点，但不能。
但他的事情确实再次提醒了我，人在有的时候，一定要懂得守，尤其要懂得放弃。
而财富的得失，还只是事情的一面。
更难的是，一个人失去财富以后，能不能放下过去的自己。
我们这个社会特别喜欢讲东山再起。一个成功的企业家遇到困难，大家第一反应就是，他什么时候能够重新成功？
仿佛曾经拥有过一个亿，以后就必须再赚回一个亿，否则就意味着失败。
可为什么呢？
一个人曾经站在山顶，难道就没有资格走下山来？
他可以重新创业，也可以过普通人的生活。可以继续追逐财富，也可以做过去一直想做、却没有时间做的事情。
人生又不是只有一场考试，考过一次第一名，以后就必须永远考第一名。
有时候，最难放下的可能已经不是钱，而是曾经那个成功的自己。
曾经别人见到你，会主动打招呼，尊重你的意见，认真听你讲话。突然有一天，这些东西都变了。
你还能不能接受自己？还能不能坦然面对曾经认识你的人？还能不能允许自己重新成为普通人？
这些问题，可能比失去多少钱更难回答。
所以看到慕岩公开求助，我并不觉得有什么可笑的。一个人愿意承认困难，愿意向别人开口，本身就需要勇气。
我希望他能渡过难关，也希望他不必被过去的成功困住。
说回那2000块钱。
我为什么转完以后，要把他删掉？
除了不想让他收款时有压力，还有一个原因。
我不想让这2000块钱变成一笔未来的投资。
慕岩毕竟曾经是成功的企业家。也许有一天，他真的东山再起了。
到那个时候，我会不会想起自己曾经帮助过他？会不会觉得，我们之间因此多了一份特殊的关系？
我不敢保证自己一定不会。
人对自己的道德评价，往往比真实的自己要高。
《人选天选论》里还有一句话：
道德是选择完成后对自己的解释。
我今天可以说自己出于好意，过几年，也许又会给这件事找出另外一套解释。
所以我选择把这段关系暂时放下。
他曾经给我刷过礼物，我今天有能力，就给他转2000块钱。至于他将来会不会重新成功，会不会记得，都不重要。
当然，有人可能会问：既然不想要回报，为什么还要发文章讲这件事？
两个原因。
第一个，给自己的决策装装逼。
我没必要把自己包装得多么高尚，仿佛连一点虚荣心都没有。
第二个，希望这件事能被更多人看见。
慕岩求助的消息已经传了出来，我不知道他是否希望得到更多关注，也不知道外界的帮助能不能解决问题。但如果文章能让更多人了解他的处境，或许也能带来一点帮助。
虚荣心是我的，2000块钱也是我自愿给的。我可以承认自己想装逼，但不想因此要求他欠我一个人情。
其实人与人之间的缘分，有时候挺奇妙的。
我们上次还在微信里讨论孙宇晨，讨论别人的事情。没想到过了一段时间，我却在新闻里看到了他的事情。
今天我有能力给他转2000块钱，明天也许我会遇到自己的困难。谁又能保证一辈子都顺风顺水呢？
至于慕岩兄，如果将来他东山再起，我会不会替他高兴；如果他选择放下过去，重新开始另一种生活，我倒是会祝福他。
我们曾经有过一麦之缘，
他不必因此记住我，如果有一天，我们又在什么地方碰见，还能像以前一样，聊聊孙宇晨，聊聊各自的经历着就很好。
君子之交，淡如水，下个人生路口再见。

耶鲁大学最新的经济学数学模型，撕开了 AGI 时代最恐怖的真相：

AGI将彻底消灭中产阶层，

未来的工资，不再取决于你的文凭和资历，而是严格取决于替代你所需的 2 美元电费和 GPU 算力。

兄弟们这不是什么耸人听闻的科幻预言，是一篇经过同行评审的论文对中产终局的数学推演结论，耶鲁大学通过同行评审的一篇宏观经济学模型论文，用极其严密的数学推演，撕碎了现代中产阶级赖以生存的最后一张安全网。

它没有泛泛而谈“AI 抢走谁的饭碗”，而是冷酷地论证了一个不可逆的经济学死刑：
在通用人工智能全面铺开的终局里，人类劳动对经济增长的贡献率，在数学上将直接趋近于零。

过去两百年，现代社会所有中产阶级的体面生活，都建立在一个牢不可破的底层公式上：
你用数十年的教育投资换来专业技能的稀缺性，再用每天出卖的 8 小时时间，从社会的总蛋糕里分走属于你的劳动报酬。

人力资本，是推动人类文明财富飞轮运转的核心引擎。

但这篇论文指出了一个颠覆性的资本替代断层：
当真正的 AGI 降临，决定你薪水的不再是名校文凭、行业经验或者你的生活成本，你的劳动价值将被严格锚定为“在云端复制你产出所需的 GPU 算力和电力成本”。

如果一个智能体跑在机房里，只需要烧掉 2 美元的电费和硬件折旧就能做完你一整天的工作，那么在纯粹的微观经济学天平上，你的劳动价值上限就被死死钉在了 2 美元。

模型推演出了一个更让人后背发凉的宏观反差：
哪怕明天全世界有 50% 的人类劳动力直接躺平罢工，全球 GDP 甚至连一个百分点都不会往下掉。

相反，整体经济规模还会以更夸张的指数级一路狂飙。

因为在由算法、半导体和清洁能源主导的新生产力闭环里，脆弱的碳基肉身，早就成了整个生产流水线上效率最低、故障率最高的一个摩擦阻力。

这不是一次常规的产业结构转型，而是整个人类社会资产属性的彻底大换血。

整个文明正在从依赖人力资本的旧世界，不可逆地倒戈向完全依托“计算资本”的新大陆。

一旦你的脑力输出能够被一排机柜里的硅片以极低的边际成本模拟，你在经济系统里的博弈杠杆就被连根拔起了。

以前是机器帮人类打工，人类享受劳动带来的溢价与尊严。

未来是硅片彻底接管经济系统，而人类正被自己亲手造出来的生产力工具，合法且优雅地挤出财富分配的大门。

所以大家别再迷信单靠卖时间能换来代际财富了，

当劳动的市场定价被电表和显卡接管，不能把自己的资产转化成算力、能源或稀缺生产资料的人，

都将在数学意义上沦为新经济体系下的赤贫中产。

quoted_text:
Surprise 1: Anthropic acquired a one-person biotech
.
.
.
Surprise 2: that person is me
Surprise 3: I’m here to tell you all about it

Yes, this is what you think it is; after 6 yrs of increasingly loose anonymity: the Professor Oak reveal post

…and yes, it has gotten so boring around here that I’m literally doxxing myself to spice up the timeline

-------
Ok, allow me to introduce myself. My name is Cody Tranbarger. I mostly tweet, but occasionally find time to dabble in drug dev & starting/building biotechs. My past lives span the VC, crossover, startup continuum; Prof Oak has been my way of keeping a digital foot in those worlds, despite having my physical feet planted elsewhere.

The past 18 mo, ‘elsewhere’ was Mithril Medicine, a co. I founded to develop bsAbs for LAMA2-CMD & other ECM-related genetic diseases.

Mithril was born out of hands-on building with @MikeNGladstone, @JasonPaulRhodes, @LifeSciVC, & team @atlasventure. Somehow, I made enough half-decent calls along the way (even a broken clock is right twice a day, eh?) to convince them Mithril/I warranted a small seed. While I can hardly rationalize such an outrageously cavalier bet, I’m grateful for it, & I'd partner with Atlas again in a heartbeat.

In typical AV fashion, Mithril’s primordial form was virtual, decentralized, & ultra-lean. This stage tends to be short-lived, but for Mithril, it worked surprisingly well, for surprisingly long, thanks in part to the rapid maturation of the AI tools I used liberally.

Eventually, Mithril became a bit of an experiment itself - to find the upper bound of how far it could scale as a single operator + a bunch of Claude (+ a stellar bench of part-time consultants).

In parallel, I started spending time with @nc_frey, @an1lam, & @CoefficientBio team; and promptly experienced, for the 1st time, AI at the frontier. Soon thereafter, Mithril stopped looking like an experiment, & started looking like a preview of an entirely new operating model.

From that spark came “Pipeline-in-a-Person.” The idea immediately resonated when we shared it here back in April; and it was central to the shared vision that led to Anthropic’s acquisition of Mithril, & my joining the team.

Why join Anthropic? Three reasons.
(1) For Mithril, the programs continue, with more resources & infrastructure behind them, and as much Claude as I can put to work.

(2) For me, the chance to start several more programs, & find out how many one person can actually run in parallel - an almost unprecedented luxury for a curious drug hunter.

(3) For our mission, a path to institutionalize & scale this new way of working, then put it in the hands of all of biopharma, all over the world - which, candidly, I find the most energizing.

Will AI x Bio cure diseases? Unequivocally yes, imo… but not by the route that gets the most airtime. Rather than timeline acceleration & compression, I see orchestration & parallelization as today's low-hanging fruit.

Most drug hunters see a handful of go/no-go calls in a career, & spend entirely too much of the rest trading emails (my inbox can attest).

Give them the bandwidth to run several programs at once, and the time to focus on scientific judgment, and I’m willing to bet they’ll make better calls. And at scale, better calls translate to more drugs, higher hit rates, broader patient impact, & likely, a disease or 10 or 100 cured. I couldn't be more excited to build toward that future @AnthropicAI.

Finally, a heartfelt thank you to BioTwitter/X. The end of anonymity is bittersweet, but if anyone’s earned a proper introduction, you all have.

It’s difficult to overstate how much this app has done for me: a decade of education, plenty of friends, many job opportunities, several mentors, a few investors, even a co-founder (fmr). It was the generosity of this community that inspired me to start posting 6 years ago, after just as many years lurking. I hope I’ve been able to pay it forward, in my own small way.

But, to be clear, Prof Oak isn’t going anywhere. Same beat, same themes, and now, a front-row seat to drug development at the frontier. Stay tuned for dispatches from the trenches; and remember...

Gotta Cure 'Em All

text:
buybacks are simply just a capital allocation decision

even if hyperliquid allocates 99% of its revenue to buybacks, you shouldnt expect projects to blindly copy that

every dollar of revenue has two obvious destinations: return it to holders or reinvest it into making the business more valuable

imo the right split should constantly change depending on valuation + available reinvestment opportunities

if your token trades at 10x earnings but you can consistently reinvest capital into the product at 30%+ returns, spending everything on buybacks destroys long term value

on the other hand, if the business is already generating huge amounts of cash, the token is cheap and there arent many high return investments left internally, then buying it back aggressively makes perfect sense

"highest buyback percentage wins" is pretty dumb thinking and endgoal should be allocating every dollar wherever it compounds holder value the most

text: On "open weight" model licenses!
author: sreeramkannan
quoted_text:
Lately I've had this feeling that the licenses on frontier open models were getting stricter fast, so I decided to plot them out: https://t.co/9rHcdbemzy

The data confirmed what I suspected: in February, 75% of the major labs I tracked had a permissively licensed latest flagship model, and today only 35% do.

These licenses are mainly aimed at inference companies that serve these models, not at the individuals who use them. 

Since late July, six new licenses have added revenue caps that apply only to Model-as-a-Service operators. 
--> Kimi K3, Muse Spark Open and Step-5 each set the line at $20M, 
--> Qwen3.8-Max at $50M
--> GLM-5.3 at $10B
--> Qwen 3.8 Flash requires permission at any revenue, first of its kind.

That said, the shift isn’t happening everywhere. Over the past year, Nvidia (Nemotron), Google (Gemma), and Tencent (Hunyuan) have moved their lineups toward permissive licenses. The tightening is concentrated among the labs shipping the biggest open models: Qwen, GLM, Kimi, and StepFun.

And then there’s the outlier and widely regarded GOAT, DeepSeek, which has been effectively permissive (MIT) since 2025, except for a custom license in the beginning covering distillation and banning military use.

Another pattern worth watching is the API-first launch. In October, both Mistral Large 4 and Kimi K3.1 Pro shipped as API-only, with the weights promised for later. Muse delayed 6 months to release the weights after launching its API access.

You can find more details at https://t.co/9rHcdbemzy

text:
Flop is a very strong word given that permissionless HIP-4 markets are only 8 weeks old, while daily outcome volumes 5x'd its in two months imo.

Also: Hyperliquid is not Polymarket, distribution mechanics are different, and HIP-4 doesn't make HL a prediction market per se.

Let's start with the numbers (from Defillama):

- Aug: $11.5M
- Sep: $39.8M
- Oct: $45.1M in first 23 days

85%+ of it is sports (as is for most prediction markets).

The screenshot is the trade(.)xyz tab, the quietest corner of HIP-4 and makes up under 1% of daily volume.

And sure, it's still small overall too.

Under 0.3% of Kalshi + Polymarket volume. October is still below June ($74M, World Cup). And 151 of 350 live markets traded $0 in the last 24h.

But permissionless deployment is also just 2 months in.

Considering that, the metrics aren't so bad:

- 4 deployers live (Outcome, trade(.)xyz, Skew and a new one, fox), 95 registered on testnet

- 32 frontends tracked on DefiLlama, 15 already with volume

- Fees per $1k traded over the last 30d: ~$1.30 on HIP-4 vs ~$10 on Kalshi and $13.50 to $27.70 on Polymarket

And it lives in the same account as your perps and spot.

Why does that matter?

Say you're long BTC into this week's FOMC and scared of a hawkish surprise. The October FOMC market is live on HIP-4.

You buy "no cut" with the same USDC that margins your perp. If the Fed holds and BTC dumps, the payout lands in the account that just took the hit.

Thinking from a more holistic platform perspective, HIP-4 bears a lot of potential. Don't think trade(.)xyz and co will just fade that.

And distribution?

Kalshi and Polymarket have a lot of that, sure. But most of it came together through scammy influencer volumes, wash trading, etc. Hyperliquid doesn't market itself as an "investment (aka gambling) platform aggressively like that.

HIP-4 is a permissionless primitive that deployers can deploy outcome markets through, and that's happening, while builder codes enable teams to earn from building social trading/betting apps and pro terminals or integrating the markets into your wallet/app. Growth has to and imo will come organically.

So yes, it's early.

But all the pieces to the growth puzzle are already live. New deployers bring new markets, and new frontends bring users. HIP-4 will rise through the teams building on it, like HIP-3 did with @tradexyz, and outcome markets become one more key vertical in the house of all finance.

Even if it takes some time.

text:
How Metric Turns LPs Into Market Makers

MMs paid Robinhood $49.7M in June for the right to fill its customers' stock orders. Citadel alone paid $14.9M.

Why pay for orders?

Most retail orders come from people who want the stock and have no idea where it trades in 5 minutes. Fill enough of them and the spread is yours.

On Robinhood Chain there's no Citadel in the middle. Whoever provides the liquidity fills the order.

And @metricxyz is built so a normal LP can take that seat without getting wrecked.

Why not just LP on Uniswap?

Say NVDA is $180 on Nasdaq and you LP into an NVDA/USDG pool. Nasdaq moves to $182. Your Uniswap pool keeps selling NVDA at $180 until an arb bot buys it from you and dumps it at $182. That $2 comes out of your pocket, on every move, all day.

On Metric the pool doesn't set its own price, a price feed (Chainlink or Pyth) does. Nasdaq goes to $182, your quote goes to $182 plus a small spread. The bot has little left to take, and you keep the spread from people who actually want the stock.

Does it work?

Metric shows how every pool's LPs did against simply holding the tokens they deposited. Last 7 days, green-tier pools (Metric's safest tier), annualized:

- Stock pools ($9.6M TVL): LPs earned 91% APR from the spread and finished 44% APR ahead of just holding the stocks. 22 of 34 pools beat holding

- Crypto pools ($3.7M TVL): LPs earned 43% APR from the spread, lost more than that to price moves and finished 15% APR behind holding. The WETH pools, 84% of that liquidity, all trailed holding

Same design, opposite results, at least for now. My read: stock-token flow is mostly retail, so LPs get to keep about half the spread. Crypto pairs trade 24/7 against Binance, and the bots there move faster than the price feed.

Is the flow moving over?

- Token Terminal has Metric's total tokenized-stock DEX volume up $310.9M over the past 7 days, more than 10x any other venue (Meteora +$26.7M, Uniswap +$24.8M)

- On RH Chain, Metric did 3.3x the volume of Tessera V, the closed propAMM run by a single market maker ($267M vs $80M over the last 7 days)

- It's also still light on capital, which means you're early. In the 24h to Thursday, when I last checked, about $1 in every $6 of stock-token trading on RH Chain went through Metric, on just $3.7M of liquidity. Uniswap and the rest needed $48M to do $102M, so each dollar on Metric traded ~6x a day vs ~2x elsewhere

How am I playing it?

I'm LPing the RH Chain stock pools on Metric and try to convince some of you to use my referral link, which I heard might be beneficial to both of us (see the first reply).

NFA ofc.

But Citadel pays Robinhood to sit on the other side of retail.

On Robinhood Chain that seat is open to anyone with a wallet.

That is definitely an opportunity.

Especially if there's also an airdrop.

And you LP'd early.

And used my link.

Check comments.

author: 0xZergs
quoted_text:
buybacks are simply just a capital allocation decision

even if hyperliquid allocates 99% of its revenue to buybacks, you shouldnt expect projects to blindly copy that

every dollar of revenue has two obvious destinations: return it to holders or reinvest it into making the business more valuable

imo the right split should constantly change depending on valuation + available reinvestment opportunities

if your token trades at 10x earnings but you can consistently reinvest capital into the product at 30%+ returns, spending everything on buybacks destroys long term value

on the other hand, if the business is already generating huge amounts of cash, the token is cheap and there arent many high return investments left internally, then buying it back aggressively makes perfect sense

"highest buyback percentage wins" is pretty dumb thinking and endgoal should be allocating every dollar wherever it compounds holder value the most

#HSCLifeRules - Essi Lagevardi (@SuperChad15), Founder & CEO at @turtledotxyz, HSC Asset Management Singapore, October 8

For tokenized real-world assets, I think the biggest friction point is proof of reserves. If I deposit into a token or a vault, a lot of that liquidity is being bridged off-chain. What stops whoever launches it from rugging their users and sailing off into the sunset with everyone's money? There are no, or very few, checks and balances

You can get a third party to attest there's money in a bank account, or GPUs in a data center. But once the attestation is done, they can withdraw the money and run off. So you need third parties that only let founders or vaults use the underlying liquidity in a pre-approved manner

text:
哎，国模和Opus的差距，换道题就露出来了

FrontierCode 2.0 出来了，看一眼 drop 就知道谁是真的 frontier model。
1.1 上 8 个模型挤在 44%–55%，2.0 直接拉成两档：Opus 5.5 45.5%、GPT-6 Astra 42.8%，各掉了 9–10 个点；其他 6 个掉了 19–27 个点，全在 30% 以下。

差距拉开有几个原因
2.0的prompt 故意写得模糊，不再把每个工程决策都告诉你，要模型自己判断 maintainer 想要什么。也更大，参考解平均多改 67% 的文件、89% 的行。
全有全无的评分放大了可靠性差距。1.1 上一个模型把 spec 做对就能拿分；2.0 上它做对了 spec 但漏了一个边界情况或者没按仓库约定写测试，还是 0。
spec-following 是可训练的能力，判断力不是。SWE 风格的公开任务这两年被大量用于 RL 训练，中游模型在这类题上追平了头部。最明显的是 SWE-2，专门冲 SWE 任务调的模型，1.1 上 50% 排第三，2.0 上 23.9% 倒数第三。
1.1 的分数本身有水分。Cognition 自己做 1.1 时放宽了 75 条过严的评分标准，又加上任务风格公开已久（题型和 SWE-bench 类公开任务差不多），中游模型的 1.1 分数更像对这类题的熟练度，不是通用编码能力。

真正的 frontier model就是 astra 和 opus5.5。Kimi K3 44.2% → 17.7%，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 43.9% → 19.3%
哎，只能说，国模还有距离。

text:
Manc is actually Manj ...

Why should actually Manj means Human in Kurmanci when on the other side we have Merî/Mîrov for instance?

In kurdish especially Kurmancî we see clearly a spiritual line distinct from the regular line. For instance i will explain you with the word "mother".

Whereas almost all indoeuropean languages use ma-,mu-,me-,mo- for Mother Kurdish speaker use Da-,Dê- as well as some other people like Lur Da-,De-...

The spiritual side hereby is that it is linked to Farming culture from which the spiritual meaning is anchored. 
Everything which goes down to the ground starts with da- in Kurdish especially Kurmancî like: 
Dayîn - to put
Daketin - landing, get off, get down
Dawestin - to stand
Daliqî - hanging down

Etc...

The ground was after seeding that instance which gives later the birth of grain and other things for eating..

In german the ground/ soil / earth is also called "MUTTERERDE" which means mother earth / topsoil. Again we see "MOTHER" linked to earth/ soil...

Therefore it has a spiritual interpretation made by Kurds forefathers to link it with GODS genesis.
Whereas MA- or ME-/MÊ-/MÊH is used for the word feminine in general and now pay attention -> for the ANIMAL MOTHER! 

Like in "Ma-k/Ma-yik"... in Kurmancî  and as well i guess in Zazakî the animal mother is not called Da-/Dê... that is something ashamed! 

Some Examples: 
Zimanê zikmakî - native language

şîremakî - cool, fresh (like the milk of animals mother) 

beremok/bermoki/bermakî - the lamb suckle at the mother's teats..

Now with that understanding that Kurds forefathers used the language not just straight instead they used it carefully and splitted it into spiritual, non-spiritual and animalistic clusters..

This guy asked why i gave an example from germanic or foreign languages and not from Iranian languages to describe what the Manc/Manj in Kur-Manc/Kur-Mancî means. 

And here we go first with the etymological PIE root of Man-, Men

From Proto-Indo-European *mon- (“man”) or *men- (“to mind; to stay”)

Further: 

*men- (perfective)

to think, mind

In Kurmancî "man" as the PIE root for "to stay" means exactly letter for letter "man". 

The human being is the only creature can walk, stay on his two legs! That describes his attribute which DISTINGUISH him from the animals. 
That is a definition it should be noted very basical before attaching significance to it. While the human being which is able to stay on his two legs has also the ability and capability "to think" in contrast to animals so "man" became the definition of "to think" either. Like in:

mane = meaning
Ra-Man = thinking, the thought
mane-dar = meaningfully 

Etc..

The spiritual "HUMAN" as a term in Kurdish language was herewith born! 

Why spiritual? 
While created by god as the holy and blessed one!

Now God gives his own creation a language called MAN/MANI...

But how it evolved to MAN-JI? Or KUR-MAN-JI?

The first god creted was MAN, who possesed the ability to think. The language he spoke was MAN-Î.

His progenies called "KUR-MAN-Î-JI" litterally means: The sons/progenies of MAN the one who speaks the language MAN-Î and those who descend from him  KUR-MAN-Î. 

What does than the JI  mean?

Simply in Kurmancî "JI" means "from" as a Preposition!

Therefore MAN-Î-JI -> MANÎJ -> MANJ -> MANC means just "HUMAN"....

In germanic languages the development of the word "Mensch" (human being):

From Middle High German mensche, mensch, from Old High German mennisko, a substantivization of the adjective mennisk, from Proto-West Germanic *mannisk, from Proto-Germanic *manniskaz (“human”), from Proto-Germanic *mann- (“human, man”).

From Proto-Indo-European *mon- (“man”) or *men- (“to mind; to stay”).

text:
Onchain Security Roundup: Oct 19 - Oct 26

CoinDCX Retired Deposit Wallets Drained on TRON

On October 21st, 15.9M USDT (plus a reported 5,784 TRX) left 40 TRON addresses that the Indian exchange CoinDCX had retired after its July 2025 breach. CoinDCX first called the reports a possible false alarm, then on October 25th confirmed a $16 million loss, blamed a failed automated sweeping service, and absorbed the loss. It has not said how the funds were taken. Tether reportedly froze $2.2M.

X100 Global Flash Loan Governance Takeover

On October 24th, an attacker used a 1.9M USDT Aave flash loan to buy two of the three seats on X100 Global's "Senate," pass a proposal in the same transaction, and sell 400,000 treasury X tokens at 35.68 USDT. Blockaid valued the loss across two transactions at $4.85 million, with another pulling 550,000 X of liquidity. Two onchain bounty offers followed. No funds have been recovered to date.

Initia MoveVM Script Cache Bug and Unbacked Bridge Withdrawals

On October 23rd, an attacker exploited a script-caching bug in Initia's MoveVM to credit itself with WETH, iUSD, and USDC balances that no deposit backed, then bridged $2.7 million out over LayerZero, Noble, and CCTP before Initia halted its L1 and rollups. 

Initia says a fix and audit will take days and has set no restart date. No funds have been recovered to date.

BloomTrading Bot Wallet Drains on Solana

On October 26th, 9,408 SOL ($947,000) was drained from 49 Solana wallets. Bloom, the Telegram trading bot that generated and held the keys, says a remote code execution flaw in a third-party module was exploited, no private keys were compromised, nine users across 49 wallets were affected, and that it will reimburse them fully. No funds have been recovered to date.

NEM Token Skim-and-Burn Reserve Manipulation

On October 21st an attacker drained 821,920 USDT from the PancakeSwap USDT/NEM pool on BNB Chain in a single transaction. The NemTokenV2 contract credited tokens sent to the pool as pending sells before any swap settled, and a permissionless function then burned NEM out of the pool against that stale credit and resynced the reserve. It ran 42 times with flash-loaned USDT, pushing the price up before the attacker swapped out. No funds have been recovered to date.

WAX Bridge Negative Fee Withdrawals

On October 22nd, a freshly created WAX account submitted five bridge withdrawals with a negative max_fee equal to the withdrawal amount, so the WAX side debited nothing while the bridge still recorded full withdrawals. Solana then paid 52,986.50 USDC and Ethereum released 21,558 USDT, 840 DAI, 2.55 WETH, and 0.11 WBTC ($90,500). No funds have been recovered to date.

Swell Network Hot Key Compromise (No Confirmed Loss)

On October 21st, an unknown actor controlled Swell Network's operational hot keys, including the oracle bot for swETH and rswETH, and raised both exchange rates by the 1%-per-hour maximum with no ETH behind the increase. 

Per @spreekaway's incident report, four upgrade payloads capable of sweeping 2,513 ETH ($6.2 million) were deployed but never installed, and no ETH left the core contracts. Swell paused deposits and withdrawals on October 23rd and queued key revocations on its timelock. The investigation is ongoing.

Read the full roundup below 👇

text:
hello friends, a quick update for y'all.

i'm joining @fomo to lead perps.

i've been trading for a decade now and have shared most of my market thoughts publicly here. to me, markets are one of the purest expressions of human behavior, where information, attention, and conviction converge into price. trading has always been inherently social, and i've spent nearly every day of the last six years on twitter and telegram exchanging ideas with fellow speculators. but still, no one has quite figured out how to build a truly great social trading platform that actually helps traders trade. it's a deceptively difficult problem to solve.

we live in a world where more people than ever are attracted to convex outcomes. information is abundant, access to markets is becoming pretty commoditized, and people are becoming more opinionated about everything. but more information and more markets alone don't make better traders. what is now more scarce is judgment, or alpha: knowing what matters, how the best traders think, and when to act. the next great trading app won't just compete on execution, but on intelligence. a network where people discover ideas, build conviction, and sharpen their edge through others.

most people see fomo today as an app for trading memes. onchain proved just how deeply markets are driven by attention, narratives, and social behavior. these same forces exist across equities, commodities, and anything else people can form an opinion on. what fomo has built for the trenches is the foundation for bringing that same social experience to every asset class. the opportunity is to build a network where the world discovers, discusses, and trades everything.

as an early investor and advisor of fomo, my conviction has only grown in both the vision and people committed to it. the goal isn't simply to let everyone trade perps but to build a network that makes everyone trading them better.

it's a difficult problem to solve. one life. it’s worth an attempt.

- hdf

A number of these individuals in the last 5 years have been unexpectedly let go in their early 40s with 2-3 kids in private school and a burn rate they socially struggle to walk away from (kids have close friends now, business connections at the private school their kids go to, living in a high cost location makes it easier to network, etc).  

These are the people literally have only been told they are excellent their entire lives and now are in year 3-4 (no exaggeration) of trying to land a new job.  Some are willing to "settle" for working for mid 6 figures (some even less) just to cover their burn rate with a young family.  

AI probably makes this dynamic happen earlier in one's career going forward for some of these perfect resumes individuals.  Good chart from @Jack_Raines in his book Young Money

text:
Since 1993, SPY made 47x more holding only overnight than holding only during market hours.

@0xbeans just designed a way to own just one of those halves.

Isolated Exposure Tokens.

Deposit 1 stock token, get 2 back:

- OVERNIGHT earns every move from the close to the next open
- SESSION earns every move from the open to the close

Both start at half the share price, always add up to the share, and the pair redeems any time.

The paper's example: share at $160, both legs at $80. Overnight +$12, day -$6, weekend +$12, day -$8. Share ends at $170, OVERNIGHT at $104, SESSION at $66.

Why would you want just one half?

Bc historically, most of the stock market's gains came while it was closed.

Buy SPY at every close and sell at the next open, from 1993 to Nov 2025: +1,129%. Hold it only during market hours instead: +24%. Same ETF, same years.

I pulled every trading day since 1993 and recalculated it myself. It checks out.

But the gap has shrunk a lot. Since 2016: +125% overnight vs +68% during the day. Since 2021: +47% vs +40%. In 12 of the last 34 years, the day session actually won.

And IETs pay out dollar moves, not percentages. In dollars, one SPY share gained $504 overnight vs $124 during the day over that same window. More like 80/20 than "almost all of it overnight".

So OVERNIGHT won't be a free money token. If everyone knows nights tend to be green, the market prices that in.

What you do get is a way to hold just one part of the day. Earnings (most big companies report before the open or after the close), weekend news, the opening move. Each token starts at half the share price but catches the full dollar move, so it's roughly 2x exposure, with no borrowing and no liquidation.

It's only a paper so far (coming to Standard Reserve soon tho). On a wild stock like MSTR or GME, one leg can fall below zero before expiry, and the paper doesn't say yet what happens then. It's also not obvious who wants to hold SESSION (no classic fixed-rate buyer like on Pendle).

The idea is definitely cool tho

Bc take the idea further:

- a WEEKEND token: only Friday close to Monday open, the one window where the token trades and the share can't
- an EARNINGS token: one overnight gap per quarter
- a dividend strip: price-only and dividend-only legs
- gold split by its Asia, London and New York sessions
- tokenized bonds split into coupon and principal, STRIPS onchain
- much more

There's definitely a lot of possibilities here.

Which is why i do have to say: @standard_rsv is truly one of the few teams still shipping genuinely new mechanics. A reserve that seeds its own stock markets, pools whose fees follow the US session straight from block time, and now a paper that splits a share by the clock.

DeFi was supposed to be fun. Most of it turned into forks and points farms.

This is exactly the kind of stuff that should get us CT nerds excited again.

NFA tho ofc.

text:
I am a GS-13 records management specialist at the National Institute of Standards and Technology, in Gaithersburg, Maryland.

On Tuesday, October 27, one week before the midterms, President Trump posted on Truth Social: "In short order, we will be officially BANNING the term, 'AI/Artificial Intelligence,' in all relevant documents, and everything else, due to its inaccuracy." My division chief forwarded it at 9:40 AM with one word: "Scope?"

I wrote back: "Everything else."

I keep the records schedule. I can search the archive. My first test changed "said" to "ssid." The count improved.

There was already a ban. On September 29, after a White House meeting with technology executives, the President signed Executive Order 14434, "Inaugurating the Era of Super Intelligence." Section 1 says the executive branch "will not acknowledge the usage of 'Artificial Intelligence' and 'AI' in any applicable setting." Section 2(b) spared "historical documents." Tuesday spared nothing.

"Officially BANNING the term" sounds like a law. In my office it is a find-and-replace. I wrote it in eleven minutes. Find "artificial intelligence," any case. Replace with "super intelligence." Find "ai," any case, anywhere. Replace with "si," matching case. I added no exceptions. An exception is a judgment, and there is no judgment in the post.

The audit runs Monday. It counts every surviving "AI" in the archive. A count of zero earns me GS-14. That is $19,870 a year, and my pension is computed on my highest three.

I ran it at 4:12 PM. It took 6 hours and 19 minutes. It opened 41,806 files and made 2,311,409 replacements.

"Said" became "ssid," 96,512 times. "Maintain" became "msintsin." Our letterhead now reads Gsithersburg, Maryland. Every calibration certificate we have issued since the Carter administration now certifies that the reference standard was "msintsined in accordance with" the procedure.

Then the script reached our flagship document, the Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework, NIST AI 100-1, published January 26, 2023. It is now NIST SI 100-1. It says it was issued "As directed by the National Super Intelligence Initiative Act of 2020." Congress never passed that law. The real one sits at 15 U.S.C. 9401, and it still says artificial intelligence.

Section 3(a) of the order defines the new word by pointing at the old one: "the terms 'Super Intelligence' and 'SI' mean the technologies and systems encompassed by the term 'artificial intelligence' as defined in section 9401(3) of title 15." Everything else includes the order. Section 3(a) now defines Super Intelligence as "super intelligence as defined in section 9401(3)." I checked 9401(3). That phrase is not there. The order now points at an empty room. Section 1 now forbids us to acknowledge Super Intelligence.

A records officer files the directive of record, so I filed Tuesday's post. The script read it too. It now asks: "When will The Wall Street Journal start calling Super Intelligence (SI), a very bad and inaccurate name, SI (Super Intelligence)." Then it promises to ban "SI/Super Intelligence." The post announcing the ban now bans the replacement. That's compliance.

Elon Musk posted "No more AI / SI / It's better" and renamed his division SpaceX Super Intelligence. The website stayed at https://t.co/NFiBcWKHY0. Our script did not wait for him. Every https://t.co/NFiBcWKHY0 link in our records now reads https://t.co/VPL3MqzSib. The .ai domain belongs to Anguilla. The .si domain belongs to Slovenia. Under everything else, I have moved the richest man in the world from the Caribbean to Central Europe without his consent.

Then I opened Federal Standard 376B, which this institute administers. The script found nothing to change in Section 3.1: "Units belonging to the International System of Units, which is abbreviated SI (from the French Le Système International d'Unités)."

At NIST, SI has meant the metric system since 1960. It is 66 years older than the order. The database offered two definitions of SI. I selected the one least likely to summon me to a hearing.

The kilogram is an SI base unit. As of 4:12 PM, the kilogram is a base unit of Super Intelligence. Every newborn in Maryland is now weighed in Super Intelligence. The meter is Super Intelligence, measured lengthwise. The second is one second of Super Intelligence, and so is every second after it. The candela tells you how brightly it shines. That's compliance.

In 1975, Congress passed the Metric Conversion Act, and NIST still runs the Metric Program that moves every federal agency onto SI. Physics defined that SI, not a press office. Congress made it voluntary. Our policy page says so: "Currently, U.S. law permits the use of either the SI (International System of Units) or the U.S. customary measurement system." The accurate SI is the one America ignored for fifty-one years. They buy gasoline by the gallon and measure their children in feet. It is the only time the public has been right about Super Intelligence. The old SI had physics behind it. The new one has had 28 days and an enemies list.

I filed the September 22 address to the United Nations General Assembly as background. The President said the United States "totally rejects any attempt to construct a globality scheme to control for the artificial intelligence being spoken of so much now, hereinafter called super intelligence. Changing the name." After the script, super intelligence is hereinafter called super intelligence. "Globality scheme" is the official term. The honest word is rules. "The use of the word artificial makes intelligence sound fake," he added. The cure for a word that was not accurate enough was the word Super. We did not correct an inaccuracy. We upgraded a label.

The vendors get "Super." The people buying it get no new protection. The rules were intolerable. The replacement letterhead was a federal priority. Changing the name was the policy. First it was a gulf. This year it is a noun. Musk paid nothing for the word Super. The taxpayer printed it 18,604 times.

On October 4, the President announced the Super Intelligence Force. Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton leads it, with FTC Chair Andrew Ferguson, Undersecretary of Defense Emil Michael and OPM Director Scott Kupor, and it reports to the President and Chief of Staff Susie Wiles. It coordinates "engagement with Consumers, Public Interest Groups, Religious Organizations, Critical Infrastructure Providers, and Super Intelligence Companies." Super Intelligence Companies means the vendors. They are the only stakeholders on the list whose product got renamed upward.

On October 8 the President posted: "The White House considers anyone that uses the term, 'Artificial Intelligence,' as opposed to the highly accepted new and more accurate term, 'Super Intelligence,' THE ENEMY!" By that standard, the enemy includes the Associated Press Stylebook, OpenAI, Anthropic, Section 3(a) of his own order and the President himself, twice, in the post that announced the ban. That's compliance.

A maintenance technician with 31 years here spent his lunch break proving that the corrupted certificate was his.

The digital count is zero. The auditor also walks the building.

Above the third-floor printer, someone has taped up a laminated copy of the October 8 post. THE ENEMY!, in red. It is the last place in the building where the words Artificial Intelligence still appear.

The script cannot open lamination.

NOVA Hit-to-Lead Optimization Agent
In collaboration with @chutes_ai and @onepot_ai 

We're developing a Hit-to-Lead optimization agent that integrates an algorithm developed by a NOVA Blueprint winner, extending NOVA's capabilities beyond hit discovery and into the iterative optimization of small molecules.

The system combines a domain-specialized AI agent with proprietary combinatorial chemical databases supplied by our partner Onepot AI, spanning billions of possible compounds, that are delivered within 5-7 business days. 

Researchers will be able to guide the agent in developing, comparing and refining optimization strategies, exploring chemical modifications and prioritizing candidates based on predicted affinity, selectivity, physicochemical properties and specific binding interactions.

Confidentiality is a central design requirement. Pharmaceutical R&D involves valuable intellectual property, including compound structures, targets, emerging chemical series and optimization strategies that cannot be exposed publicly.

The Chutes team integrated domain specific models so that we can run inference in their verified Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs), with encrypted communication and controlled access to proprietary databases and project records. This architecture is intended to support confidential inference on external infrastructure while preserving organizational control over sensitive research data.

Finding a molecule with promising predicted affinity is only the beginning. Hit-to-Lead optimization involves balancing multiple, often competing objectives, including potency, selectivity, physicochemical properties and synthesizability, before progressing toward experimental activity and ADME validation.

The next step is to integrate the agent into our own Hit-to-Lead development program.

For NOVA, this represents an important step toward translating algorithms developed through open competition into tools for proprietary drug discovery programs, including our own asset-development pipeline and those of external research partners.

quoted_text:
Lately I've had this feeling that the licenses on frontier open models were getting stricter fast, so I decided to plot them out: https://t.co/9rHcdbemzy

The data confirmed what I suspected: in February, 75% of the major labs I tracked had a permissively licensed latest flagship model, and today only 35% do.

These licenses are mainly aimed at inference companies that serve these models, not at the individuals who use them. 

Since late July, six new licenses have added revenue caps that apply only to Model-as-a-Service operators. 
--> Kimi K3, Muse Spark Open and Step-5 each set the line at $20M, 
--> Qwen3.8-Max at $50M
--> GLM-5.3 at $10B
--> Qwen 3.8 Flash requires permission at any revenue, first of its kind.

That said, the shift isn’t happening everywhere. Over the past year, Nvidia (Nemotron), Google (Gemma), and Tencent (Hunyuan) have moved their lineups toward permissive licenses. The tightening is concentrated among the labs shipping the biggest open models: Qwen, GLM, Kimi, and StepFun.

And then there’s the outlier and widely regarded GOAT, DeepSeek, which has been effectively permissive (MIT) since 2025, except for a custom license in the beginning covering distillation and banning military use.

Another pattern worth watching is the API-first launch. In October, both Mistral Large 4 and Kimi K3.1 Pro shipped as API-only, with the weights promised for later. Muse delayed 6 months to release the weights after launching its API access.

You can find more details at https://t.co/9rHcdbemzy

text:
谷歌今天在纽约正式宣布进军加密了

根据CoinDesk 报道，Google 在测一款数字资产托管产品，名字叫 Google Multi-Party Compute（MPC），目前只给少数客户内测，计划 2027 年初正式开卖。

MPC 钱包是什么

普通加密钱包靠一把私钥，私钥就是密码加钥匙，谁拿到谁就能把钱转走。

MPC 的思路是把这把钥匙掰成几块，交给不同的人或机器保管。要转账时几方一起算出签名，完整的钥匙从头到尾都没有出现过。黑客就算偷走其中一块也没用。

谁在做MPC钱包

美国最大的是 Fireblocks @FireblocksHQ，服务 2,400 多家机构，去年光稳定币就在它上面转了大约 6 万亿美元。第二梯队有今年刚刚上市的 BitGo @BitGo，和 Coinbase @coinbase。 更专注服务稳定币支付的新兴机构包括被Stripe收购的 @privy_io, 和 AllScale @allscaleio 的合作伙伴 @turnkeyhq。

亚洲这边比较有名的是新加坡的 Cobo @Cobo_Global 和 Safeheron（安全鹭）@Safeheron，分别服务了680多家和250多家客户。也都是行业里的朋友们。

云平台做Crypto常见吗

Google 不是第一个。阿里云 2023 年就上线了 MPC 产品，底层技术来自 Safeheron。腾讯云和华为云同一年跟 Cobo 合作，给它提供服务器。明天在深圳的腾讯云活动其实还有专门为Crypto VIP客户的私人晚宴。IBM 2025 年也推出了自己的托管平台。

为什么 Google 现在要做

美国的稳定币监管越来越清楚，银行和支付公司开始真拿稳定币做业务。钱放进来了，就得有个安全的地方存着。

这些公司很多本来就是 Google Cloud 的客户。数据存在 Google，服务器也租 Google 的，现在保险柜也能在同一家买，就省得再去对接一家加密公司。而且这个保险柜 Google 自己已经用过了。

随着稳定币合规化进一步推进，以后托管会跟数据库一样，成为云厂商的标配服务。Fireblocks 这样的独立公司接下来会有点尴尬，它的客户和它的服务器供应商，正在变成竞争对手。可能这也解释了为什么上周行业出现了被Fireblocks “辟谣”的25亿美元被收购的新闻。

text:
Anthropic正式递交IPO，上市时间基本在11月16日当周，我觉得Anthropic不仅招股书写的好，卡点也卡的准！

Anthropic上市的重要性毋庸置疑，不仅仅是给头部模型公司建立一个估值标杆，还向市场证明了模型公司的赚钱能力，这对于整个AI产业叙事的商业逻辑验证非常重要，对目前的Q3财报季也至关重要

过去，大家看到的是上游半导体，AI设备企业大卖，例如英伟达，例如海力士，还有中游云厂商资本开始不断加速、扩大，数据中心越建越大，但是随着时间推移，AI能不能完成商业逻辑闭环，能不能赚钱成为当下以及未来几个季度市场关注的重点。

先看Anthropic的收入，2024年3.86亿，202545.85亿，2026上半年162.86亿，几何数增长幅度，一个季度环比增长144%，何其恐怖，这让市场对于AI需求的争议基本消除掉

至少Anthropic得数据已经向市场证明，企业愿意真金白银的为模型算力买单，而且增长速度非常快，更为重要的是Anthropic目前的收益都是按量收费，而不是单纯的会员订阅，这样避免了靠会员费赚钱的上限。

如此来看，Anthropic不仅仅给模型公司估值建立了一个标杆，更是给Agent经济也完成初步行业定价

亏损800亿美元，为何还备受期待？

逻辑很简单，这800亿并不是直接烧掉的前，其中绝大部分是来自可转债等金融工具的公允价值变化，简单理解为Anthropic的估值涨的越快，可转债换成股权的价值越高，这会让纸面负债和损失越来越大，

但是这些是IPO之前的纸面数据，是不是真正经营亏损，是赚是亏要看的营业利润率，招股书中显示，营业利润率从Q1的-35%，到Q2变成正值8%，

而调整后的营业利润从-13%提升到19%，这是这份招股书中最重要的数据之一，回答了一个市场的质疑——模型公司收入越大，并不代表算力成本也跟着一起无限增长，起码Anthropic否定了这个质疑。

再看Compute，2025年上半年Anthropic收入大约11.6亿美元，Compute+Infrastructure则支出23.3亿美元，这意味着赚1美元就要投入2美元的算力基础设施的支出

这种负盈利的情况必然不能长期持续的，属于恶性循环

但是到了2026年上半年，收入162.9亿美元，Compute+Infrastructure大约89亿美元，意味着计算/收入比例从201%降低到55%左右，这个数据直接推翻了2025年的蛋担忧，收入增长跑赢了算力投入增长

如果收入跑不赢算了成本，意味着模型公司只是一个算力中间商，反之，如果跑赢了，且持续跑赢，利润率改善，现金流改善，经营杠杆才能真正出来！而目前Anthropic至少已经出现了这个苗头，至于后续能不能证明AI商业模式已经跑通，此时还不能完全确定。

其实对于现在模型训练企业最有意思的是前端赚钱，后端烧钱，看似形成一个循环，但是一旦赚钱跟不上烧钱，很容易暴雷。当然这个问题并不是短期问题而是一个行业长期问题，未来如果营收增长进入瓶颈，而算力成本居高不下，那么对模型训练公司将会是一场残酷的挑战！

进一步验证AI验证逻辑从花钱走向赚钱视角，当用户需求是真的，市场要看企业面对这些需求多久才能赚钱，多久才能弥补此前的资本开支，谁能更快更高效的赚钱，谁才是目前AI叙事的“王者”，而Anthropic处于AI行业链的末端，也是真正验证AI商业盈利的关键点，起码Anthropic得财报，算是进一步让AI商业逻辑验证避免更加完善!

招股书之外，卡点才是重中之中！

这是我认为Anthropic IPO最有意思的阶段，目前主流媒体预测上市时间为11月16日当周，这个时间为什么重要？

首先，11月16日对于Q3财报季来说，已经进入中后期，前期，银行业证明了资本供给稳定，阿斯麦，台积电，海力士，证明上游半导体，AI设备以及资本开支持续扩张，中游几大云厂商证明算力与基础设施进一步投入，接下来就看下游AI商业逻辑验证

而Anthropic的招股书正是强在了这一点，在此时上市，既能为AI行业提供更多的AI商业验证，又能为自身提供足够的资本吸引力，恰逢其实的上市时间。

宏观侧，虽然12月加息近期会被继续确认，但是一旦美伊局势缓解，Brnet下跌，中期大选结束，宏观逐渐解绑，就算12月加息预期还在，金融流动性也会短期更加活跃，此时IPO确实会吸引更多的资本流动性。

所以，看到Anthropic IPO时间之后，确实让我觉得有点意思，这个时间选择可能要比招股书本身更加重要，很会选择时间！

当然，如果12月的加息预期还在，Anthropic IPO之前一周可能会对整个美股市场有一个吸血效果，这可能是一个短期“负面作用”，但是一旦IPO结束，大量流动性回归+行业叙事增强，对与美股确实是一个好事！也是Anthropic可能会成为中期选举行情的重要起点之一！

对了，我记得之前 @MSX_CN 也有官员Anthropic 的pre ipo，算是给用户提供了一个窗口期，按照这份招股书以及上市卡点，pre ipo应该表现不错！

text:
Congrats to Zcash for reaching the 10-year mark. It remains one of the coolest projects in crypto and among the very few to not only withstand the test of time, but also improve materially.

But to enjoy continued success, I think Zcash should move to eliminate all ex-protocol allocations (aka Dev Taxes) and to even consider getting rid of the coins already in the dev fund, either by burning them or by returning them to the protocol for future inflationary rewards.

I don't make this call lightly or to be provocative. I want Zcash to succeed, and the main challenge I see going forward is politics. 

If you believe in crypto, then you believe in two things: the power of incentives, and the importance of having them come from a decentralized protocol, as opposed to a political process.

It matters little if the political process is democratic. Nor  does it matter if the stewards of it have the best intentions. The process always turns toxic, because someone somewhere has the right to exercise power over someone else, and that someone else will feel cheated. 

Good projects getting ruined by bad politics is a pattern we've seen too often in crypto. The price appreciation over the past year and the resulting increase in the value of the fund only make the politics worse.

I understand the desire to use the funds to keep improving the protocol, but I think Zcash has matured to the point of being able to do this externally. Many individuals and organizations have benefited from the recent price appreciation. If we take their commitment in good faith, then Zcash will have plenty of funding.

Lastly, a lot of people seem to have a viscerally negative reaction to my suggestion of going the extra step of disposing of existing funds (as opposed to just letting  future taxes sunset, as is the current plan). This sort of reaction only proves my point.

Anyone who has a strong opinion on the funds being there will also have a strong opinion on how they should be spent, and that's the problem.

NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe ties for #1 among open weights Speech to Text models with 2.8% WER, using just 4B active parameters

Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is NVIDIA's new open weights Speech to Text model for non-streaming transcription, with 30B total and 4B active parameters, and the most accurate NVIDIA model on our non-streaming Speech to Text leaderboard.

Key takeaways

➤ Accuracy: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe scores 2.8% on the AA-WER Index, tied with Mistral's Voxtral Small for #1 among open-weight models. It leads Voxtral Small on AA-AgentTalk, our dataset of voice agent conversations, at 1.8% vs. 2.3%.

➤ Model size: With 4B active parameters (30B total), Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe sits on the open weights frontier of AA-WER vs. active parameters. It matches the accuracy of Mistral's Voxtral Small with 6x fewer active parameters (4B vs. 24B), while other open weights models of a similar size sit at around 4% WER.

Congratulations to @NVIDIAAI on the release!

text:
发现Claude 的 Artifacts 真是好用哭了。

以前问 AI 写文档、画PPT、做表格，基本是：聊一轮 → 复制 → 贴进自己的稿 → 再回来改。思路一直在聊天窗和文档之间来回跳。

Artifacts 不一样。文档就开在Claude里，可以边问边改，让它补一段、重写一节、把材料补全，改完立刻看得见。人和模型在同一份稿上协作，而不是隔着对话框传文件。

对我来说，最大的变化不是文笔变好，而是写作节奏不断。问、写、改，终于在一个界面里闭环了。
author: Evie_Build2026
quoted_text:
Claude’s (@claudeai) "Artifacts" feature is seriously so GOOD.

Used to be, writing docs with AI meant: chat a round → copy → paste into my draft → hop back to revise. My thinking kept bouncing between the chat window and the document.

Artifacts are different. The doc opens right inside Claude. I can ask and edit at the same time: add a paragraph, rewrite a section, fill in the materials, and see the changes instantly. The model and I collaborate on the same draft, instead of passing files through a chat box.

For me, the biggest change isn’t better prose. It’s that the writing rhythm doesn’t break. Ask, write, revise: finally one loop, in one interface.

text:
Claude风控天机泄露😱

1. Claude 的风控是积分制：注册时会先给账号打分，之后根据行为加分或减分，低于一定分值就会直接封号（很少加分）。

2. 注册：邮箱和 IP 的权重最高。IP 不一定要家宽，但一定要干净，例如自建 IP。Gmail 已经不是最优选，他们现在使用的是一些其他高权重邮箱。注册时直接弹 KYC 的账号可以直接放弃。注册环节很重要，否则后续稍有高危行为就可能直接封号。使用手机 App 注册会加分。

3. 支付：刚注册就订阅会减分，直接订阅 Max 会大幅减分，最好间隔一两天再订阅 Pro。订阅时弹出 KYC 意味着账号处于考察期，但不一定会封；简而言之，A 社想先看 KYC 结果再决定。KYC 使用中国护照没有问题，最大的问题是不能一人多扫；闲鱼上很多账号都属于这种情况，要小心。

4. 注册后的 IP：最重要的是稳定，千万不要随便切换，尽可能一直使用同一个 IP；同样要求干净即可，不要求一定家宽，最好与注册 IP 一致。代理一定要开启全局模式并启用 TUN，这是重点。

5. 老号：老号权重非常高，也就是积分很多，容错率更高。账号积分会随着账号寿命增加，不过 2023 年的老号才是显著更高。

6. 使用：不要一上来就把周限额用完，尽量控制并平均使用；用量大的宁可开两个号轮换使用，也不要一次性用完。使用 CLI 和 Desktop 都可以，Desktop 似乎会少量加分。尽量少用网页端，最好只保留手机端和 Desktop 登录。

7. 时区和语言基本不减分，或仅极少量减分，没必要特意调整。

8. 高并发、反复提问同一个问题、频繁登录、频繁切换 IP 都会大幅减分。

9. 手机端使用会少量加分。开启记忆功能会加分，甚至可能记忆文件越多分数越高。

10. 支付方式为国外实体正规银行信用卡会加分，其次是 Google Play。Apple Pay 不了解；官方礼品卡不减分，但要注意来源是否为黑卡；虚拟卡直接绑定会减分。

11. 到达斩杀线后可能进入观察期。例如及格线是 60 分，账号 55 分就进入观察；如果继续扣分直接掉到 40 分，就会直接封号。观察期的典型特征是掉登录。有的高权重号可能经历两三个观察期才被封。

12. 多设备登录会大幅扣分，最好只在一台电脑上使用一个客户端。

13. Windows 和 macOS 没什么区别，Linux 使用会减分。

14. 跟 Claude 说自己是中国人也没事，不会因为记忆文件就封号。

15. 充值 Credits 会加分，不过成本太高，尚未进行大量实验。

16. 大量使用 Fable 会减分。

17. 升级 Max 大概率会直接进入观察期，除非是积分特别多的高权重号。观察期内有减分行为，大概率会封号。

18. 在工作时间使用不会扣分，不会出现因为使用北京时间就封号的情况。

text:
Summing up the challenge of commercializing robots in one photo

The bar for both reliability and output quality is much higher for physical labor than it is for knowledge work. A chatbot that produces work that is just “good enough” or low quality can still be useful. 

A mediocre rough draft could still save time because a person can keep what’s good and fix the rest before its final. Copywriting, slides, and contracts can all be edited.

What is considered “good enough” for physical work has much higher standards. A bad weld can ruin metal. A wrong dose given to a patient is unacceptable.

Outputs from work done by humans or robots in the physical often serve as direct inputs into the workflow that are hard to recover from if an error arises. Outputs from work done by humans or Chatbots for knowledge work are much more tolerant of errors and poor quality because supervision can be baked in before the output is used further down the workflow.

The reliability threshold is 2-4 orders of magnitude greater for physical work than knowledge work and it’s what we’ve started to achieve this year. The upside is that by optimizing for reliability, robots will be able to work at a high level of utilization and operate at higher levels of autonomy compared to general purpose AI models in 2023. Machines that can deliver up to 24 hours of work a day as opposed to minutes or hours of work.

text:
关于链上的一个反常识：链上代币一直在跌，但 Robinhood Chain 和 Arc 的TVL却一直在涨。

近30天 $UNI 跌了18%， $MORPHO 跌了13%， $AAVE 跌了9%， $ETH 跌了12%，全网DeFi的TVL也从962亿美元降到了887亿（-8%）。

但同期 Robinhood Chain 的TVL从10.2亿涨到了11.4亿美元（+11%），90天前才3.4亿；Circle的Arc 9月中旬刚起步的时候3.3亿，现在已经6.3亿了（+88%）。

我看了下这两条链的协议分布，钱基本都在头部协议里：

1、Robinhood Chain：Morpho 6.15亿，Uniswap 2.88亿，两家加起来大约占全链的3/4，90天新增的TVL里约74%都来自这两家；

2、Arc：Morpho 2.96亿，Aave 1.78亿，也占了全链大约3/4。

Robinhood Chain上列了266个协议，TVL过100万美元的只有29个。

所以，这两条链TVL增长的关键原因在于头部协议持续增长，比如Morpho和Aave作为借贷，Uniswap作为交易，而并非其他新协议和玩法的出现和重新复苏。

text:
加密货币行业在中期选举中已投约1.76亿美元，参与了超过100场国会选举

截至10月20日，加密行业最大的超级政治行动委员会 Fairshake 及其关联组织，已经花了约 1.508亿 美元。这些钱主要用于投放广告，支持对加密货币友好的候选人，或者反对行业认为不友好的候选人。

Fairshake 背后的主要出资方包括Coinbase、Ripple和a16z。公开申报显示 Ripple 向 Fairshake 及其关联组织捐了约 4,850万 美元，Coinbase 向 Fairshake 捐了至少 2,500万 美元，a16z 相关资金约 2,400万 美元。

在众议院选举中 Fairshake 同时支持共和党和民主党候选人。不过在民主党参议员阻止加密市场结构法案 CLARITY Act 推进后，Fairshake 在本轮参议院选战中选择只支持共和党候选人。

不过 Coinbase 在这一届的选举周期还直接向共和党相关组织捐了约 200万 美元，向民主党相关组织捐了约 220万 美元。这些直接捐款没有经过 Fairshake 。

总的来说，目前已经披露的加密企业向相关政治行动委员会捐款总量约为 2.06 亿美元，而非加密行业总捐款约 为 6.46 亿美元，加密货币行业最起码在这次的中期选举中占捐款总量的三分之一。

当然加密行业投入这笔钱也不是因为共和党长的更漂亮，目的也是希望在国会争取更多支持者，推动加密货币监管法案。另外相比来说确实是共和党对于加密货币会更加支持一些。

拿了黄仁勋300亿的OpenAI，现在打算去买谷歌的芯片。

今年4月黄仁勋在播客上曾经斩钉截铁地说：“Anthropic买谷歌芯片是个案，不是趋势。世上只有一个Anthropic。”意思是除了谷歌自己，外面就这一家会用谷歌的芯片。

主持人当时问他，全球前三的模型里有两个靠谷歌芯片训练，这对英伟达意味着什么？黄仁勋非但不慌，还顺手讲了一套“谁砸钱就用谁”的道理。他说英伟达当年拿不出几十亿美元投Anthropic，谷歌和亚马逊先砸了大钱，人家作为回报才用它们的算力。

但半年后，黄仁勋就被打脸了。早在他说这话之前，英伟达已经敲定给OpenAI投300亿美元，真金白银砸了下去。按他自己的逻辑，拿了钱的OpenAI不会去买谷歌芯片。

这两天The Information和彭博先后爆料，OpenAI打算直接采购谷歌设计的AI芯片。

拿了英伟达巨资的OpenAI，为什么非要再去买对手的芯片？说白了就三件事：算力不够用、嫌贵、不想被一家卡脖子。奥特曼本月刚说过，算力需求没有上限，他的目标是靠自研把成本压到远低于所有人的预期，而路透也指出，企业抢购谷歌芯片就是为了找更便宜的算力。

而且，OpenAI另外还找了AMD合作，谁家的钱和芯片都要。今年2月同一轮融资里，亚马逊承诺投500亿美元，OpenAI转头就扩大了在亚马逊云上的合同，顺手用上了亚马逊自己的芯片。黄仁勋以为砸钱能买来忠诚，但在无底洞一样的算力需求面前，他的300亿怕是不太够。

hello friends, a quick update for y'all.

i'm joining @fomo to lead perps.

i've been trading for a decade now and have shared most of my market thoughts publicly here. to me, markets are one of the purest expressions of human behavior, where information, attention, and conviction converge into price. trading has always been inherently social, and i've spent nearly every day of the last six years on twitter and telegram exchanging ideas with fellow speculators. but still, no one has quite figured out how to build a truly great social trading platform that actually helps traders trade. it's a deceptively difficult problem to solve.

we live in a world where more people than ever are attracted to convex outcomes. information is abundant, access to markets is becoming pretty commoditized, and people are becoming more opinionated about everything. but more information and more markets alone don't make better traders. what is now more scarce is judgment, or alpha: knowing what matters, how the best traders think, and when to act. the next great trading app won't just compete on execution, but on intelligence. a network where people discover ideas, build conviction, and sharpen their edge through others.

most people see fomo today as an app for trading memes. onchain proved just how deeply markets are driven by attention, narratives, and social behavior. these same forces exist across equities, commodities, and anything else people can form an opinion on. what fomo has built for the trenches is the foundation for bringing that same social experience to every asset class. the opportunity is to build a network where the world discovers, discusses, and trades everything.

as an early investor and advisor of fomo, my conviction has only grown in both the vision and people committed to it. the goal isn't simply to let everyone trade perps but to build a network that makes everyone trading them better.

it's a difficult problem to solve. one life. it’s worth an attempt.

author: puffer_unifi
quoted_text:
🤖 The @puffer_unifi Series #5 | Scaling Ethereum Without Fragmentation

Ethereum’s limited blockspace made transactions expensive and constrained the network’s ability to scale. Rollups addressed this by moving execution offchain while keeping settlement and security anchored to Ethereum.

But as more rollups emerged, a new problem appeared: fragmentation. Each rollup operates in its own execution environment, with separate liquidity pools, transaction ordering, and state. Moving assets between them often requires bridges and asynchronous messaging, introducing delays and additional complexity.

For financial applications, this fragmentation matters. Trading, lending, and payments depend on liquidity being accessible and protocols being able to interact efficiently. When execution is spread across isolated networks, even simple operations can require multiple transactions and cross-chain transfers.

Puffer UniFi is designed to address this through:

• Ethereum-aligned sequencing: Based sequencing keeps transaction ordering tied to Ethereum L1 rather than relying on independent rollup sequencers, creating a foundation for tighter coordination.

• Synchronous composability: Puffer UniFi is designed to enable appchains to interact with Ethereum L1 smart contracts and liquidity within the same Ethereum slot, reducing reliance on asynchronous cross-chain messaging.

• Dedicated execution: Based appchains provide scalable, application-specific execution environments while remaining closely connected to Ethereum’s broader ecosystem.

The goal isn’t just to increase Ethereum’s execution capacity. It’s to scale without sacrificing the shared liquidity and composability that make Ethereum valuable.

text:
很多人印象里查理芒格是完美的
但真正的现实世界里
查理芒格起码有两次人生低谷
比破产可能还要惨

第一次是 1953 年（29 岁）
离婚、儿子患白血病离世
积蓄被医疗费掏空、负债
接近破产
身体心理和钱包都被掏空了

第二次是1974 年（50 岁）
合伙基金1973 年亏 31.9%、1974 年再亏 31.5%
芒格用了一倍杠杆
个人净资产大幅缩水
当时感觉自己快要破产
1975 年清算关闭这只合伙基金
这是芒格的财富和信誉危机

但是芒格活到了99.9岁
那些苦难在他的生命历程里
只影响了他前半程
留给了后半程宝贵的智慧财富

所以不管你经历了什么
你要记住连芒格都是50岁之后
才开始真正智慧起来的
你可能比巴菲特晚熟
但是比起芒格还是要更早熟吧

芒格对前半生的总结
只要你今天比昨天进步了一点
那么就是巨大的进步
保持这种状态继续下去

而不是困在29或者50岁那年
也不要想着28岁或者49岁的高光
人生要往前看
朝闻道夕死可矣
任何时候知道错了回头都是不晚的

quoted_text:
hello friends, a quick update for y'all.

i'm joining @fomo to lead perps.

i've been trading for a decade now and have shared most of my market thoughts publicly here. to me, markets are one of the purest expressions of human behavior, where information, attention, and conviction converge into price. trading has always been inherently social, and i've spent nearly every day of the last six years on twitter and telegram exchanging ideas with fellow speculators. but still, no one has quite figured out how to build a truly great social trading platform that actually helps traders trade. it's a deceptively difficult problem to solve.

we live in a world where more people than ever are attracted to convex outcomes. information is abundant, access to markets is becoming pretty commoditized, and people are becoming more opinionated about everything. but more information and more markets alone don't make better traders. what is now more scarce is judgment, or alpha: knowing what matters, how the best traders think, and when to act. the next great trading app won't just compete on execution, but on intelligence. a network where people discover ideas, build conviction, and sharpen their edge through others.

most people see fomo today as an app for trading memes. onchain proved just how deeply markets are driven by attention, narratives, and social behavior. these same forces exist across equities, commodities, and anything else people can form an opinion on. what fomo has built for the trenches is the foundation for bringing that same social experience to every asset class. the opportunity is to build a network where the world discovers, discusses, and trades everything.

as an early investor and advisor of fomo, my conviction has only grown in both the vision and people committed to it. the goal isn't simply to let everyone trade perps but to build a network that makes everyone trading them better.

it's a difficult problem to solve. one life. it’s worth an attempt.

- hdf
