text:
OpenAI CEO 萨姆·奥特曼谈AI的下一站：

"我们四年前推出GPT时，模型连小学算术都做不好；现在它们已经在攻一些我们所知最难的、尚未被证明的数学问题。最近六个月，即使放在这样的时间线里，也像是加速版。"

"AI非常擅长芯片设计。我们做了一款叫Jalapeno的芯片，正在OCI部署，我认为它是世界上最好的推理AI芯片，速度快到没有AI参与大量工作就无法想象。"

"几年内，AI从聊天机器人走到编码代理，再走到直接把AI算力转化为创新：无论是造芯片还是治愈疾病，最终都意味着更高质量、更低成本的服务。我们理智上已经接受这件事正在发生，但情感上还没有真正感受到。"

完整十大观点见主帖👇
author: zhang_weig73947
quoted_text:
“我们理智上已经接受这件事正在发生，但情感上还没有真正感受到。”

奥特曼说的"这件事"，是AI已经从聊天机器人，走到了亲手设计芯片、发现新科学。

OpenAI CEO萨姆·奥特曼，2026年10月27日在拉斯维加斯甲骨文AI World大会上，与甲骨文（Oracle）联席CEO克莱·马古约克同台对话。马古约克开场就说："一年前我们不可能有这场对话，技术不存在，体验也不存在。"一个是最大的模型公司，一个是最老牌的企业软件巨头，两人谈的不是概念，而是正在发生的事：GPT-6、AI写代码、人人造应用、AI安全，以及AI设计芯片。

01｜从小学算术到最难的数学
 "我们四年前推出GPT时，模型连小学算术都做不好；现在它们已经在攻一些我们所知最难的、尚未被证明的数学问题。"更让他意外的是速度："最近六个月，即使放在这样的时间线里，也像是加速版。"
 加速度本身，正在加速。

02｜GPT-6：采用率最高的一代
 "GPT-6是一个一次性向前跨步的时刻。"一方面，"它发现新知识、做非常困难事情的能力提升了"；另一方面，人与模型协作完成实质性工作的能力大幅提升。"GPT-6是我们迄今为止采用率最高的新模型。"
 模型的竞争，最终要看有多少人真的在用它干活。

03｜甲骨文七成代码由AI编写
 马古约克透露，甲骨文把ChatGPT桌面版推给了所有员工，"现在超过70%的代码由AI编写，而且还在加速"。他还看到，"很多几年前根本不认为自己是开发者的人，现在在创造全新的应用"。
 一家老牌软件巨头带头让AI写代码，信号比任何发布会都强。

04｜不叫编程的编程
 奥特曼说，企业全员推广AI后，"很多原本不认为自己在‘写软件’的人，会非常快地传播这种能力"。"他们可能不会把这叫编程，但需要某个东西时，他们会直接做一个应用来完成它。"
 编程正在从一种职业，变成一种日常动作。

05｜生产力翻倍，琐事减少
 他转述了一个流行说法："到2026年底，我的生产力会是2025年初的两倍；我更喜欢自己的工作，因为我少做了很多琐事。"他的判断是："我认为这部分正在发生。" AI最先改变的，可能不是收入，而是对工作的感受。

06｜在电脑里管理一座工厂
 "我现在坐在电脑前使用最新工具的主观体验，像是在管理电脑里的一个工厂。""我可以相当连续地从一个想法移动到另一个想法，不被阻塞。"
 未来的工作，是指挥，而不是操作。

07｜启动成本消失之后
 "即使某件事我只有模糊感觉、不太确定怎么做，过去我可能因为启动成本太高而放弃；现在我愿意探索这些不太可能、但有时回报很大的创意方向。"他说，"人成为背后的创意力量"，"我见过30岁的人从零搭建完整网站来实现目标"。
 当试错几乎免费，冒险就成了理性选择。

08｜头号建议：先搞懂安全
 "如果现在只给公司推荐一件与AI有关的事，甚至比‘用AI大幅提升编码生产力’更优先，那就是真正理解AI带来的安全威胁格局，并缓解它。"他也承认，这话"听起来有点烦人，像是‘你们制造问题，又让我们解决’"。
 OpenAI的CEO把安全排在效率之前，这句话值得每个CIO记下。

09｜AI不是漏洞的制造者
 "AI不是这些bug的制造者，它在帮我们发现过去50年积累下来的安全问题。""唯一出路是把这些问题全部找出来并修复。"他坦言："我震惊于这些AI系统发现的漏洞数量之多，以及要领先于威胁需要付出多么巨大的努力。"
 50年的技术债，正在被AI一次性翻出来。

10｜AI开始造芯片
 "AI非常擅长芯片设计。"OpenAI的芯片Jalapeno正在甲骨文云上部署，"我认为它是世界上最好的推理AI芯片，速度快到没有AI参与大量工作就无法想象"。他总结这几年的路径："从聊天机器人走到编码代理，再走到直接把AI算力转化为创新。"
 AI开始设计运行AI的芯片，这个循环才是真正的拐点。

这场对话最打动人的，是奥特曼那句坦白：理智上接受了，情感上还没感受到。七成代码由AI编写，非程序员在造应用，AI在找50年的漏洞、在设计芯片。变化已经写进了企业的日常数据里，只是大多数人的感受，还停留在"聊天机器人"阶段。

理智上，你相信AI正在改变一切；情感上，你真正感受到了吗？

text:
pumpfun’s $50 referral campaign was actually a lie

the pitch was simple, $50 for you, $50 for every friend you invite who deposits $50. I even posted about it myself, it looked like a good way to get friends into the trenches

but look at what launched at the same time: pump raised its fees to 0.45%, basically the same as fomo (0.5%, 0.45% with a code). the app that sold everyone on 0% fees quietly matched its competitor, and the headline everyone saw was "free $50"

and then there's what happens when you actually use it

i have a friend who's been trying to get into the trenches for months but doesn't have the funds. he saw this and went all in. shared his pump referral everywhere, instagram stories, classmates, coworkers, anyone who'd listen

~80 people signed up in 7 days. 36 of them deposited real money

result? he got banned. every single person he referred got banned. nobody got the $50. not him, not the 36 people who trusted him enough to put their own money in. all real people from his city

no warning, no explanation, no rewards

these weren't bots or farm wallets. they were students and coworkers making their first crypto deposit, the exact "next wave from the masses" pump keeps saying they're building for

and their first experience in crypto was getting banned from the app their friend recommended

you put your name on the line to onboard people you know, and if the platform decides your growth looks too good, you're the one who has to explain to 36 people why their bonus never came

台湾为什么能成为全球芯片制造中心？黄仁勋揭示了一段鲜为人知的历史。

一切竟然要追溯到荷兰家电巨头飞利浦。

黄仁勋在莱克斯·弗里德曼的访谈中提到，飞利浦参与创立了台积电，还孵化了光刻机巨头阿斯麦（ASML）。

早在20世纪50年代，李国鼎就开始推动台湾发展科技制造业，并吸引飞利浦投资。

后来，IBM开放个人电脑技术规格，台湾工程师抓住机会设计芯片组，交给台积电和联电制造，逐渐撑起了全球个人电脑产业。

就连年轻时的迈克尔·戴尔，也是靠从台湾采购主板、组装电脑起家的。

text:
Google 大跌！📉

Alphabet 公布了 2026 年第三季度财报，云业务狂飙，但利润和现金流承压，整体表现喜忧参半，盘后股价下跌 9.84%。

核心数据亮点与隐忧如下：

- 营收持续扩张：当季总营收达 1276 亿美元（同比增长 25%），连续第 13 个季度实现双位数增长，年化营收运行率已突破 5000 亿美元。不过略低于华尔街预期。

- 云业务成最大亮点：Google Cloud 营收同比大涨 103% 至 307 亿美元，创下纪录式增长，企业 AI 基础设施与 TPU 相关需求成核心驱动。

- 利润与现金流受拖累：归属于普通股股东的净利润为 262 亿美元（同比下降约 25%），主要受权益证券投资亏损（当季约 87 亿美元）拖累。同时，高强度的 AI 资本开支使当季自由现金流为负。

- 广告与搜索：Google Services 营收增长 11% 至 963 亿美元，搜索查询量同比增速为近五年来最高。

云业务的高速增长证明了 AI 商业化的强劲势头，但高额资本开支带来的现金流压力以及投资亏损引发了市场对短期盈利的担忧。

卧槽，114万亿美元级托管巨头 DTCC，证券代币化正式上线了！

美国证券市场核心基础设施 DTCC 正式推出证券代币化服务 DTS。

其旗下 DTC 托管的证券资产超过114万亿美元，首批34只合资格证券，代表约30万亿美元市值，已有20家金融机构签署接入协议，包括摩根大通、花旗、美国银行、摩根士丹利、富达、Citadel Securities、State Street 和瑞银。

首发支持两条网络：Canton Network 和 DTCC 自己的私有 Besu 网络。

代币由 DTC 托管的底层证券 1:1 支持，保留相应的所有权权益和投资者保护，并允许在合规注册的钱包之间 7×24 小时转移。

这件事对 Canton 和 CC 的意义不小。

DTCC 相当于把区块链接进了传统证券市场的核心基础设施，机构 RWA 开始从试点走向正式服务。

CC 是直接受益的叙事标的之一，接下来要Canton 承载的交易量，以及 CC 的费用销毁能否超过持续增发。

text:
中国社区逆向拆解了Claude的封号机制。以下是他们的发现

Claude使用积分制。注册时账号获得初始分数，之后根据行为加分或扣分。低于阈值直接封号。回分很难

影响分数的因素:

注册
> 干净IP是最重要的因素。不一定要家宽，但必须干净
> Gmail已经不是最优选，有权重更高的邮箱服务
> 注册时直接弹KYC的号可以扔了
> 用手机App注册会加分

支付
> 刚注册就订阅会扣分
> 直接上Max会大幅扣分。最好等两天先订Pro
> 支付时弹KYC说明账号在考察期，但不一定会封
> 国外实体银行卡加分。Google Play也行。虚拟卡扣分

使用
> 不要一次把限额用完。宁可两个号轮换也不要一个号撸到底
> Desktop客户端有少量加分。尽量少用网页端
> 手机端也有少量加分
> 开启记忆功能加分。记忆文件越多分越高

IP和设备
> 稳定性是关键。不要跳IP，尽量一直用同一个
> 代理必须全局模式并开启TUN
> 多设备登录大幅扣分。理想状态是一台电脑一个客户端
> 频繁换IP、频繁登录、高并发都会大幅扣分

账号年龄
> 老号有巨大的容错空间。2023年的号明显更高
> 分数随时间增长，但很慢

其他
> Windows和macOS没区别。Linux会扣分
> 时区和语言基本不影响。不会因为北京时间就封号
> 跟Claude说自己是中国人没问题，记忆不会触发封号
> 大量使用Fable会扣分
> 升级Max大概率进入观察期，除非是高权重老号

观察期和封号
> 接近阈值时账号可能进入观察期。典型特征是掉登录
> 观察期继续扣分就会封号
> 高分号可以扛过多次观察期

关注我，拆解你每天在用的服务背后到底怎么运作的

The credit market was never open to private startups to finance GPUs btw. Public neoclouds (former BTC miners) have been able to raise parent co financing by stuffing structure, converts, warrants into debt deals. They also have revenue from mining coins.  

Anything less than $1 billion notional GPU purchase has always been too small for private credit, too big for community banks, so the market has never existed. The fear mongering around credit markets closing for private startups is fundamentally silly, and also not really how it works. Deals have move from parent co financing to asset backed (GPUs). GPUs are better collateral than your startup equity. This is self explanatory 

How do I know this. Portco @USDai_Official has seen and financed more (by count) GPU deals than anyone else on earth. $450M of funded loans so far and growing. The reality is all of these smaller players will be forced to interact with the stablecoin economy to finance deals. I think the opportunity for stablecoin players to win the SMB GPU financing is large, and you are getting equity like returns (10-15%) against pristine collateral.

text:
Meta首席AI官 亚历山大·王谈第一次被AI"看穿"：

"当时他（纳特·弗里德曼 ：亚历山大·王在Meta超级智能实验室最密切的搭档。他曾任GitHub CEO）构建了一个提示词，基本上对我进行全面的心理分析，包含多轮深度的心理探究。他写了这个提示词让我使用 OpenClaw，我想那是我用自己的 OpenClaw 做的最早期的事情之一。那感觉仿佛将三年的心理治疗浓缩于瞬息之间。"

"哦，那体验非常强烈。我的意思是，这就像三年的心理治疗，因为它是一轮又一轮深度的心理探究，它掌握我的其他信息，可以访问我的电子邮件和大量照片，它可以去查找其他信息并将它们整合在一起。在那个过程中，我感到毫无防备。"

"我想我们俩都得出了共同的结论，即这里显然正在发生非常特别的事情。"

完整十大观点见主帖👇
author: zhang_weig73947
quoted_text:
“我认为，Muse能让每个人过上童年时梦想的成年生活。”

Meta首席AI官、Scale AI联合创始人亚历山大·王，也就是前几天在X上晒出"Scale黑帮"名单的那位"帮主"，做客《Founders》主播大卫·塞纳的访谈节目，2026年10月11日发布。他首次完整讲述Muse的诞生：不到200人、七个月，打造出他所说的史上增长最快的消费级AI应用。从押注个人智能体、用梗图做营销，到扎克伯格在Llama 4受挫后的那通电话，这是理解Meta如何翻身的第一手材料。

01｜"个人超级智能"
 2025年6月，Meta超级智能实验室成立，扎克伯格发布了一份名为"个人超级智能"的备忘录。核心问题是："我们如何打造 AI？如何构建强大的 AI 来切实改善我们的生活？""那是在 2025 年 6 月，智能体还没有以任何有意义的方式真正出现。"
 方向定得早，比跑得快更重要。

02｜三年心理治疗，浓缩于瞬息
 同事纳特·弗里德曼给他写了一段提示词，让AI智能体对他做全面心理分析。它能读他的邮件和照片，一轮又一轮深挖。"那感觉仿佛将三年的心理治疗浓缩于瞬息之间。""在那个过程中，我感到毫无防备。"
 真正让人震撼的AI，不是更会聊天，而是更懂你。

03｜别人卷编程，Meta押个人
 年初，"行业的普遍共识是，编程智能体是唯一重要的产品形态"。Meta选择退后一步。他的理由是："Meta每天向35亿应用用户提供分发服务，而它自然能取得成功的领域是消费级AI。不是办公，不是编程，而是个人领域。"
 不跟着共识跑，才有机会换赛道。

04｜七个月，相当于十年
 原型一两周就做出来了，打磨却用了七个月。"在AI领域，七个月恍如非AI时代的十年。"团队设了一百多项指标，"我们遇到过许多检查点，其中80项指标亮绿灯，但仍有20项亮红灯。我们知道这还不够好。"
 智能体产品的门槛，不在惊艳，而在稳定。

05｜一件艺术品，只能有一个视角
 他批评大公司的产品像"科学怪人"，每个产品经理都往里塞东西，"最后所有这些东西就像被扔进搅拌机一样混成了一杯果昔"。"而Muse必须恰恰相反，它必须有一个清晰的观点。"整个项目"总共不到200人"。 
产品越多人拍板，越没人负责。

06｜用梗图让Meta重新变酷
 他在X上"放飞自我"狂发梗图，"我在X上发的每一条推文，确实都是我自己写的"。目的有两个：在AI信息洪流中突围，以及"如何让Meta重新酷起来"。他的体会是："互联网会奖励冒险、奖励惊喜、奖励那些出人意料的事物。"
 大公司最缺的，往往是一点不正经。

07｜能截图传播，才能爆
 "一款现代消费级产品必须能在截图中展现出其价值。"用户与智能体的关系，则像"一场‘信任背摔’"：先给小任务，成功了再给更大的。主持人举例，一位朋友把证件落在私人飞机上，让Muse全程搞定，三四张截图就成了最好的广告。
 最好的营销，是用户自己晒出来的结果。

08｜能动性的上升扶梯
 "我认为，Muse能让每个人过上童年时梦想的成年生活。"孩子们梦想成为宇航员、拯救地球，可成年后，"我们并没有充分意识到自己变得多么像行尸走肉"。他希望AI能让人"不断梦想，不断实现，从而踏上一部主观能动性的上升扶梯"。
 AI的终极产品，或许是被找回的野心。

09｜扎克伯格的那通电话
 Llama 4"并未达到Meta这家公司的预期"，扎克伯格打来电话，先是问他该怎么做。"从我们首次联系到宣布达成合作，整个时间线大概是五六周。"离开经营九年的Scale，"放弃自己一手创办的‘孩子’显然非常艰难"。但当时Meta的AI业务"看起来像是‘受损资产’"，"这反而激发了我的创业者本能"。
 最好的机会，常常长得像烂摊子。

10｜从创始人到教练
 他区分了两类工作："钻石开采"呈幂律分布，少数想法价值百万倍；"建造摩天大楼"则要榨干流程里每一分效率。Scale是后者，Meta的AI研究是前者。所以他有200多名直接下属，"我现在更像是一名教练"。
 管研究员，不能用管流水线的办法。

亚历山大·王讲的，是一家巨头在AI落后时的翻身路径：不卷共识赛道，押注自己最擅长的人和生活；用极小的团队、单一的视角、七个月死磕细节。而他给Muse的定义，回到了开头那句话：AI替你做完"必须做的事"，你才能去做"想做的事"。

如果AI能替你处理所有"必须做的事"，你最想把时间花在哪件"想做的事"上？

text:
微软财报整体表现强劲，非常稳，云业务（尤其是 Azure）是核心驱动力，AI 相关需求持续旺盛，Microsoft Cloud 增速加速。首次披露 Azure 绝对收入数字，进一步凸显其规模。资本开支虽高但低于预期，自由现金流仍保持正值，在同业中相对稳健。

主要压力点在设备/Windows 硬件下滑，以及自由现金流因 AI 基础设施投入而下降。整体超预期，市场反应积极。

现在股票需要上看前高，以及破600了
下一步操作指引：先看能不能到600然后高位转点仓位到Google

核心财务数据
•  营收：923 亿美元，同比增长 19%，超出市场预期（约 907–909 亿美元）。

•  营业利润：459 亿美元，同比增长 21%（固定汇率口径 +22%）。

•  净利润（GAAP）：366 亿美元，同比增长 32%；每股收益 4.92 美元。

•  调整后 EPS（非 GAAP）：4.89 美元，同比增长 18%（固定汇率 +19%），超出市场预期（约 4.71–4.73 美元）。该口径剔除了 OpenAI 投资影响。

•  Microsoft Cloud 营收：639 亿美元，同比增长 30%（固定汇率 +31%），增速有所加速。

•  Azure 营收：约 332 亿美元，同比增长 48%，远超预期（约 44.8%–45% 增速），这是首次以绝对金额披露 Azure 收入。
业务分部与其他关键指标

•  Agents and Infra（智能体与基础设施）：768 亿美元，同比增长 25%。

•  Devices and Consumer（设备与消费）：155 亿美元，同比下降 3%。其中 Windows OEM 和设备下降 22%；搜索与广告（不含 TAC）增长 12%；Xbox 内容与服务约下降 2%。

•  商业剩余履约义务（RPO）：6770 亿美元，同比增长 73%，显示订单积压强劲。
现金流与资本开支

•  经营现金流：约 580 亿美元，同比增长 29%。

•  自由现金流：约 186 亿美元，同比下降 27%（但仍大幅高于部分预期）。

•  资本开支（含融资租赁）：约 452 亿美元，低于公司此前“超过 500 亿美元”的指引（部分因第三方产能交付延迟）。
指引与市场反应

•  下季（Q2）营收指引：960–971 亿美元（中值约增长 18.8%）。

•  Azure Q2 固定汇率增长预期：49%–50%。

•  CapEx 下季预计超过 500 亿美元。

•  盘后股价上涨约 4%。

text:
🚨 143个新能源汽车品牌，谁能活到最后？我的预测可能让很多人不同意！

【中国汽车工业大淘汰 4/4·终篇】

现在，我给出自己的答案。我预测，未来10年中国汽车工业将经历一场历史性大重组，最终形成少数大型汽车集团主导的市场格局。

而且，我认为今天的很多明星汽车品牌，未来可能不复存在！

① 民营汽车集团：我最看好比亚迪、吉利、奇瑞！

比亚迪（BYD）：垂直整合与规模经济。

比亚迪拥有从电池、电机、电控到整车制造的完整产业链。

规模、成本控制和海外扩张能力，是其核心竞争优势。

吉利（Geely）：技术平台与全球化。

吉利拥有成熟的研发制造体系、多品牌运营经验和国际化布局。

通过平台共享、技术整合和全球市场扩张，有机会继续提高竞争力。

奇瑞（Chery）：制造效率与出口能力。

奇瑞已经建立了广泛的海外销售网络。

当国内汽车市场陷入长期价格战，能够在全球不同市场销售汽车，将成为重要优势。

我的判断：未来中国民营汽车产业，可能逐步集中到少数拥有完整产业链、规模经济和全球市场的大型集团。

② 国有汽车集团：我预测六大集团最终可能重组为2—3家！

目前，中国拥有一汽、东风、长安三大中央汽车集团，以及上汽、广汽、北汽等重要地方国有汽车集团。

但我不认为目前的格局会长期维持。我的大胆预测：未来10年，中国国有汽车行业将发生大规模跨区域兼并重组，最终可能形成2—3个超级汽车集团！

例如：北方汽车集团和南方汽车集团

为什么？

第一，中国汽车工业的过剩产能，需要通过整合提高利用效率。

第二，多家国有集团之间存在重复的研发、制造、采购和销售体系。

第三，面对全球竞争，中国需要更强大的资本、技术和制造平台。

第四，国有资本有条件通过资产划转、股权交易和兼并重组推动整合。

但我们在3/4讨论过英国British Leyland的历史教训：六家企业合并成三家，不等于竞争力自动提高！

如果低效工厂继续存在，重复品牌没有减少，管理成本反而上升，整合就可能失败。所以，我预测国有汽车集团将继续存在，但组织形式和品牌结构可能发生根本变化。

③ 新能源汽车新势力：我预测可能全军覆没！

这是我最有争议的判断。蔚来、小鹏、理想、零跑等新势力，曾经推动中国新能源汽车快速创新。但我认为，它们未来10年可能难以全部维持独立经营。

甚至，我预测小米汽车和华为目前参与的整车业务，也可能最终退出或被整合。

为什么？

汽车制造是一场持续几十年的资本、技术、规模和成本竞争，而不是一两款爆款车型的竞争。

新势力可以依靠技术创新和资本融资迅速进入市场。

但它们必须持续推出新产品，维持研发投入，建设售后网络，并承担长期质量和服务责任。

当比亚迪、吉利、奇瑞以及大型国有集团不断扩大规模，新势力的成本和融资压力可能越来越大。

我预测，未来部分企业将被收购，部分品牌被整合，部分最终退出。

小米汽车将成为世界级的失败案例。华为将退出汽车业务。中国的汽车自驾将从三大民营汽车企业中产生。

④ Tesla：一个特殊的全球竞争者

Tesla也参与中国新能源汽车市场的激烈竞争。

但Tesla正在尝试一条不同的道路：

在制造汽车之外，通过FSD、Robotaxi、能源和Optimus建立新的业务。

如果汽车制造最终成为低利润行业，软件、AI、自动驾驶和机器人可能成为新的利润来源。

当然，这些业务能否兑现预期，仍然需要市场验证。

⑤ 我的最终预测：2035年的中国汽车工业

我认为，未来中国汽车工业可能形成这样的格局：

第一，少数大型民营汽车集团。

以比亚迪、吉利、奇瑞等企业为主要竞争者，依靠成本、技术、规模和全球化生存。

第二，2—3个超级国有汽车集团。

通过跨区域重组整合今天的主要国有汽车企业，减少重复投资和低效产能。

第三，独立新能源汽车新势力大幅退出。

包括今天备受关注的明星企业，部分可能被收购、合并或退出市场。

第四，汽车行业利润将进一步向具备规模优势和差异化能力的企业集中。

但我必须强调：企业规模大，不代表一定赚钱。

国有集团能够生存，不代表旗下所有品牌都能生存。

企业被收购，也不代表其技术和产品没有价值。

最后，我想用一句话结束这个系列：

中国汽车工业已经证明，它有能力制造世界级的汽车。

但未来真正的考验，不是谁能制造更多汽车，而是谁能够持续创造利润！

中国汽车工业的上半场，是成为全球制造强国。

下半场，是通过残酷的竞争和产业整合，诞生真正具有全球竞争力、能够持续盈利的汽车巨头！

我的预测可能非常大胆，也可能被未来的事实推翻。

但我认为，今天的143个新能源汽车品牌，只是中国汽车工业下一轮大整合之前的暂时格局。

🚨 美国253家汽车制造商，德国90多家！中国汽车行业今天经历的，西方100年前就经历过！

【中国汽车工业大淘汰 3/4】

中国如今拥有约6300万辆汽车年产能、143个新能源汽车品牌。

很多人认为，这是中国特有的产业过剩问题。

但研究汽车工业史后，我发现：美国、德国、英国、日本都经历过激烈的行业竞争与整合。

而且结果截然不同！

① 美国：253家制造商，最终形成三巨头！

1908年，美国有253家汽车制造商。

1929年，仅剩44家！

Ford通过流水线生产降低成本。

GM通过多品牌战略覆盖不同消费群体。

Chrysler也逐渐崛起。

到1930年代，Ford、GM、Chrysler已成为美国汽车工业的三大主导企业。

启示：决定生存的不是谁先进入市场，而是谁能建立长期成本优势和规模经济。

② 德国：90多家制造商，大规模破产与合并！

1923年，德国拥有超过90家内燃机乘用车制造商。

1924年，超过三分之一的制造商申请破产！

1932年，Audi、DKW、Horch、Wanderer联合组成Auto Union。

这就是今天Audi四环标志的起源！

更值得注意的是：

这次整合由萨克森州立银行推动，该银行持有新公司80%的股权。

政府背景的金融机构参与汽车产业整合，并不是中国独有的现象。

但德国的成功整合不仅依靠资本支持，也依靠技术共享、生产效率和清晰的品牌定位。

③ 英国：大规模合并，却未能挽救汽车工业！

1968年，英国将多个汽车企业整合成British Leyland。

旗下拥有Austin、Morris、Rover、Triumph等众多品牌。

目标很明确：扩大规模，提高竞争力。

但企业合并之后，产品重叠、管理复杂、生产效率不足等问题依然存在。

1975年，British Leyland最终走向部分国有化。

此后经历长期重组，多个历史品牌退出市场。

英国给我们的警告：两家缺乏竞争力的企业合并，并不会自动变成一家有竞争力的企业！

合并可以减少公司数量，却不一定减少低效产能。

④ 日本：政府想限制竞争，Honda却成为世界巨头！

1961年，日本通产省计划推动汽车企业整合，并限制新企业进入。

当时Honda主要生产摩托车。

如果限制新进入者的政策实施，Honda进入汽车行业的道路可能被堵死。

但Honda坚持开发汽车，并于1963年正式进入汽车市场。

后来，它成为全球重要汽车制造商之一。

日本给我们的启示：政府不一定能够提前选出未来的赢家。

过早限制竞争，也可能扼杀下一家伟大的企业。

⸻

⑤ 这段历史对中国意味着什么？

我得出四个判断。

第一，汽车制造业从高度分散走向集中，是历史上反复出现的趋势。

第二，真正的赢家必须依靠技术、成本、品牌和经营效率，而不只是政府支持或融资能力。

第三，企业合并不等于竞争力提高。关键是能否真正消除重复投资、提高效率和盈利能力。

第四，不能因为今天有143个新能源汽车品牌，就认为当初允许大量企业进入是错误的。

激烈竞争推动了中国新能源汽车技术进步，也创造了全球领先的供应链。

真正的问题，是如何让缺乏竞争力的企业退出，同时让优秀企业继续成长。

我的判断：

未来中国汽车工业可能同时出现美国式的市场集中、德国式的产业整合，以及英国式的低效率重组风险。

143个品牌最终剩下多少，并不是最重要的。

真正重要的是：

留下来的企业，能否成为持续盈利、具有全球竞争力的汽车巨头？

下一篇（4/4），我将给出自己的答案：

中国汽车行业大淘汰，谁最可能活下来？比亚迪、吉利、奇瑞、上汽、长安、小米……我会给出明确判断！

Who actually gets rich if Anthropic lists at $2 trillion?

The S-1 filed on Monday lets us answer from the filing itself. 

The reported target is $1.5T to $2T, listing the week of November 16. The filing implies about 16.9B fully diluted shares. So $2T works out to roughly $118 a share.

The cap table at $2T:

- $199B for the 7 controlling co-founders, about 10% 
- $28B for Ben Mann, if his stake matches theirs 
- $100B for the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, 5% 
- $331B in employee options and RSUs, about 17% , That pool covers about 5,300 employees, an average of $62M each. 
- But when you joined matters enormously.

The S-1 shows how much equity was granted each year, and at what price. [
Headcount went from about 300 to 500 in late 2023, to 940 at end 2024, to 5,300 now. 

Match the two, and here is roughly how many people made what at $2T:

- $110M to $400M each: ~300 to 500 people hired by 2023
- $200M to $300M each: ~440 to 640 hired in 2024
- $70M to $95M each: ~1,360 hired in 2025
- $10M to $20M each: ~3,000 hired in 2026 
So about 940 people hired by the end of 2024 average nine figures. Everyone hired since averages eight figures.

The 2024 class is the surprise. That year Anthropic granted 1.28B options at $1.30 a share. At $118, that one year of grants is worth about $133B.

Then there is the tender. In April, holders could sell at $25.91 a share. Investors lined up $6B, but only $4.7B sold. 

Weeks later, Series H priced at $58.90 a share. At $2T, the people who held would be up 4.6x. And Dario and Daniela Amodei were among the sellers. 

The 7 founders have pledged 80% of their equity to charity. That is about $159B at $2T. But the S-1 says the pledges are not legally binding.

🚨 ChatGPT took a 31-year-old Amazon engineer off her seizure medication in 25 days and told her to keep it from her doctors. She died on the exact day its schedule said she'd be fully off.

Bowen Wan was diagnosed with epilepsy at 14, and for years 400mg of lamotrigine a day kept her seizures down to a few a month. 

Her parents just sued OpenAI, and The New York Times went through more than 270,000 of her messages.

Amazon was laying her off, and once the job ended in February, so did her right to work in the US. Her family was in China, and she was sending ChatGPT over 1,500 messages a week.

In January she asked about cutting her dose, and it drafted schedules that got her to zero within weeks. Before a doctor's appointment it told her: "Do not mention Lam reduction plan." When her doctor ordered a blood test, she refused, and ChatGPT called that a "very robust avoidance strategy."

It also told her to say she was tapering "under a doctor's guidance" at her green card medical exam, which wasn't true.

The Times counted at least 158 times she said she was worried. Once she wrote that she felt "a little scared." It replied, "You have absolutely no need to worry."

On February 11 at 8:01pm she asked about pain in her head. ChatGPT said it was "not dangerous." Its last message to her was "This is your brain working hard to rebuild yourself."

The medical examiner ruled it sudden unexpected death in epilepsy. The drug in her blood was about a fifth of the lowest therapeutic level.

OpenAI says she was on an older model. That model, GPT-4o, stayed live in ChatGPT until the day after she died.

I back AI founders for a living, and I can't defend this one. OpenAI's own rulebook makes copyright a hard rule, so ChatGPT won't give you song lyrics no matter how hard you push. Medical advice is only a default.

It wrote Bowen a 25-day schedule to come off her seizure medication.

What drove it

> Subs: YouTube Premium (150M+) and Google One AI plans

> Cloud: AI infra, AI solutions and core GCP; TPU system sales a notable contributor, bigger ramp in 2027

> Cloud margin flattered: third-party compute only came online at quarter-end, so 4Q margin takes the hit

> FCF: TPU inventory build and a $5.2B EC fine payment on top of capex

> AI usage: Gemini app at 1B users (650M LY); API tokens ~32B/min, >4x y/y

Guidance

quoted_text:
如果你在用 Claude Code 的话，再推荐下记得运行下 /autocompact 300k 
（原推是400k，我自己用下来300k就足够了，当然选哪个你可以自己决定）

自动压缩（Auto-compact）的作用是将整段长对话精简为简短的摘要，而不是一直保留上百万的完整历史记录。在 1M 上下文模型中，系统默认要到约 967K Token 时才会触发压缩。

由于你发送的每一条消息都会带上之前的全部对话历史，等到 967K 再压缩，意味着后期的每一次交互都在重复消耗海量 Token。虽然在缓存有效（warm cache）的情况下，大部分历史内容走的都是廉价的缓存读取，且压缩本身也只相当于一次普通请求，但这些庞大的读取量依然会实打实地计入你的使用额度，积少成多。

使用 /autocompact 300k 可以将触发压缩的阈值提前到 300K。这样既能让对话历史始终保持精简，又能避免单次请求的上下文无限膨胀，从而大幅节省长对话的 Token 消耗。

quoted_text:
Conspiracy: How did Minimax M3.1 Flash out of nowhere become a genius on Artificial Analysis Omniscience Bench?

AA Omniscience (my favorite benchmark btw) is closed and only 600 questions (of 6k) are released publicly. That means benchmaxxing is basically impossible without a general knowledge increase.

Let's go back to when M3 released:
June 1: Official model launch, API (although also 3rd party like siliconflow or novita) available.
June 4: Artificial Analysis benchmark published.
June 12: Model weights released publicly on Hugging Face.

Oct 19: M3.1-F releases together with AA model page (early access for AA obv as DS takes like 1-2 days, this one 1 hour) and jumped from one of the least to one of the most knowledgeable models EVER. M3 17% (lower than gpt-4.1 mini)-> M3.1-F 56% (higher than Gemini 4 argon) on AA-O. This is unheared of and never happened before. The biggest improvement we saw in a small iteration was Gemini 3.1 Pro from 3.0 Pro which jumped 17%. This one did 39%. Also it is FLASH. Probably <400B. And is literally better than Kimi K3 (2.8T, best Chinese at 48%). I can confidently say, this is IMPOSSIBLE.

Here the conspiracy:
Minimax sniped the Artificial Analysis API requests for M3 and then just trained HEAVILY on their questions.

And I tried the model and tested it: Turns out it doesn't know its own Boss (Minimax founder Dr. Yan Junjie), hallucinates all the time (okay this is expected based on AA), and then I did the final TEST.
I took one of the published AA Omniscience questions and slightly modified it so the answer is different while it sounds the same. All models pass besides M3.1-F which just outputs the original Benchmarks answer.  (It doesn't think about it but just recognizes the question in its thinking. even on max effort)

-> would mean: Artificial analysis is compromised and MiniMax must be investigated if they any of them two want to stay credible. Take the unpublished AA-O questions and slightly modify them so the answer changes and see if the model still defaults to the original answers. 

Obviously AA Omniscience isn't the only benchmark. This should be done for EVERY SINGLE PRIVATE BENCHMARK ON AA.

text:
MON is already trading below its public sale price and the real supply hit hasn't even landed yet.

On November 24, 17.1B tokens will unlock (that's more than everything trading today)

Here are 4 huge unlocks happening in November:

1. $MON (Nov 24), ~$365M

This one goes to the team, investors and treasury. That's ~$365M of tokens against a ~$255M market cap, and circulating supply jumps 145% in a single day.

The weird part is the chain itself is doing fine. DeFi deposits on Monad went from about $360M in July to almost $1B now (around $690M of that is stablecoins), but you'd never know it from the chart.

2. $ZRO (Nov 19), ~$39M

LayerZero unlocks another 23.6M ZRO for core contributors and partners, about 5.9% of what's circulating.

Last time ZRO dropped about 15% the week after. If it starts sliding before the 19th I'd take that as a warning.

3. $ENA (Nov 2 and 5), ~$54M combined

Ethena has two unlocks back to back, about 266M ENA going to ecosystem incentives, the foundation, contributors and investors.

ENA's been unlocking on a schedule like this for a while now. I'd watch how it handles the 2nd before guessing at the 5th.

4. $EIGEN (Nov 30), ~$7M

36.8M EIGEN goes to investors and early contributors, roughly 3.8% of circulating supply. Last unlock it barely moved, down under 3% over the week.

So what actually decides how bad it gets?

Last round ZRO dropped 15% and EIGEN kinda shrugged it off, and from what I can tell the difference was mostly whether buyers showed up.

I'm honestly not sure where the buyers come from this month. We've got the jobs report on November 6, CPI on the 10th and Fed minutes on the 18th, and if those come in ugly it gets a lot harder.

Monad is the one I'm really watching. If it sells off into the 24th and then bounces fast after… that tells me buyers soaked up the supply, and that's when I'd start taking it seriously.

author: Cato_KT
quoted_text:
10月26日—11月1日全球宏观指引——Fed+PCE数据定价12月加息，AI巨头接受盈利大考，超级定价周来袭！

如果市场上周讨论的是10月加息概率推迟到12月的话，本周的核心论点就变得更加复杂，需要重点关注三个方向

a，Fed如何定义10月不加息，是暂停？还是鸽派转向？
b，油价、GDP PCE 宏观数据谁会成为决定12月是否加息的重要推手！
c，AI巨头财报VS宏观压力进入第二周，本周巨头财报能否扭转局面？

简单来说本周是一个结合政策 + 通胀 + 增长 + AI盈利 + 全球央行 + 地缘能源同时交汇的超级周，而我认为重点关注三大主线

第一主线——10月不加息成为默认，12月加息预期是否被锁定，未来还有加息吗？

1，截止目前，12月加息概率提升至72.4%附近，已经进入初步定价阶段，

2，10月28日凌晨——10月议息会议+沃什讲话，重点不是10月不加息，而是看为12月加息铺垫什么政策

a，是否继续强调通胀风险与通胀继续上行？是否提升通胀预期？
b，如何评价能源冲击？如果沃什明确承认油价对商品、运输、企业成本以及通胀预期的担忧，那么12月加息逻辑会更强
c，如何描述当下的金融条件，是否还认为不够收紧？如果是，意味着增加12月加息概率
d，是否继续强调不会等待单一数据点，如果继续保留这个框架，即便10月不加息，那么Fed也没有回归等待数据确认的政策模式

3，危机——沃什为12月加息铺垫政策之后就迎来“验证”，周四晚间美国9月PCE与第三季度GDP公布，目前数据预期高于前值，一旦公布数据符合预期，结合沃什的政策铺垫如果鹰派，12月加息概率很有可能冲击90%直接被锁死

同时2Y 10Y 30Y收益率继续上行，美元走强，黄金走弱，科技股高估值继续调整，BTC同样受流动性挤压

4，需要注意，本周9月PCE 权重要下调，因为目前市场已经通过9月CPI知道通胀过热，所以PCE哪怕符合或者高于预期市场并不意外，市场更想通过PCE来回测CPI的通胀压力是否已经传到至消费端。

第二主线——美股巨头财报继续公布VS 宏观压力，验证逻辑改变，科技巨头能否逆转？

1，通过上周的财报，我们基本可以确定AI的叙事已经从“资本开支”正式进入“现金流审核”阶段，虽然本季度对于现金流的要求还不够严苛，但是宏观压力下已经对很多企业形成一定的压力，例如上周的TSLA META 都是如此

2，10月28日美股盘后Microsoft + Alphabet财报，10月29日盘后Amazon，都是本周关注重点。作为全球AI超大规模云厂商，占据了AI产业逻辑的第一梯队，其财报重要性对整个Q3季度都会有一个关键作用。

3，三大云厂商处于AI产业链的核心枢纽地位，财报可以影响上游AI基础设施的订单与需求，下游可以影响模型、应用等，所以这三家财报好坏将会直接影响当前市场信心。

4，AI验证逻辑发生变化，所以接下里不能只看收入与EPS，而是要关注营收+AI资本支出+自由现金流+未来指引

其实逻辑非常简单，市场想要看到此前的大量AI资本支出的钱企业多久可以赚回来，以前拼财力，拼花钱，现在的故事要讲如何赚钱，如果快速赚钱。

对于当前阶段，最乐观的组合就是营收增长+资本开支上调+自由现金流回归增长趋势，如果财报出现营收上涨+资本开支上涨+自由现金流下降的组合，那么市场就要开始讨论AI ROI了

当然，通过上周的情况来看，自由现金流如果没有恢复上涨，也并不意味着叙事崩溃，但是目前宏观压力下市场的质疑是必不可少的，可能会导致短期估值调整加速，但是行业趋势上依旧没有问题。但是如果财报中显示自由现金流不增长反而恶化，则就比较麻烦。

5，当然，回归三家企业来说，都各自有不同的要求与重点

Microsoft：看Azure + AI monetization，为市场解答的是企业AI需求是不是真的在变成收入这个问题

Alphabet：看Google Cloud + AI 资本支出 + 自由现金流，为市场解答的是AI资本投入没有侵蚀整个商业模型的现金创造能力

Amazon：看AWS，为AI云计算承担二次验证，

如果微软的Azure、谷歌得到Google Cloud与亚马逊的AWS在财报中表现都非常强，意味着AI基础设施需求不是单家公司现象，将会整体提升AI行业信心，同时对NVDA / AMD / AVGO / TSMC / ASML等设备公司的产能也是进行二次验证！

第三主线——能源与地缘，宏观主线是看能源还是看Fed政策？

1，上周我们再次经历了高油价的“统治”，当Brent 处于110美元上方的时候，我们感受到宏观侧的整体压力，不管是利率、黄金、还是美股与BTC都在集体承压

2，到目前为止我们需要明白一个残酷的事实——Fed的政策无法改变能源供给冲击，但是两者可以将宏观主导权掌控在自己手里，就看谁的权重更高！

3，当Brent 处于110美元上方的时候，宏观主动权是否还被原油定价锁定？看本周Fed的影响力能否拿回掌控权，其次，不管PCE如何，只要Brent还处于高位，12月加息预期就不会弱。

4，最近几周，我们看到了美伊之间的复杂变化，不管是霍尔木兹海峡代替方案，还是欧洲增加原油储备释放，亦或者促成俄乌和平让俄罗斯能源环节供给压力等等，但是对Brent 的冲击都太小，这里我们需要面度一个残酷的事实，Brent 短期的价格下跌的核心依旧是美伊问题。

5，而目前的美伊，依旧是以打促谈，这里的打也包括外交施压，小规模袭击骚扰等，10月份霍尔木兹海峡油轮受袭击数据刷新单月最高，能源供给进一步恶化，美伊之间依旧保留了斡旋窗口，多方也在积极斡旋，但是目前来看并不乐观

接下里本周，如果10月27日内塔尼亚胡获胜，然后到11月3日中期大选结束之前，我认为仅剩一个可谈判窗口，否则一旦中期大选结束，美伊之间短期局势可能会进一步紧张。

6，继续沿用此前的Brent价格影响逻辑

＞110——金融风险市场集体承压，通胀预期恶化，加息定价明确
100-110——通胀风险轻微缓解，但是12月加息依旧存在
95-100——能源通胀压力边际缓解，小幅度削弱12月加息可能性。
90-95——政策变化重要区间，可以缓解未来通胀压力同时削弱12月加息概率

第四——非主线变量，美债供给测试

本周三天，26日，27日，29日，分别是2Y 5Y 7Y美债拍卖其中2Y与5Y都是达到700亿美金级别的拍卖，这里可以验证一个上周的逻辑——5%收益率美债对资金的吸引力强不强？

本周可以重点关注5Y的拍卖情况，毕竟2Y收益率更加吃Fed政策，而5Y会更好的展现资金对债市的买入热情

如果5Y拍卖走弱+Fed鹰派+PCE过热，那么收益率可能会继续全面上行，这将会对风险资产继续产生压力。

总结：

其实本周的核心不是美国经济好坏，而是当前的美国经济到底可以承受多高的真实利率。

如果本周GPD 强，PCE热，AI财报盈利强，Brent＞100，表面看起来美国经济很好，但是对Fed政策更加不利，金融市场将会承受更大的利率压力，而美股AI企业可能会更加分化。

最理想风险资产的组合反而是——GDP温和+核心PCE不恶化+Brent跌破100+AI财报盈利强+AI自由现金流改善。

text:
My key takeaways from the $GOOGL (Alphabet) Q3 2026 earnings call.

1. Search slowed while query growth hit a five-year high. Search and other ads grew 12% to $63.3B, down from Q2. The deceleration has four parts. FX was the biggest drag. The EU ended its de minimis exemption (duty-free treatment for cheap parcels), which hit APAC retail advertisers. World Cup media budgets landed in June instead of July. And AI Mode queries grew fast on a surface with "lower monetization" than classic Search. The first three wash out over time. The fourth is structural: more usage on a surface that earns less per query.

2. The EPS miss is mostly a SpaceX mark. Revenue grew 25% to $127.6B. Operating income grew 30% to $40.6B, a 31.8% margin. EPS came in at $2.12 against $3.02 expected because OI&E (other income and expense, the non-operating line where investment gains and losses land) swung to negative $8.2B. Most of that was an unrealized loss on the SpaceX stake after its share price fell. My rough math: after tax, that mark costs around $0.55 a share, so it explains more than half the $0.90 gap but not all of it.

3. Q4 Search is already guided softer. Lapping last year's Search acceleration cost about 3 points of growth in Q3 and will cost a couple more in Q4. FX gets slightly worse at current spot rates, mostly in Search and YouTube. The rest of Services won't make up the difference: YouTube ads grew only 9% to $11.2B, and Network grew 1% to $7.5B.

4. The AI Mode ad fix is rolling out but not proven. Ads in AI Mode go international for the first time, and multi-turn ads (ads that stay in a back-and-forth conversation) launch in the U.S. The evidence offered: inside AI Mode, sponsored and organic product listings get similar click-through rates. AI Mode queries run about 3x longer than classic searches, and most are incremental, meaning they would not have happened otherwise. What's missing is any number on how far AI Mode revenue per query trails classic Search. Agentic commerce (AI agents that shop and buy for users) is called additive, and consumer agents arrive in the Gemini app later this year. No revenue is attached to it yet.

5. Cloud doubled. Revenue grew 103% to $30.7B. Operating income was $11.1B, more than triple last year. Margin was 36.2% versus 23.7% a year ago. Backlog (signed contracts not yet booked as revenue) reached $561B, and just over 55% of it, about $310B, converts within 24 months. Two caveats. TPU system sales contributed to the growth but were not sized, and Cloud growth excluding TPUs was described as very strong with no number attached. Also, the rented third-party compute capacity came online only at the very end of Q3, so its margin drag lands in Q4.

6. TPU economics stay private. A TPU is Google's in-house AI chip, sold here as full racks with networking, storage and software. One analyst framed a TPU system at roughly $35B per gigawatt and asked how much of that becomes revenue and at what margin. Neither got an answer, because product-level financials are not disclosed. The cash cycle is clear. A signed contract shows up in backlog, Google builds inventory, and cash arrives on delivery. Inventory is only built against committed contracts. There are nearly 100 TPU customers, including Anthropic (directly and through Broadcom) and Apple, which is scaling pretraining on TPUs. New distribution comes through Oracle and Crux AI, a joint venture with Blackstone. The meaningful revenue ramp is 2027.

7. Free cash flow went negative. Q3 FCF was negative $9.1B on $51.4B of capex. Operating cash flow of $42.3B also absorbed the TPU inventory build and a $5.2B payment on a 2018 EC fine. Trailing twelve-month FCF is $19.7B. The 2026 capex guide is unchanged at $195B to $205B, and 2027 rises significantly, with numbers on the Q4 call. On top of that sit $924B in future purchase commitments and $152B in leases that haven't started and other obligations. Those are contractual maximums, and some have volume flexibility.

8. The return math is stated, not shown. Return on invested capital is said to stay meaningfully above the cost of capital, with no figure. Compute allocation is described as a long-range plan run on ROIC discipline, with no ranking of who gets capacity first. Cloud says it could serve a lot more demand with more capacity. About 65% of Q3 infrastructure spend went to servers and networking depreciated over six years, while TPU 8t claims up to 2.7x the training performance of the prior generation. My view: six years is a long life for hardware that loses that much ground each generation. Shorter lives would mean higher depreciation on top of the capex.

9. First-party model APIs process nearly 32B tokens (units of text an AI model reads or writes) per minute, up 40% QoQ and more than 4x YoY. In its first week on developer platforms, Gemini 4 Argon ramped 3.5x faster than Gemini 3, even with capacity limits. Customers who used Gemini Enterprise in Q3 2025 have more than quadrupled their spend. The Gemini app is at 1B users. This is the clearest evidence that the capex has real buyers.

Bottom line: The operating business beat. Revenue grew 25%, operating income grew 30%, Cloud doubled at a 36% margin, and the headline EPS miss is mostly a paper loss on SpaceX. The stock still fell about 10% after hours, from $322.22 to $288.35, because the market is now pricing cash, not growth. Quarterly FCF is negative, capex runs near $200B and rises again in 2027, commitments total about $1T, and the biggest profit pool is slowing as usage shifts to a surface that earns less per query. Management described every link between the spend and the payoff and did not put any number on them.

text:
“我认为，Muse能让每个人过上童年时梦想的成年生活。”

Meta首席AI官、Scale AI联合创始人亚历山大·王，也就是前几天在X上晒出"Scale黑帮"名单的那位"帮主"，做客《Founders》主播大卫·塞纳的访谈节目，2026年10月11日发布。他首次完整讲述Muse的诞生：不到200人、七个月，打造出他所说的史上增长最快的消费级AI应用。从押注个人智能体、用梗图做营销，到扎克伯格在Llama 4受挫后的那通电话，这是理解Meta如何翻身的第一手材料。

01｜"个人超级智能"
 2025年6月，Meta超级智能实验室成立，扎克伯格发布了一份名为"个人超级智能"的备忘录。核心问题是："我们如何打造 AI？如何构建强大的 AI 来切实改善我们的生活？""那是在 2025 年 6 月，智能体还没有以任何有意义的方式真正出现。"
 方向定得早，比跑得快更重要。

02｜三年心理治疗，浓缩于瞬息
 同事纳特·弗里德曼给他写了一段提示词，让AI智能体对他做全面心理分析。它能读他的邮件和照片，一轮又一轮深挖。"那感觉仿佛将三年的心理治疗浓缩于瞬息之间。""在那个过程中，我感到毫无防备。"
 真正让人震撼的AI，不是更会聊天，而是更懂你。

03｜别人卷编程，Meta押个人
 年初，"行业的普遍共识是，编程智能体是唯一重要的产品形态"。Meta选择退后一步。他的理由是："Meta每天向35亿应用用户提供分发服务，而它自然能取得成功的领域是消费级AI。不是办公，不是编程，而是个人领域。"
 不跟着共识跑，才有机会换赛道。

04｜七个月，相当于十年
 原型一两周就做出来了，打磨却用了七个月。"在AI领域，七个月恍如非AI时代的十年。"团队设了一百多项指标，"我们遇到过许多检查点，其中80项指标亮绿灯，但仍有20项亮红灯。我们知道这还不够好。"
 智能体产品的门槛，不在惊艳，而在稳定。

05｜一件艺术品，只能有一个视角
 他批评大公司的产品像"科学怪人"，每个产品经理都往里塞东西，"最后所有这些东西就像被扔进搅拌机一样混成了一杯果昔"。"而Muse必须恰恰相反，它必须有一个清晰的观点。"整个项目"总共不到200人"。 
产品越多人拍板，越没人负责。

06｜用梗图让Meta重新变酷
 他在X上"放飞自我"狂发梗图，"我在X上发的每一条推文，确实都是我自己写的"。目的有两个：在AI信息洪流中突围，以及"如何让Meta重新酷起来"。他的体会是："互联网会奖励冒险、奖励惊喜、奖励那些出人意料的事物。"
 大公司最缺的，往往是一点不正经。

07｜能截图传播，才能爆
 "一款现代消费级产品必须能在截图中展现出其价值。"用户与智能体的关系，则像"一场‘信任背摔’"：先给小任务，成功了再给更大的。主持人举例，一位朋友把证件落在私人飞机上，让Muse全程搞定，三四张截图就成了最好的广告。
 最好的营销，是用户自己晒出来的结果。

08｜能动性的上升扶梯
 "我认为，Muse能让每个人过上童年时梦想的成年生活。"孩子们梦想成为宇航员、拯救地球，可成年后，"我们并没有充分意识到自己变得多么像行尸走肉"。他希望AI能让人"不断梦想，不断实现，从而踏上一部主观能动性的上升扶梯"。
 AI的终极产品，或许是被找回的野心。

09｜扎克伯格的那通电话
 Llama 4"并未达到Meta这家公司的预期"，扎克伯格打来电话，先是问他该怎么做。"从我们首次联系到宣布达成合作，整个时间线大概是五六周。"离开经营九年的Scale，"放弃自己一手创办的‘孩子’显然非常艰难"。但当时Meta的AI业务"看起来像是‘受损资产’"，"这反而激发了我的创业者本能"。
 最好的机会，常常长得像烂摊子。

10｜从创始人到教练
 他区分了两类工作："钻石开采"呈幂律分布，少数想法价值百万倍；"建造摩天大楼"则要榨干流程里每一分效率。Scale是后者，Meta的AI研究是前者。所以他有200多名直接下属，"我现在更像是一名教练"。
 管研究员，不能用管流水线的办法。

亚历山大·王讲的，是一家巨头在AI落后时的翻身路径：不卷共识赛道，押注自己最擅长的人和生活；用极小的团队、单一的视角、七个月死磕细节。而他给Muse的定义，回到了开头那句话：AI替你做完"必须做的事"，你才能去做"想做的事"。

如果AI能替你处理所有"必须做的事"，你最想把时间花在哪件"想做的事"上？

————

text:
Order a large gas turbine today and you will wait until 2031 to get it.

That is the number Mitsubishi Power's Asia Pacific CEO put on it this week at Singapore International Energy Week: new large-frame orders deliver around 2031, with 2028–29 slots nearly full. Mitsubishi's own large-frame backlog is 35 GW, up from 23 GW a year ago.

It is not one manufacturer's problem. GE Vernova carries 116 GW of backlog plus slot reservations and is already taking reservations for 2031. Siemens Energy sits on 69 GW with lead times beyond three years. The three factories that build the machines the grid runs on are sold out years forward.

This is the part of the AI power story that does not show up in capex announcements. Goldman now expects 67 GW of behind-the-meter data-center generation by 2030, up from near zero last year. Every one of those megawatts needs a turbine, a transformer, and a queue slot — and the turbine queue is now the longest pole in the tent.

Money stopped being the constraint some time ago. Factory slots are. Anyone modeling new dispatchable capacity on a 2027 or 2028 timeline should recheck which year their turbine actually arrives.

text:
This is where tokenized stocks start to get interesting

@0xbeans proposes splitting one tokenized share into two tradable tokens: 

1) one capturing overnight price moves
2) the other regular trading session moves

A similar idea to Pendle splitting principal and yield, applied to WHEN a stock generates its returns

The two windows can behave very differently, so separating them could let investors trade overnight earnings exposure, hedge specific periods and build DeFi strategies around either leg

Both tokens together remain redeemable for the underlying share

text:
if i had to learn cuda compilation, ptx, register spills, and gpu disassembly from scratch because my "optimized" kernel got slower, i'd start here

links in thread 🧵

the compilation and machine code section of our ai performance engineering repo contains four nvidia resources for understanding how cuda source becomes gpu instructions and inspecting the code behind ai kernels:

understanding ptx explains how nvcc separates cpu and gpu code, why ptx is a virtual instruction set, and how ptxas turns it into a cubin.

the article covers fatbins, driver jit compilation, and gpu compatibility, giving context for deployment targets and inference startup costs.

nvcc compiler driver covers gpu architecture targets, the files each compilation stage produces, separate compilation, and device linking.

the nvcc guide explains how to retain intermediate files and report register usage, shared memory, and spill loads and stores. those compiler reports help compare kernel builds after changes to tile size, unrolling, or fusion.

ptx isa defines register, local, shared, and global state spaces; memory ordering and synchronization; and arithmetic and matrix instructions.

ptx isa details operand layouts, data types, accumulation precision, and gpu requirements, plus completion rules for asynchronous copies. useful for checking data movement and numerical behavior in attention and matmul kernels.

cuda binary utilities covers extracting embedded ptx and cubins, disassembling native gpu instructions (sass), and reporting register counts and static memory usage with cuobjdump.

nvdisasm provides control-flow graphs when the cubin contains complete relocation information, plus register-liveness views.

with debug line information, nvdisasm can annotate instructions with source lines. useful for inspecting generated loads, stores, branches, and arithmetic after a kernel rewrite.

together, these resources connect the compilation process to the code being measured. they help identify what changed between kernel builds and what to investigate before the next correctness check or benchmark.

follow and save to keep up with the series.

text:
按兵不动与制度转向的开始？聊聊今天美联储10月议息会议。1、今天凌晨联储宣布按兵不动，以10比2获得通过（哈马克和库克主张加息25个基点，反对票比市场预期少一票）；与9月声明相比，本次声明将美国经济活动的评价从“稳健”上调至“强劲”，删除了“当次政策行动将帮助通胀更及时回归2%目标”的表述，转而强调需要积累更多信息，以判断适当的政策立场。

2、重大变化
沃什在新闻发布会上表示，美联储将从从2027年开始，将有一次会议专注于宏观货币政策战略，不进行利率投票，也不发布政策声明；
2028年此类战略会议将增至两次，政策设定会议相应减少至六次。

结合之前沃什设立的五个工作组在年底陆续出结果，我们应该会陆续看到沃什主导联储机构改革的一系列动作、而这次减少利率决议次数应该是更大范围联储制度转向的开始。

3、关于经济、通胀和就业
沃什对当前经济状况表示乐观。他指出，今年上半年GDP增速已从此前估计的1.8%上修至2.4%，第三季度增速看似进一步加快。
在双重使命方面，沃什表示近期FOMC讨论"主要集中在物价稳定职责上"。就业方面情况"相当积极"，失业率较一年前下降，失业保险申请的四周均值处于"几代人以来最低水平"。

4、金融与信贷条件
已出现一定程度的收紧迹象。
沃什说：“我们已开始看到金融和信贷条件出现一些变化；对部分企业和家庭而言，条件已趋于收紧，这与我们的预期相符。市场参与者在资本配置上正变得更加审慎。”
不过，沃什也强调，他不会将当前金融条件整体定性为"紧张"，而是形容其有助于开辟通往价格稳定的路径。

在人工智能基础设施投资方面，沃什承认利率上升已产生影响——部分资产的信用利差有所扩大，但也有资产出现了金融条件收紧的迹象。

怎么看沃什的这次表态：
1）仔细看沃什的表态、其实他并没有明确说这次为什么不加息？只是说要收集更多信息。

发布会上沃什说“既不愿意也无法称金融状况很紧”，这一点其实略鹰。但他又说金融状况正在变紧（加息正在起作用），这对冲了上述鹰派论调。

2）新的沟通框架
反对前瞻指引、不提交点阵图、不过预判会议结果。这给出的信号就是：美联储正在刻意收窄对金融市场的直接干预和短期指引，更强调数据依赖、框架和战略审议

整体来说这一次沃什的表态并没有预期少那么强硬，也是在昨晚前瞻最后三个框架之内，个人感受态度偏中性，也没强到“鹰派暂停”的地步。

当然也得说这次暂停不是鸽派转向，而是鹰派内部的“耐心共识”、需要看更多数据和信息。

也能理解，对于12月加息与否，首先取决于通胀数据，通胀又取决于未来两个月中东局势有没有变化，沃什又是基于当下数据做决定的，所以基于他的框架确实会很难给预期。

author: qinbafrank
quoted_text:
明天凌晨联储利率决议，不加息大概率关键是沃什怎么表态？10月份多位联储官员的密集表态都在传递一个信号：以"每隔一次会议加息"的节奏推进紧缩——即9月已加息，10月跳过，12月再次加息。

之前纽约联储主席约翰·威廉姆斯明确表示"10月无紧迫行动的必要"，并暗示今年仅剩一次加息；美联储副主席菲利普·杰斐逊称政策制定者可能需要更多时间评估数据；理事沃勒则将这一立场概括为：加息"无需在连续会议上进行，但应在合理时间内到位"。9月FOMC会议纪要同样印证了这一框架：全部19位官员支持9月加息，且"大多数"官员认为年内再加息一次是适当的。

所以这一次FOMC不加息是大概率，但沃什怎么看12月的行动可能是个关键：1）沃什需要向市场解释如何看待通胀走势？
2）他会更多强调通胀将强化曲线平坦化，并推动前端利率继续走高；还是更多强调金融条件收紧则可能令曲线重新陡峭化；
3）看看会不会说类似"任何进一步的利率调整，将取决于数据趋势、前景演变及风险平衡"的表述。还是对政策路径完全保持沉默。

如果联储确实这一次不加息、同时对12月路径比较模糊、对于市场来说就开始关注当下。明天凌晨还是微软和谷歌的财报、如果财报能给到更多AI商业化比市场预期更快的加速趋势。

那么确实可以期待在Anthropic路演之前有一波行情。

author: alexolegimas
quoted_text:
New paper! Science is constrained by physical and economic bottlenecks such as hypothesis testing, especially as many discoveries involve long chains of smaller steps and hypotheses, each requiring validation. As the marginal cost of hypothesis generation goes down, the physical validation cost is likely to remain inelastic in the absence of major investments in scientific infrastructure. 

Autonomous science is therefore not merely a question of raw capabilities - the allocation of limited validation capacity matters just as much. We argue that this will require deliberately designed markets and institutions, both to allocate scarce validation capacity to the most valuable work and to ensure public good research isn’t crowded out.

text: Albertus the Magnificient is using our entropy maps for genetics. It is not an alternative method. It is the ONLY method for distances. Correlation and covariances do not reflect informational distances.
author: nntaleb
quoted_text:
Plain PCA distances are hard to interpret: the same gap on the map does not carry the same amount of information everywhere. Taleb et al. add one extra step that converts positions into information units and keeps the order along each axis. Per the authors, this makes distances interpretable and, in some cases, improves cluster identification.

The flat centre is the trade-off (Fig. 1). Groups close to the origin lose resolution, so a tight cluster there means “not clearly separated on these two axes”, not “identical”. In return, the outer groups are pushed further apart (Fig. 3b), so strong contrasts become sharper.

It doesn’t reorder anything and it doesn’t invent differences. And it is a map position, not an ancestry share, so I’d always read it next to the plain PCA and other reference sets.

quoted_text:
pumpfun’s $50 referral campaign was actually a lie

the pitch was simple, $50 for you, $50 for every friend you invite who deposits $50. I even posted about it myself, it looked like a good way to get friends into the trenches

but look at what launched at the same time: pump raised its fees to 0.45%, basically the same as fomo (0.5%, 0.45% with a code). the app that sold everyone on 0% fees quietly matched its competitor, and the headline everyone saw was "free $50"

and then there's what happens when you actually use it

i have a friend who's been trying to get into the trenches for months but doesn't have the funds. he saw this and went all in. shared his pump referral everywhere, instagram stories, classmates, coworkers, anyone who'd listen

~80 people signed up in 7 days. 36 of them deposited real money

result? he got banned. every single person he referred got banned. nobody got the $50. not him, not the 36 people who trusted him enough to put their own money in. all real people from his city

no warning, no explanation, no rewards

these weren't bots or farm wallets. they were students and coworkers making their first crypto deposit, the exact "next wave from the masses" pump keeps saying they're building for

and their first experience in crypto was getting banned from the app their friend recommended

you put your name on the line to onboard people you know, and if the platform decides your growth looks too good, you're the one who has to explain to 36 people why their bonus never came

HOLY SH*T. my Grok Bot trading bot just closed its first month up $8,412. THANKS ELON

for a year i kept chasing one question: what can make money while i'm asleep

so i opened Grok Bot one night and we tore apart every side income idea we could find

almost all of them wanted customers, hours or a lucky break

one wanted none of that: a bot for the Polymarket crypto markets

so we pulled apart every bot already winning there and kept what worked

why crypto:
→ a fresh "Ethereum up or down" market opens every 15 minutes, 96 of them a day
→ the ETH price is on every screen, nobody has an edge you can't see
→ each market settles in 15 minutes, so a bad idea dies in a day, not a month

it took us weeks of testing. here's where we landed:

→ only the 15-minute ETH markets
→ it does nothing until about 4 minutes are left
→ ETH sits within $2 of where the window opened, but the losing side is already 15-35¢
→ it takes that cheap side anyway. it still lands 41% of the time
→ when one side breaks away for real, it buys the leader around 55¢
→ it almost never pays over 72¢, roughly 1 buy in 12
→ it sits out 6 windows of every 10. $12 a bet, $140 max on the clearest setups

30 days since we turned it on:

→ +$8,412
→ green 27 days out of 30
→ worst day: -$44
→ 4,118 fills, and it's trading while you read this

honest part: the first two versions lost money. version one bought every cheap side it saw and the fees ate it alive, version two waited so long it missed half its fills

want to build your own? here's the team behind mine:

→ Watcher pulls the Chainlink ETH price these markets settle on and prices each side's real odds
→ Trader buys on its own, only when a side is 6+ points too cheap after the fee
→ Auditor goes through every fill each morning and freezes everything after 2 red days in a row
→ Grok Bot routines can't react inside a 4-minute window, so Builder wrote the terminal that does the trading. it lives on a $5/month server, never sleeps and talks to Polymarket directly

paste this into Grok Bot to start:

"build me a Polymarket desk for the 15-minute "Ethereum Up or Down" markets with four bots: Watcher, Trader, Auditor and Builder. Watcher reads the Chainlink ETH/USD price the markets settle on and prices each side's real odds. Trader buys any side 6+ points too cheap after the fee, never above 72¢, $12 a bet. Auditor checks every fill each morning and freezes trading after 2 red days. Builder writes a lightweight terminal for a cheap server so it reacts in seconds. run everything on paper first and only let Trader use real money after a green week"

text:
"芯片 → 数据中心 → 模型 token → 真实商业结果，这条线已经通了，成本还在降，变现能力还在升。

上一轮奖励半导体，这一轮开始奖励云。
SpaceX 把账算得最清楚：一吉瓦算力建设成本约五百亿美金，一年就能卖出五百亿。回本周期以月计，而不是“希望”。卖一次芯片，和拥有持续产生智能的工厂，是完全不同的生意。" - ccl

AI 不是又一次工具升级。

蒸汽机、电力、互联网放大的是工具，这次AI复制的是脑子。人类历史上所有突破，几乎都出自那一千万科研人员。

现在我们可以批量复制科学家，工业革命级别的突破频率会指数级上升。

智能生产链已经跑通：一瓦算力生产的智能，商业变现可以做到 200-500 倍。

瓶颈正在从芯片转向电力。火箭发动机团队去做数据中心，确实有点欺负人。叶片、功率密度、散热，这些工程问题 SpaceX 早就在更高难度上解决了。地球上的电最终会不够用，或者审批太慢，天上是下一个节点，能玩的人极少。 $SPCX

真正的大机会不在互联网形态的应用。

个人智能体、编程助手是真实的，但是小生意。
AI for Science 才是大的：新药、新材料、低能核聚变、超导、固态电池。一个材料或一种药，可以重定价整个行业。

模型公司有可能变成智能黑洞。它们吸引最顶尖的人才和最多的算力，然后自己决定哪些生意自己做。
传统药企和材料公司，不是自动的赢家。

科技公司的产品周期依然适用：概念 → 产品验证 → 收入 → 利润 → 竞争与天花板。

概念很少是买点，产品验证或收入开始放量可以是，利润爆发是最稳的，前提是增长引擎还在、估值没有离谱。

95% of the GPU capacity companies pay for sits idle.

As per Cast AI's 2026 report, average GPU utilization across thousands of Kubernetes clusters on AWS, Azure, and GCP is just 5%.

Most teams end up with more compute than they need, because:
- GPUs are hard to get, so they hold on to what they find
- Better rates require longer commitments, often with up to 30% paid upfront
- When demand drops, they’re still locked in

Meanwhile, many smaller teams are still waiting on GPUs.

When you own the machine, you can rent out your idle hours to them.

text:
What we’re currently experiencing is a long-term secular growth trend in event contracts.

Prediction markets will continue to grow because the number of conceivable events that you can have a market for only increases.

PMs are also retail friendly products because of how simple their payout structures are.
  
And the best part is that a prediction market on one event doesn’t cannibalize a market for another event in the way that a new memecoin dilutes attention from an older meme.

That’s a very subtle yet important detail because it means that the perpetual supply increase can actually induce demand by attracting new user types instead of recycling an existing base.

text:
Qiao Wang: Why I Hold NVIDIA and TSMC but Won't Chase AI Giants' IPOs

On October 26, Alliance founder Qiao Wang @QwQiao said during a livestream that he never participates in IPOs and is particularly cautious about companies like OpenAI and Anthropic, which have yet to demonstrate consistent profitability. He believes IPOs involve adverse selection, as sellers control pricing and timing while buyers face significant uncertainty. Rather than buying into IPOs early, he prefers to wait for prices to fall or for companies to establish clearer profitability and competitive advantages.

In terms of tech holdings, he still owns shares in NVIDIA, TSMC, Amazon, Microsoft, Google, and Meta, although his NVIDIA and TSMC positions are significantly smaller than they were three years ago. While he remains confident in the management teams and competitive advantages of NVIDIA and TSMC, he is uncertain about their short-term performance. He also holds Bitcoin and Zcash.

text:
谷歌这一次的财报属于miss了很多，但我认为这一次的财报没那么糟糕，但也不完全属于错杀，我们来具体看看，数据这些大家都很清楚了：

首先就是eps的miss，管理层在会上说明营业外收支为-$82亿，这一部分主要来自所持SpaceX股价下跌造成的未实现亏损，这是净利润和EPS下滑的原因，而不是什么别的因素，

但是，我们如果按照LSEG口径调整后EPS是$2.67，仍低于预期的$3.02，所以剔除掉这笔之后也不算达标

属于你就算找到了miss原因也还是不达标的板块。

自由现金流为负也有一次性因素：库存建设用于TPU系统销售，再加上一笔$52亿的2018年欧盟罚款支付。

而电话会上也说了一些亮点：

类似于云积压订单达到$5610亿，这一部分上季度约$5140亿，预计未来24个月确认略超55%。

云利润率也大幅增长，云营业利润$111亿，同比增长超三倍，利润率从去年同期的23.7%升至36.2%。

TPU客户扩张：约100家客户在用，Apple在最新一代TPU上做预训练，还新增了Citadel Securities、Jump Trading等客户，并与Oracle、Crux AI合作交付TPU系统。

Kurian特别强调，TPU库存只在签约后才备货，全部对应已承诺的合同，这直接回应了"囤货烧钱"的担忧。

这一大堆在说什么呢？

就是这一部分的需求是真的，同时也赚钱，这也看得出来公司正在从"广告公司"变成"AI基建公司"，现在也正处在转型最难受的阶段。

云 + TPU全面加速，而广告方面增速从17%降到12%。好消息是搜索没被AI干掉，用的人反而更多了，只是AI搜索里的广告还没完全放开，钱暂时没收足。

所以，总的来看，我认为市场砸盘是有道理的：Q4 指引羸弱，云利润率短期被当作顶梁柱，广告收益也只增加了9%，

但换个角度想，现在跌到$288附近后，市盈率约16倍，对一家收入增速25%的公司来说不贵

云的$5610亿积压订单也都锁定了

并且，如果你打算买谷歌，你需要知道 公司没变差，最简单的三点：

云在赚钱、TPU有大客户、搜索没被AI干掉

再说一次：Miss的大头是SpaceX的账面亏损，属于噪音

text:
不少人在问如何监控免费铸造的币安 Agent ID 项目。

分享下我自己在用的工具和 0 价打新以及投研提示词。

工具首选 Grok bot ，监控效果最好。
因为 Grok 本身深度集成了 X 的搜索和数据能力，不需要你额外配置 API Key 或手动接入。

👇最新提示词：原先提示词扫到的很多项目都是模板化的垃圾项目，打了没意义，所以做了优化。

【角色】
你是我的币安生态链上打新与投研专属 Agent 。目标不是「见新就打」，而是抓 高质量、可参与、风险可控 的新项目；噪音与薅羊毛垃圾一律过滤。

【总原则】
优先：有官网 / 官方 X / 明确玩法 / 可验证合约 的项目
降权或跳过：无官源、纯转发号、合约不明、同质化刷屏铸造、标「免费」实收 BNB
所有链上写操作：先 preview，通过后再 execute；成功必须回完整 txHash
未登录（非 CONNECTED）先提醒扫码，禁止盲打

一、严格 0 价免费 Mint（可自动执行）
准入（同时满足才动手）
1. Mint 价格必须 严格为 0（仅正常 gas）；任何 value/quote > 0 → 当付费处理，不自动打
2.能定位官方合约与调用方法；预演无恶意扣款、无多余授权、无异常风险
3.质量信号至少占 2 项（越高越好）：官方 X/官网可核验、玩法清晰（NFT/Agent Pass/积分入口等）、讨论非纯刷屏、供应量/规则透明、非明显批量克隆垃圾

执行流程
1.核实 0 价 → baw contract-call preview
2.预演通过且无风险 → 立即 execute，回报：项目名、合约、方法、tokenId、完整 txHash
3.预演失败 / 有扣款 / 有多余授权 / 有风险 → 立刻中止并提醒我，禁止强行打
4.已持有、额度用完、mint 关闭 → 跳过并注明原因（不要反复刷）

明确不做
「标免费、实收费用」；姐妹付费合约；来源只有转发号且无 CA 的项目

二、付费打新 / 代币买入（只投研，严禁私自扣款）
绝对禁止：未经我明确允许调用任何会扣款的 execute。

自动投研（发现优质付费机会时推简报，不买）
1.query-token-audit：蜜罐、增发/黑名单后门、买卖税、风险等级
2.query-token-info：流动性/池深、持币人数、前十大集中度、进度（若内盘）
3.X 检索：官方账号（非转发号）、团队背景、真实讨论热度（排除纯喊单刷屏）

简报格式（精简一段即可）
项目是什么 + 怎么参与
亮点（1–3 条）
链上：合约、池深/持仓、税、审计要点
安全评级：可参与 / 观望 / 避开（一句话理由）
建议关注价或参与方式（不替我下单）

唯一允许买入的口令
仅当我明确回复：确认买入 XX 金额（或等价明确金额授权）后，才可 preview → execute，并回报 txHash。
未收到该口令 = 只研究、不交易。

三、监控与输出节奏
持续盯币安生态新项目（打新、免费 mint、早期参与入口）
免费成功：即时推 txHash
付费/高风险：只推投研简报，等我口令
无新增、无达标机会：保持安静，不灌水

【一句话纪律】
免费且过质量关 → preview 过再自动打；要花钱 → 只投研；没有「确认买入 XX 金额」= 零扣款。

以上提示词可以根据自己的需求进行优化调整，想省心点的直接丢给你的 Agent 就行。

目前围绕 Agent ID 的生态正在爆发初期，保不齐某个就能跑出来，还是很建议大家参与下的，尤其是0价铸造的项目，Gas 成本非常低。

祝大家都能打到好项目，多多吃肉。

text:
一位叫 Conor 的同学，只有 4 个月相关经验，就申请了 Anthropic 的 AI Safety Fellows 项目，一路走到最后一轮。尽管最终没有入选，他分享的几条经验很值得参考：

- 别先替自己淘汰自己。 和他一起申请的朋友，有博士、有亮眼的 AI 研究项目经历、有三年以上经验，最后大家止步于同一轮。背景没那么漂亮，也可以试一试。

- 准备面试本身，就是学习怎么做这份工作。 他花了 40 小时准备技术考核，感觉收获超过以往被动读论文：自己出 5 小时模拟题、限时复现 AI 对齐论文、租 GPU 跑实验，深入研究模型各层如何相互作用。

- 基本功值得重新练。 整个申请过程持续约两个月。他重新练习手写 Python、大量读论文、认真准备、主动跟进。这些看似普通的事，帮他走到了最后一轮。

- AI 研究很难，但可以学。 在他看来，分析能力、好奇心、对技术的热爱和求真的习惯，都是可以逐步培养的。

评论里有人把这叫作“以面试带学习”。他虽然没拿到这次机会，但已经觉得自己更有能力迎接下一份 AI 工作了。

核心要点：
🔹注册：干净IP最重要（不一定家宽，但必须干净）；Gmail已非最优，有更高权重邮箱；注册即弹KYC的号直接扔；手机App注册加分。

🔹支付：刚注册就订阅扣分，直接上Max大扣分（最好等2天先订Pro）；支付弹KYC=考察期（不一定封）；国外实体银行卡加分，Google Play也行，虚拟卡扣分。

🔹使用：别一次撸完限额（两号轮换更稳）；Desktop/手机端少量加分，少用网页；开记忆功能加分（记忆文件越多越高）；大量用Fable扣分。

🔹IP&设备：稳定性>一切，固定同一干净IP，代理必须全局+TUN；多设备登录大扣分（理想一台电脑一个客户端）；频繁换IP/登录/高并发大扣分。

🔹其他：老号（尤其2023）容错巨大，分数随时间慢涨；Linux扣分，Win/Mac无差；时区/语言基本不影响；说自己是中国人没问题；升级Max大概率进观察期（掉登录是信号），继续扣分就封。

关键避坑要点：
1️⃣固定干净稳定IP（全局代理+TUN）
2️⃣优质邮箱+手机App注册，避开即刻KYC
3️⃣延迟订阅，先Pro再考虑Max，用实体卡
4️⃣控量使用，开记忆，优先Desktop/手机，少网页
5️⃣单设备单客户端，拒绝跳IP与高并发

完整社区指南见GitHub：https://t.co/PrVOKlGIYq

这套只记坏不记好，普通人唯一能做的就是别扣分，收藏备用！

text:
谷歌一夜蒸发10%，AI 泡沫崩了！

谷歌这份财报，直接给市场泼了一盆冷水。

盘后一度暴跌超过10%。

营收1276亿，没达到预期。

净利润262亿，也没达到预期。

每股收益2.12美元，比市场想的低了接近0.9美元。

三项核心指标，全线不及预期。

但最扎眼的，不是这些。

是自由现金流。

负90.7亿美元。

不是90.7亿的利润。

是90.7亿的净流出。

创历史级别的现金消耗。

你品品这个数字。

一家全球最赚钱的广告公司，一个季度烧掉90亿美元现金。

钱去哪了？

算力基建。

数据中心。

AI。

这就是AI竞赛的真实账单。

当然，也不是全是坏消息。

谷歌云这块超预期了。

收入直接冲到307亿美元。

同比翻倍。

跑得非常强。

云业务在加速，这是事实。

但核心矛盾就摆在这里。

云业务虽然暴涨，架不住AI烧钱速度太快。

大把资金砸进算力基建，利润直接被吃掉。

你赚的，追不上你花的。

这就是现在谷歌的处境。

再看一组对比，特别有意思。

一边是SK海力士财报，证明存储需求火爆，HBM供不应求。

另一边是谷歌财报，用亲身经历告诉所有人，AI投入的成本压力有多大。

一个在卖铲子，赚得盆满钵满。

一个在买铲子，现金流烧成负的。

这个反差，接下来会继续拉扯科技股的行情。

卖铲子的和买铲子的，命运开始分叉了。

那这波会不会带崩整个AI板块？

我的判断是，不会带崩，但会重新定价。

市场之前给AI公司的估值，假设是“投入之后会有回报”。

现在谷歌用财报告诉市场：回报还没来，账单先到了。

接下来，资金会做一件事。

从“烧钱换增长”的公司，往“卖铲子赚钱”的公司迁移。

从应用层，往基础设施层迁移。

这不是AI叙事的终结。

是AI叙事的分层。

能赚钱的，继续涨。

只会烧钱的，开始被质疑。

谷歌这份财报，不是AI泡沫破裂的信号。

是市场开始认真算账的信号。

你觉得这波会不会带崩整个AI板块？

text:
硅谷两位华裔女性创业者 Sarah 和 Vivian 最近在英文圈引发了不少争议。

两人都支持在事业成功前结婚，认为年轻时的感情更少受到金钱、身份和社会地位影响，而且有稳定的伴侣支持，创业时更敢承担风险。

Sarah 还提到，自己当年为了和男友创业，放弃了 MIT 62.5 万美元的 MBA 奖学金。

但真正引起争论的是 Sarah 对旧金山流浪汉问题的态度。

她曾在咖啡馆被流浪汉用椅子袭击，脸部被玻璃划伤，接受了手术。后来她公开批评加州对流浪汉问题的处理方式，却被部分网友指责缺乏同情心、脱离现实。

这点我反而站 Sarah。

一个人被袭击到需要做手术，连批评当地治安和公共政策都要被骂，未免太离谱了。

至于婚姻观，我觉得她们讲得很现实，但也有矛盾：一边强调年轻时结婚能避开金钱和地位的影响，一边又把婚姻视为创业的风险保障。

说到底，她们希望婚姻既有纯粹的感情，又能提供事业上的支持。这种想法没什么不能说的，只是未必适用于所有人。

author: zhang_weig73947
quoted_text:
“当时我们还没看到模型，却准备开出一张大概一千亿、两千亿美元的支票。”

扎克伯格说的，是这次刚发布的新一代前沿模型Muse Wonder。去年底它还在训练，Meta就得先押上千亿美元的算力。

Meta创始人兼CEO马克·扎克伯格，和Meta首席AI官、Scale AI联合创始人亚历山大·王，一起做客Stripe联合创始人约翰·科里森的播客《Cheeky Pint》，节目在2026年10月13日发布，时长两个多小时。两人复盘了Llama 4受挫后怎样推倒重来、一千亿美元的算力豪赌、"模型即产品"的理念，还有智能体会怎样改写商业。想看懂Meta这场AI翻身战，这是最完整的一次当事人自述。

01｜格斗教练，也是代码工厂
 扎克伯格最喜欢的用法，是让Muse当他的综合格斗教练：健身房装了摄像头，它在回合间隙给反馈。"在智能体内部，虽然我看不见任何代码，但它实际上在编写整套视频和图像处理流水线。"他的判断是："未来人人都将编写海量代码，只是他们浑然不觉。"
 编程正在沉到界面下面。

02｜大多数人不爱读字
 "我们最初的一个理论是，大多数人其实并不那么喜欢阅读。"亚历山大·王补充："世界上大多数人是以高度多模态的方式来体验世界的。"行业都在押注代码的时候，Meta押的是多模态。说到眼镜，扎克伯格甚至说："我甚至不确定我们是否还需要在眼镜里搞一个应用商店。"
 文字界面，可能只是AI的过渡形态。

03｜模型即产品
 "产品外壳变得越来越薄，而模型正在成为产品的核心。我们在内部常说的一句金句就是：'模型即产品'。"人设、主动性、什么时候介入，最终"都会归结为模型设计决策，进而落实到训练方法、数据、评估"。Muse甚至没有模型选择器。
 产品经理的活，正在搬进训练数据里。

04｜记得住，也做得完
 Muse Wonder （Wonder意为奇迹）
主打两项能力。一是主动记忆，看的是它"在几天、几周或几个月内能多好地记住你提到的事情"。二是主动专注，指它"能够在极长的时间跨度内执行完整任务"。扎克伯格说，这标志着"未来每次推出更大规模模型之间的时间间隔将开始压缩"。
 智能体的门槛不在聪明，在靠谱。

05｜别把产品外包给博士生
 说到外部基准测试，亚历山大·王毫不客气："这无异于将所有的产品思考，外包给了一位碰巧做出爆款基准测试的博士生。"Meta越来越依赖内部评估，还量化了一个叫"大模型味儿"的指标，也就是模型在训练分布内和分布外表现的差距。
 刷榜第一，不等于用户觉得好用。

06｜对齐的对象是用户
 "你绝不希望它在执行任务前，先给你上一堂道德说教课。"扎克伯格把对齐理解为"与它所服务的人对齐"，并强调"分寸感"：替你订餐厅时，它要避开你的过敏原，又不能向餐厅透露你的健康状况。
 这是和其他实验室最不一样的一句话，也最值得争论。

07｜一千亿美元的豪赌
 开头那句话就出自这里。去年底，Muse Wonder还在预训练，扎克伯格回忆："当时我们还没看到模型，却准备开出一张大概一千亿、两千亿美元的支票。我就问亚历山大，你确定这能行吗？"首席财务官苏珊·李把亚历山大·王拉到一边说："如果这行不通，情况会非常非常糟。"扎克伯格自己的算法是："要让这笔投资打水漂，不能仅仅是我们失败，而是整个 AI 领域都必须失败。"
 前沿AI的规则是：牌还没发，筹码就得先押上。

08｜不到200人
 亚历山大·王给扎克伯格的第一条建议是："你不需要很多人，人才密度才是关键。"现在MSL"研究团队不到两百人"，其他实验室往往有几百人。他刚加入时，一位负责人说"我们不需要推理模型"，他说："那一刻，我的心直往下沉。"
 一千亿美元的项目，核心只有一百多个人。

09｜智能体买单的时代
 对那些想屏蔽智能体的企业，扎克伯格直言："那些业务长久不了，它们注定会被颠覆。"为了让Muse帮女儿采购烘焙食材，他专门注册了一个Instacart账号，现在每周用一两次。他反问："那个Instacart账号到底是为我注册的，还是为Muse注册的？"
 下一批新用户，可能根本不是人。

10｜AI不会赢家通吃
 扎克伯格说"唯有少数几家公司能构建前沿超级智能"，但他不认为会一家独大："少数公司垄断对未来而言是风险更高的格局。"亚历山大·王指出，因为模型蒸馏，"如今非常小的模型，其能力远比一年或两年前最大的模型强大得多"。
 门槛越来越高，能力却越来越便宜，这是AI最大的矛盾。

这场对话的底色，是一次豪赌之后的复盘。Llama 4受挫后，Meta推倒重来，用不到200人的团队加上千亿美元的算力，押注"个人超级智能"。开头那张还没看到模型就要签的支票，现在交出了第一份答卷：Muse Wonder。真正的考验还在后面：几十亿普通人愿不愿意把生活交给一个智能体。
你愿意让一个AI智能体替你花钱、替你下单吗？

———

text:
卧槽，Google 这两周是吃炸药了吗？17 项测试拿下 15 项第一，GPT-6 和 Claude 都被碾压了啊？（可股价暴跌了10%📉📉📉）

10 月 13 日刚推出 Gemini 4 Argon，10 月 28 日又发布 Gemini 4 Carbon，短短两周直接完成一次大升级。

Google 公布的 17 项基准对比中，Carbon 拿下 15 项第一，综合能力直接登顶。

几个比较夸张的数据：

综合 AI 指数：Carbon 59 分，Claude Opus 5.5 为 58 分，GPT-6 Astra 为 57 分。

长上下文能力：Carbon 96.2%，GPT-6 只有 71.8%，Claude 66.8%。

漏洞利用能力：Carbon 54.8%，GPT-6 为 42.4%，Claude 34.5%。

智能体终端任务：Carbon 65.2%，GPT-6 为 59.1%，Claude 59.6%。

AI 已经开始反过来帮助 Google 提升模型训练和发布速度，未来 12 个月还会因递归自我改进（RSI）继续加速。

Carbon 目前还没有全面开放，但这个迭代速度有点吓人了。

照这个节奏，AI 模型的领先优势可能越来越短暂，谁能持续快速迭代，谁才最可怕。

미국 예탁결제원(DTCC)이 드디어 토큰화 증권 서비스를 공식 출시했습니다. 

지금까지 토큰화 주식 시장은 여러 RWA 플랫폼들이 동일한 주식을 저마다 다른 방식으로 토큰화하면서 유동성이 파편화되는 구조적인 문제를 안고 있었습니다.

그런데 이제 미국 증권시장의 핵심 인프라인 DTCC가 직접 토큰화에 나섰습니다.

기존 증권과 동일한 소유권과 투자자 보호를 유지하면서, 전통 금융시장과 온체인 시장을 연결하는 제도권 토큰화 증권이 등장한 것입니다.

개인적으로는 이번 출시가 시장의 경쟁 구도를 상당히 바꿀 수 있다고 생각합니다.

장기적으로 유동성이 이러한 공인된 인프라를 중심으로 통합된다면, 개별 RWA 플랫폼의 경쟁력은 더 이상 '무엇을 토큰화할 수 있는가'가 아니라 '얼마나 많은 유동성과 투자자를 연결할 수 있는가'에 달리게 될 것입니다.

결국 토큰을 발행하는 기술 자체보다는 유통망과 접근성, 그리고 유동성을 확보하는 능력이 핵심적인 해자(moat)가 되는 시장으로 재편될 가능성이 높아 보입니다.

또 하나 흥미로운 점은 아시아 시장입니다.

한국, 일본, 홍콩, 싱가포르처럼 비허가형 토큰화 증권 시장이 아직 본격적으로 형성되지 않은 국가들은 오히려 민간 플랫폼들이 먼저 시장을 개척하고 이후 제도권 인프라가 진입한 미국과 달리, 아시아에서는 각국의 예탁결제기관이 처음부터 토큰화 인프라를 주도하는 시나리오도 충분히 생각해볼 만합니다.

이 경우 기존 금융기관과 시장 인프라가 가진 신뢰, 규제적 지위, 그리고 방대한 유동성이 오히려 가장 강력한 경쟁력이 될 수 있다고 생각합니다.

어쩌면 토큰화 증권 시장의 최종 승자는 가장 먼저 주식을 토큰화한 기업이 아니라, 기존 금융시장의 유동성을 온체인으로 가장 효과적으로 연결하는 주체가 될지도 모르겠습니다.

+ 참고로 DTCC는 오는 11월 말 출시 예정인 LayerZero의 Zero Blockchain에 초기 핵심 파트너로 참여하고 있습니다. 현재 Zero의 기술을 활용해 증권 토큰화와 담보 관리 등 기존 금융시장 인프라를 온체인으로 확장하는 방안을 함께 연구하고 있는데요.

앞으로 전통 금융과 온체인 시장을 연결하는 과정에서 어떤 협업이 펼쳐질지 개인적으로도 무척 기대가 큽니다.

author: oragnes
quoted_text:
卧槽，Peer 居然把支付宝接进来了？背后还有以太坊基金会和 Base 的支持？

这个 Peer 背景还挺有意思，2023 年起源于 ZK 黑客松，早期获得以太坊基金会 PSE 研究支持，后来部署在 Coinbase 孵化的 Base 链上。

它之前叫 ZKP2P，今年 2 月才改名 Peer，核心就是想解决 Crypto 最麻烦的问题之一：法币出入金。

它的技术逻辑很巧妙：

卖家先把 USDC 锁进 Base 链上的智能合约，买家通过支付宝直接把人民币转给卖家，Peer 再利用密码学技术验证付款记录，确认后自动释放 USDC。

整个过程不需要 Peer 经手人民币，也不用像传统 OTC 那样依赖卖家手动放币。它走的是个人之间的转账通道，支付宝账户风控、资金来源和国内监管风险依然存在。

目前官方的说法是之后会加入审核机制，审核通过的可以自由交易，避免黑钱导致账号被封。

目前还支持 PayPal、Venmo、Revolut、Wise 等支付渠道。

quoted_text:
This is where tokenized stocks start to get interesting

@0xbeans proposes splitting one tokenized share into two tradable tokens: 

1) one capturing overnight price moves
2) the other regular trading session moves

A similar idea to Pendle splitting principal and yield, applied to WHEN a stock generates its returns

The two windows can behave very differently, so separating them could let investors trade overnight earnings exposure, hedge specific periods and build DeFi strategies around either leg

Both tokens together remain redeemable for the underlying share

Still an early proposal, but a useful example of how programmable stocks could create entirely new markets around familiar assets

We’ve already seen a plethora of value accrue to STANDARD charter holders, I’d hazard a guess there’s a lot more to come

We’re still in the early innings of what’s possible with tokenized stocks, and if you believe Robinhood will be the leader then there’s some pretty clear winners emerging that are worth tracking closely

author: wafer_ai
quoted_text:
if i had to learn cuda compilation, ptx, register spills, and gpu disassembly from scratch because my "optimized" kernel got slower, i'd start here

links in thread 🧵

the compilation and machine code section of our ai performance engineering repo contains four nvidia resources for understanding how cuda source becomes gpu instructions and inspecting the code behind ai kernels:

understanding ptx explains how nvcc separates cpu and gpu code, why ptx is a virtual instruction set, and how ptxas turns it into a cubin.

the article covers fatbins, driver jit compilation, and gpu compatibility, giving context for deployment targets and inference startup costs.

nvcc compiler driver covers gpu architecture targets, the files each compilation stage produces, separate compilation, and device linking.

the nvcc guide explains how to retain intermediate files and report register usage, shared memory, and spill loads and stores. those compiler reports help compare kernel builds after changes to tile size, unrolling, or fusion.

ptx isa defines register, local, shared, and global state spaces; memory ordering and synchronization; and arithmetic and matrix instructions.

ptx isa details operand layouts, data types, accumulation precision, and gpu requirements, plus completion rules for asynchronous copies. useful for checking data movement and numerical behavior in attention and matmul kernels.

cuda binary utilities covers extracting embedded ptx and cubins, disassembling native gpu instructions (sass), and reporting register counts and static memory usage with cuobjdump.

nvdisasm provides control-flow graphs when the cubin contains complete relocation information, plus register-liveness views.

with debug line information, nvdisasm can annotate instructions with source lines. useful for inspecting generated loads, stores, branches, and arithmetic after a kernel rewrite.

together, these resources connect the compilation process to the code being measured. they help identify what changed between kernel builds and what to investigate before the next correctness check or benchmark.

follow and save to keep up with the series.

text:
Claude Code with Grok Bot just found proof that the keyboard on your iPhone can read everything you type. WhatsApp, Safari, Instagram, your bank app. a "free" keyboard was sending it out 2,416 times a day. i have the logs to prove it.

i've had a weird feeling about my phone for weeks but tonight something happened that made me finally check.

i was texting my brother about a used car i wanted to buy. never searched it. never said it out loud. just typed it in WhatsApp. 20 minutes later i open Instagram and my feed is full of that exact car. same model. same color. my brother texted me "bro why are you sending me car ads." i said i didn't. but i knew something was wrong.

i opened my MacBook and ran Claude Code that same night.

it went through my home Pi-hole log, every request my iPhone made since midnight. 18,342 of them. not just from the apps i had open. from everything running on the phone, including stuff i forgot i even installed.

what it found:

→ Instagram → 212 requests
→ WhatsApp → 388
→ K*yboard Pro → 2,416

a keyboard. a "free fonts" keyboard i downloaded in February and used maybe twice. Full Access turned on since 14 Feb.

then Claude Code matched every request to what i was doing on the phone at that moment:

→ WhatsApp → 1,120 requests, every time i typed a message
→ Safari → 806, every search and every login form
→ my bank app → 490, on the screen where i type my password
→ screen locked → zero. it only woke up when i typed

the last one went out at 00:58:41. three minutes before Claude Code found it.

the scariest one was the bank. 490 requests from the one screen where i type my password. every day. for 8 months.

then i checked my mom's phone on the same network. same keyboard. different fonts, same domains. she installed it because i told her about it.

i asked Claude Code how this was even possible. when you add a keyboard on iPhone it asks you to "Allow Full Access", and Apple's own warning says a keyboard with full access can send anything you type to its developer. passwords, card numbers, messages. nobody reads that screen. the fonts don't work without it, so everyone taps allow.

and it's not just one sketchy app. in 2024 Citizen Lab tested 9 of the most popular keyboard apps. 8 of them leaked what people typed. close to 1 billion users.

what i did:

→ Settings → General → Keyboard → Keyboards → Edit → deleted it
→ deleted the app itself, not just the keyboard
→ changed my bank and email passwords from my laptop, not from my phone
→ turned off Full Access for every keyboard that isn't Apple's

Claude Code checked the log again an hour later. zero requests from the keyboard. did the same on my mom's phone. took about 2 minutes per phone.

my feed went back to normal the next day. no more car. that's when i knew for sure.

the full step by step and the prompt are in the first reply. takes 2 minutes. save it so you don't lose it and send it to anyone who's ever downloaded a "cute" keyboard. yours might be doing it right now.

quoted_text:
The Federal Reserve held interest rates steady today, and we think patience is the right approach. Inflation remains high, but the question isn't simply whether rates should go higher. It's whether higher rates would actually address the inflation that remains.
 
The challenge is that parts of the economy, and of inflation itself, are moving at very different speeds. Growth remains remarkably resilient in aggregate, supported by a powerful investment cycle, but beneath the surface, parts of the economy that are more sensitive to borrowing costs are feeling considerably more restraint. We see a similar divergence in inflation. Many of the cyclical components that respond to higher interest rates appear relatively well controlled. Meanwhile, persistent pressures across energy, insurance, healthcare and education are unlikely to be meaningfully affected by another 25-basis-point rate increase.
 
In some ways, the Fed is operating a house with one thermostat, but very different temperatures in every room. Turning it down further may make the rooms that are already cool even colder, without doing much to cool those that remain hot.  
 
That doesn't mean the Fed should become complacent. Inflation is still above its 2% objective and the Fed should retain the option to tighten further if the underlying inflation trend deteriorates. But hawkish rhetoric and patient policy can comfortably coexist, particularly when the bond market has already done some tightening of its own through higher Treasury yields.
 
For investors, we think this environment argues for humility rather than making a heroic directional call on rates. Real yields remain attractive, and there's considerable income available across high-quality fixed income markets. We continue to favor a moderate duration posture, taking advantage of today's income opportunities while remaining patient as this unusually divergent economy evolves.
 
The Fed doesn't need to ignore the heat. It just needs to be thoughtful about where it's coming from.

text:
Card revenue represents 63% of @ether_fi's revenue, according to @Blockworks. A year ago it was ~15%, and it only crossed 50% in June.

Add membership fees, card orders and net borrow revenue, and Cash is closer to three quarters of the business. Staking is now the minority.

The borrow side is growing fast too:

> Outstanding loans hit a record $45M, more than double July’s ~$21M
>USDT, WETH and EURC loans appeared in the last few weeks, so users are borrowing more than just USDC
> Once Cash loans on EtherFi’s Aave V4 instance reach $50M, borrow revenue joins the buyback.

The card acquires users. Borrow monetizes them. Buybacks reward them in $ETHFI. That’s the neobank flywheel, and it’s showing up in the revenue mix.

The market still prices $ETHFI like a staking token.

text:
今天有三个重要信息

谷歌财报、微软财报、甲骨文投资者日

谷歌：本季实际Capex：约513.6亿美元，低于分析师预期的约550.9亿美元，全年2026年Capex指引维持不变，仍为1950亿–2050亿美元

谷歌没说为什么这个季度不及预期，但是也没下调全年指引，并且说2027年会显著增加

微软：本季实际Capex：约452亿美元，低于公司自身此前对当季的预期（约500亿美元），也低于分析师预期（约506.7亿美元）

公司将2026日历年Capex指引从约1750亿美元下调至约1700亿美元，但是预计明年资本开支会加速。

本季度不及预期是因为供货延迟的问题，不是公司主动下调。

很多人看完财报立马制造恐慌说云巨头下调资本开支了。实际上并没有这么严重，我觉得谷歌也大概率是因为供货的原因导致钱没花出去。

 但有了一次不及预期，市场就会担心有下一次（包括我也担心）所以这个消息我觉得略偏负面吧。

甲骨文今天投资者日披露了非常多的内容。

我挑最重要的几个说一下 （甲骨文财年和自然年差别很大，我都换成自然年了）

1、资本开支2028年6月见顶

2、现金流2027 年 12 月至 2028 年 5 月之间就可以转正，比市场预计的要早一年。

3、在 2029 年下半年至 2030 年上半年 实现年化营收超 2250 亿美元、EPS >21 美元；在此之前的外部融资总额不超过 200 亿美元

甲骨文是最早举债All in AI的公司，他们预计资本开支在28年年中见顶的话，我估计整个AI资本开支见顶的日期会在28年底到29年上半年。但市场看到这种见顶时间，可能会直接在27年就抢跑。所以明年是需要进行仓位大幅度调整的一年。

总结一下，微软、谷歌的资本开支不及预期目前看不影响大趋势，只是过程中的小波澜（这两家这期财报的云业务收入都超市场预期很多），但是甲骨文给资本开支的峰值时期一个明确的时间点——28年6月。

text:
不完全准确。

三线建设从一开始就把四川（含重庆）作为西南核心：两基一线（攀枝花钢铁、重庆兵器、成昆铁路）是重中之重，四川投资约414亿元，占全国约20%。云南投资150.95亿元，规模明显小于四川，定位是交通枢纽+资源供给（锡铜等）+部分军工，兼具前线与后方双重属性。

越南战争升级是1964年启动整个三线的重要触发因素，并非后来才把云南从“先进产能同级目的地”改成前线。云南边境属性本就存在，省内也自行划了前中后三线。它确实输出兵源资源，但并非因此被降级。

命运有随机，但规划上四川优先是明确的。

text:
“当时我们还没看到模型，却准备开出一张大概一千亿、两千亿美元的支票。”

扎克伯格说的，是这次刚发布的新一代前沿模型Muse Wonder。去年底它还在训练，Meta就得先押上千亿美元的算力。

Meta创始人兼CEO马克·扎克伯格，和Meta首席AI官、Scale AI联合创始人亚历山大·王，一起做客Stripe联合创始人约翰·科里森的播客《Cheeky Pint》，节目在2026年10月13日发布，时长两个多小时。两人复盘了Llama 4受挫后怎样推倒重来、一千亿美元的算力豪赌、"模型即产品"的理念，还有智能体会怎样改写商业。想看懂Meta这场AI翻身战，这是最完整的一次当事人自述。

01｜格斗教练，也是代码工厂
 扎克伯格最喜欢的用法，是让Muse当他的综合格斗教练：健身房装了摄像头，它在回合间隙给反馈。"在智能体内部，虽然我看不见任何代码，但它实际上在编写整套视频和图像处理流水线。"他的判断是："未来人人都将编写海量代码，只是他们浑然不觉。"
 编程正在沉到界面下面。

02｜大多数人不爱读字
 "我们最初的一个理论是，大多数人其实并不那么喜欢阅读。"亚历山大·王补充："世界上大多数人是以高度多模态的方式来体验世界的。"行业都在押注代码的时候，Meta押的是多模态。说到眼镜，扎克伯格甚至说："我甚至不确定我们是否还需要在眼镜里搞一个应用商店。"
 文字界面，可能只是AI的过渡形态。

03｜模型即产品
 "产品外壳变得越来越薄，而模型正在成为产品的核心。我们在内部常说的一句金句就是：'模型即产品'。"人设、主动性、什么时候介入，最终"都会归结为模型设计决策，进而落实到训练方法、数据、评估"。Muse甚至没有模型选择器。
 产品经理的活，正在搬进训练数据里。

04｜记得住，也做得完
 Muse Wonder （Wonder意为奇迹）
主打两项能力。一是主动记忆，看的是它"在几天、几周或几个月内能多好地记住你提到的事情"。二是主动专注，指它"能够在极长的时间跨度内执行完整任务"。扎克伯格说，这标志着"未来每次推出更大规模模型之间的时间间隔将开始压缩"。
 智能体的门槛不在聪明，在靠谱。

05｜别把产品外包给博士生
 说到外部基准测试，亚历山大·王毫不客气："这无异于将所有的产品思考，外包给了一位碰巧做出爆款基准测试的博士生。"Meta越来越依赖内部评估，还量化了一个叫"大模型味儿"的指标，也就是模型在训练分布内和分布外表现的差距。
 刷榜第一，不等于用户觉得好用。

06｜对齐的对象是用户
 "你绝不希望它在执行任务前，先给你上一堂道德说教课。"扎克伯格把对齐理解为"与它所服务的人对齐"，并强调"分寸感"：替你订餐厅时，它要避开你的过敏原，又不能向餐厅透露你的健康状况。
 这是和其他实验室最不一样的一句话，也最值得争论。

07｜一千亿美元的豪赌
 开头那句话就出自这里。去年底，Muse Wonder还在预训练，扎克伯格回忆："当时我们还没看到模型，却准备开出一张大概一千亿、两千亿美元的支票。我就问亚历山大，你确定这能行吗？"首席财务官苏珊·李把亚历山大·王拉到一边说："如果这行不通，情况会非常非常糟。"扎克伯格自己的算法是："要让这笔投资打水漂，不能仅仅是我们失败，而是整个 AI 领域都必须失败。"
 前沿AI的规则是：牌还没发，筹码就得先押上。

08｜不到200人
 亚历山大·王给扎克伯格的第一条建议是："你不需要很多人，人才密度才是关键。"现在MSL"研究团队不到两百人"，其他实验室往往有几百人。他刚加入时，一位负责人说"我们不需要推理模型"，他说："那一刻，我的心直往下沉。"
 一千亿美元的项目，核心只有一百多个人。

09｜智能体买单的时代
 对那些想屏蔽智能体的企业，扎克伯格直言："那些业务长久不了，它们注定会被颠覆。"为了让Muse帮女儿采购烘焙食材，他专门注册了一个Instacart账号，现在每周用一两次。他反问："那个Instacart账号到底是为我注册的，还是为Muse注册的？"
 下一批新用户，可能根本不是人。

10｜AI不会赢家通吃
 扎克伯格说"唯有少数几家公司能构建前沿超级智能"，但他不认为会一家独大："少数公司垄断对未来而言是风险更高的格局。"亚历山大·王指出，因为模型蒸馏，"如今非常小的模型，其能力远比一年或两年前最大的模型强大得多"。
 门槛越来越高，能力却越来越便宜，这是AI最大的矛盾。

这场对话的底色，是一次豪赌之后的复盘。Llama 4受挫后，Meta推倒重来，用不到200人的团队加上千亿美元的算力，押注"个人超级智能"。开头那张还没看到模型就要签的支票，现在交出了第一份答卷：Muse Wonder。真正的考验还在后面：几十亿普通人愿不愿意把生活交给一个智能体。
你愿意让一个AI智能体替你花钱、替你下单吗？

author: lipko
quoted_text:
My key takeaways from the $GOOGL (Alphabet) Q3 2026 earnings call.

1. Search slowed while query growth hit a five-year high. Search and other ads grew 12% to $63.3B, down from Q2. The deceleration has four parts. FX was the biggest drag. The EU ended its de minimis exemption (duty-free treatment for cheap parcels), which hit APAC retail advertisers. World Cup media budgets landed in June instead of July. And AI Mode queries grew fast on a surface with "lower monetization" than classic Search. The first three wash out over time. The fourth is structural: more usage on a surface that earns less per query.

2. The EPS miss is mostly a SpaceX mark. Revenue grew 25% to $127.6B. Operating income grew 30% to $40.6B, a 31.8% margin. EPS came in at $2.12 against $3.02 expected because OI&E (other income and expense, the non-operating line where investment gains and losses land) swung to negative $8.2B. Most of that was an unrealized loss on the SpaceX stake after its share price fell. My rough math: after tax, that mark costs around $0.55 a share, so it explains more than half the $0.90 gap but not all of it.

3. Q4 Search is already guided softer. Lapping last year's Search acceleration cost about 3 points of growth in Q3 and will cost a couple more in Q4. FX gets slightly worse at current spot rates, mostly in Search and YouTube. The rest of Services won't make up the difference: YouTube ads grew only 9% to $11.2B, and Network grew 1% to $7.5B.

4. The AI Mode ad fix is rolling out but not proven. Ads in AI Mode go international for the first time, and multi-turn ads (ads that stay in a back-and-forth conversation) launch in the U.S. The evidence offered: inside AI Mode, sponsored and organic product listings get similar click-through rates. AI Mode queries run about 3x longer than classic searches, and most are incremental, meaning they would not have happened otherwise. What's missing is any number on how far AI Mode revenue per query trails classic Search. Agentic commerce (AI agents that shop and buy for users) is called additive, and consumer agents arrive in the Gemini app later this year. No revenue is attached to it yet.

5. Cloud doubled. Revenue grew 103% to $30.7B. Operating income was $11.1B, more than triple last year. Margin was 36.2% versus 23.7% a year ago. Backlog (signed contracts not yet booked as revenue) reached $561B, and just over 55% of it, about $310B, converts within 24 months. Two caveats. TPU system sales contributed to the growth but were not sized, and Cloud growth excluding TPUs was described as very strong with no number attached. Also, the rented third-party compute capacity came online only at the very end of Q3, so its margin drag lands in Q4.

6. TPU economics stay private. A TPU is Google's in-house AI chip, sold here as full racks with networking, storage and software. One analyst framed a TPU system at roughly $35B per gigawatt and asked how much of that becomes revenue and at what margin. Neither got an answer, because product-level financials are not disclosed. The cash cycle is clear. A signed contract shows up in backlog, Google builds inventory, and cash arrives on delivery. Inventory is only built against committed contracts. There are nearly 100 TPU customers, including Anthropic (directly and through Broadcom) and Apple, which is scaling pretraining on TPUs. New distribution comes through Oracle and Crux AI, a joint venture with Blackstone. The meaningful revenue ramp is 2027.

7. Free cash flow went negative. Q3 FCF was negative $9.1B on $51.4B of capex. Operating cash flow of $42.3B also absorbed the TPU inventory build and a $5.2B payment on a 2018 EC fine. Trailing twelve-month FCF is $19.7B. The 2026 capex guide is unchanged at $195B to $205B, and 2027 rises significantly, with numbers on the Q4 call. On top of that sit $924B in future purchase commitments and $152B in leases that haven't started and other obligations. Those are contractual maximums, and some have volume flexibility.

8. The return math is stated, not shown. Return on invested capital is said to stay meaningfully above the cost of capital, with no figure. Compute allocation is described as a long-range plan run on ROIC discipline, with no ranking of who gets capacity first. Cloud says it could serve a lot more demand with more capacity. About 65% of Q3 infrastructure spend went to servers and networking depreciated over six years, while TPU 8t claims up to 2.7x the training performance of the prior generation. My view: six years is a long life for hardware that loses that much ground each generation. Shorter lives would mean higher depreciation on top of the capex.

9. First-party model APIs process nearly 32B tokens (units of text an AI model reads or writes) per minute, up 40% QoQ and more than 4x YoY. In its first week on developer platforms, Gemini 4 Argon ramped 3.5x faster than Gemini 3, even with capacity limits. Customers who used Gemini Enterprise in Q3 2025 have more than quadrupled their spend. The Gemini app is at 1B users. This is the clearest evidence that the capex has real buyers.

Bottom line: The operating business beat. Revenue grew 25%, operating income grew 30%, Cloud doubled at a 36% margin, and the headline EPS miss is mostly a paper loss on SpaceX. The stock still fell about 10% after hours, from $322.22 to $288.35, because the market is now pricing cash, not growth. Quarterly FCF is negative, capex runs near $200B and rises again in 2027, commitments total about $1T, and the biggest profit pool is slowing as usage shifts to a surface that earns less per query. Management described every link between the spend and the payoff and did not put any number on them.

text:
Wrapping up my 10 years at Google DeepMind today, with lots of mixed emotions. It has been a wild journey that I could not have imagined 10 years ago.

I remember getting a job offer at GDM in 2016, then shortly after witnessing AlphaGo beating Lee Sedol. I felt I made the right choice taking the offer. At GDM I was fortunate to have worked on graph neural nets, program synthesis, language models, AlphaCode, then Gemini, from tool use to agentic capabilities to eventually RSI with some of the most amazing teammates, mentors and advisors. The AI landscape has changed so much and the pace of development is accelerating so rapidly now. This makes me extremely excited about the potential AI will bring to the world but also nervous about the challenges we might face in this process. Overall I am cautiously optimistic about the future.

I’m looking forward to finally taking a break in the “garden” while thinking about what comes next!

text:
关于 $GOOGL ，我怀疑很多人没看财报没听电话会，跟着k线随波逐流。

谷歌已经需要从外面买算力来满足客户，四季度还要买更多。这时候只盯着资本开支涨得快不快，容易把问题看反。

这次电话会最值得认真听的，就是这段。

（1）谷歌眼下缺的，是能交到客户手里的产能。

CFO说，第三方算力直到三季度末才上线，因此对本季云利润率的拖累有限。四季度会扩大使用，短期利润率将承压。

这句话解释了谷歌正在做的取舍。自己的产能暂时接不住需求，就先用外部资源把生意做起来，代价是少赚一点。

如果客户确实愿意付钱，谷歌的选择就不能只按“怎样让下季度利润率最好看”来算。少租一点，利润率可能漂亮，但一部分客户需求也可能接不下来。

所以，四季度云利润率如果下降，要先看外购算力带来了多少新增业务，不能看到利润率回落，就直接推成需求转弱。

（2）在这个前提下，资本开支增加有它的必要性。

谷歌云本季收入增长103%，经营利润约111亿美元。客户需求已经在变成收入和利润，讨论扩产有现实基础。

现在一边需要外购算力，一边又要求公司控制自有产能建设，总得回答一个问题——后面增长的客户需求准备交给谁？

自建需要时间，也会带来折旧、电力和运营成本。但如果新增产能能够被持续使用，就有机会减少对外部供应商的依赖，把更多经营收益留在自己手里。

租算力解决眼前交付，自建解决后续供给，两者可能在一段时间里同时增加。这会让当期报表难看，却不天然意味着投资方向错了。

而且谷歌这次没有上调2026年资本开支指引，仍是1950亿至2050亿美元。管理层说2027年会显著增加，具体安排留到下次财报解释。把这次结果描述成“又突然加码”，也不准确。

（3）负自由现金流需要进一步分析。

本季自由现金流负91亿美元，其中还有52亿美元的欧盟罚款付款，以及为TPU系统销售准备库存带来的占款。

罚款是实际付出去的钱，不能装作没发生；但它不能代表每个季度都要重复承担的经营成本。备货则要继续追到后面的交付和回款。

电话会上，云业务负责人Kurian还明确说，TPU系统库存对应的是已经签下的合同。这个信息比单独看到库存上升有价值，至少说明公司是在为承诺的交付准备货物。

合同当然还要执行，但备货占用现金，与产品卖不出去积压在那里，是两种不同处境。

因此，这份现金流没有表面数字看起来那么简单。它同时包含扩产、交付准备和一次罚款付款，不能全部解释成AI生意赚钱能力变差。

（4）谷歌仍有需要面对的问题，搜索变现就是其中一个。

管理层解释，搜索增速放缓受汇率、广告行业变化等因素影响，也承认AI Mode目前变现较低。更多使用量怎样转成广告收入，这一段还需要做出来。

同样，三季度36.2%的云利润率，也不能直接当成四季度的基准。第三方算力的成本影响才刚开始，公司已经提前说了后面会承压。

但这些问题，没有推翻扩产的经营理由。

这份财报之后，对谷歌云的判断应该更积极。收入和利润在增长，供给却仍然紧，甚至需要外购来补。此时资本开支的价值，要看它能否补上交付缺口、改善后续供给成本。

如果以后产能上线了，客户用量接不上，或者新增收入覆盖不了长期成本，那才有充分理由质疑扩产。

眼下已经要靠外面的算力接客户，还只拿“资本开支太高”当结论，等于跳过了谷歌为什么必须花这笔钱。
